Crew Pew.Imps: They want us out so the can loot the [town].
Crew Pew.town: They are pushing boulders down the hill that are damaging our buildings and injuring [people].
Crew Pew.people: My [shop] has been damaged and my [daughter] injured.
Crew Pew.daughter: Please help us by killing the imps and their leader.
Crew Pew.assistance: Will you brave warriors please [assist] us?
Crew Pew.assist: If you bring me the evidence that you have killed them, you will be handsomely rewarded.

npc_lines.Crew Pew: Help! [Imps] on the hill behind me are trying to force us out of town! They want us out so the can loot the [town]. They are pushing boulders down the hill that are damaging our buildings and injuring [people]. My [shop] has been damaged and my [daughter] injured. Please help us by killing the imps and their leader. We are desperate for [assistance]. Will you brave warriors please [assist] us? If you bring me the evidence that you have killed them, you will be handsomely rewarded.

A6.accept_line: Oh thank you! He was last seen not far from here. Northeast, into the woods!

Olorustos.can help: Yes, there is an outcast member of our association known as Ormgarth who has been [causing problems].

npc_lines.Ormgarth: You shall not stop me from killing those who have caused me such pain!

M7.offer: I leave hobgoblins. Me no like [hobgoblins]! Carr stay here in Mularn now!
M7.accept_line: Smyga and Anklebiter [terrible mean] hobgoblin, always on raids. I don't like what they do anymore so I stay here.
M7.finish: Yes! Kill Anklebiter and bring the orders to me.

Carr.terrible mean: Is a frightening time! Scared of the [Hobgoblin Anklebiter]!
Carr.Hobgoblin Anklebiter: Anklebiter mean Lieutenant to Smyga. Smyga and Anklebiter [planning something awful] they are.
Carr.planning something awful: No, am scared of plans Anklebiter may carry out [in Smyga's orders].
Carr.in Smyga's orders: Yes! Can find the Anklebiter in the Hobgoblin Camp. Anklebiter always carry out orders. Bring Smyga's Orders from Anklebiter.

A11.offer: Some talk of a red snake that will only come should he become [displeased].
A11.accept_line: Good! This rare snake was last seen to the east. Not far from the walls of Camelot. Best of luck in your endeavor!

Commander Burcrif.displeased: I know now what might truly displease a snake, but I do know where he may be found. Are you [interested]?

A12.offer: What am I to do? My boat has sunk in the river and the [cargo] lost. Oh what am I to do?

Cullen Smyth.cargo: My cargo of fine apple brandy that I was [delivering] to the King's table. Did you know that Hakon is a master wood craftsman as well as a hunter?

A15.offer: Help! Evil is walking the land and it has despoiled my farm. An army of [zombie swine] has invaded my land, they are led by the walking corpse of the farmer who owned the land before me.
A15.accept_line: Thank heavens, one less monster to ruin my land. Here is a small payment for your troubles.

Gronyr Gloyw.zombie swine: Aye, foul and corrupted undead swine rise from the ground at [night] and dance around their unholy master, a zombie farmer. If you bring me rotting hig tails as proof that you have killed them, I will reward you.
Gronyr Gloyw.night: Only at night do the beasts rise from the grave to ravage my fields. Even if you do not agree to help me, beware [walking] the road near m farm at night, for evil walks the land.

A16.offer: So you want to buy something eh? Well here is what I have.
A16.accept_line: It is said that upon his death, he carried into the after life an item of great worth. Some say he still walks the cemetery not far from here!

Hugh Gallen.bit of information: Listen close! Lord Prydwen once had a faithful cleric, known as Mulgrut. His service to our realm was unparallel. Yet, during Arthur's siege on Lancelot, his son, <Player>, [was slain].
Hugh Gallen.was slain: Yes! Mulgrut [never recovered] from that. He turned his eyes from God and never looked back.
Hugh Gallen.never recovered: Aye! Even in death his soul never rests. If you are interested, I can tell you how to [make a profit] from this!

npc_lines.Mulgrut Maggot: Die you demon of Arthur! My son shall be avenged!

M18.accept_line: You waste much time. Svartmoln eat many crabs, many more fishermen. Leave. No come back until have Svartmoln's hide.
M18.finish: You kill Svartmoln. Village honor you. Kyba honor you. Here, take this gift that Kristen, the Norse woman, fashion for you.
giver_turnins: Where Svartmoln hide?

M19.offer: (your name here), it is time to send you out into the lands beyond ours. Explore these other lands and tell them of our house's good will and [aid those we can].
M19.accept_line: Well then, if you wish to journey these lands, I shall send you to Val. He can be found in the guard tower on the road to East Svealand. Do explore!

Val.some time: Just bring me a few of those ant parts; these little ant workers have been everywhere lately. You could rid us of a few, couldn't you now.

Lalida.Fort Atla: Oh. Val must have sent you. I had requested his aid, but it is no longer necessary...but since you've come this way, speak with Ruk. She owes me one, tell her Lalida says hello.

npc_lines.Val: Aye there. You've come a ways, haven't you now? Spare me [some time], could you? Just bring me a few of those ant parts; these little ant workers have been everywhere lately. You could rid us of a few, couldn't you now.
npc_lines.Lalida: You look a traveler from far off. What brings you to [Fort Atla]? Oh. Val must have sent you. I had requested his aid, but it is no longer necessary...but since you've come this way, speak with Ruk. She owes me one, tell her Lalida says hello.
npc_lines.Ruk: Hello traveler. Can I help you? Well! I am glad. Here, now don't be telling all your friends I've give you this now.

Gwaell.a moment: I have learned how to craft them from a few [tomte bracers].
Gwaell.tomte bracers: Yes, the jerkin requires a total of three tomte bracers in order to have enough material to create. You show interest in this object. Would you like me to [craft one] for you?
Gwaell.craft one: Very well then, find three of these [bracers] and return them to me.

npc_lines.Denise: A troll in Audliten who goes by the name of Aleaniver, is spreading tales of a great beast! Joining the hunt might prove your worth!

H26.offer: Blessings upon you this day, noble (character class). I have the finest wares in all of Connacht, and I humbly thank thee for taking a minute of your most valuable time to view my wares. Although I am not talented enough to [make the armor] , I do sell fine things.
H26.accept_line: I am most pleased to see you have returned safe and sound. I hope you were able to collect the items my cousin needs. Please give me the hill toad warts first.
H26.finish: Well, I see you had no difficulty obtaining that either! My cousin will be overjoyed, and he will pay me well. I am not a selfish person, so please, take this. It is your share of what I will receive from him. I thank you most sincerely!
giver_turnins: Ah, this group of warts is perfect. I believe my cousin uses them strengthen armor. (sic) He will be pleased. Now for the water beetle wings?
Hmmm, these wings are a bit tattered, but I believe my cousin will be able to use them. Thank you. Now for the final item the spraggonite hide. Please give it to me.

Cristin.make the armor: Oh, I do wish I had the talent, but alas, it is my cousin that makes the actual armor, as well as repairs items that have been damaged or worn. I assist him by collecting the [necessary items] he needs.
Cristin.necessary items: He uses things like hides, pelts, and other parts of animals in his repairs. I have recently received word he is in need of more supplies, but I have no one to take over my shop for me. I am [in need] of someone to retrieve items for me.
Cristin.in need: I am so pleased you have agreed to help me. I will tell you the things I need, and if you are able to retrieve them all, I will pay you well. There are [three things] on the list my cousin sent me.
Cristin.three things: All three things can be found either around Connacht (sic) . The first object sound strange, but it is what he has requested. I need you to get some warts from the hill toads. They are easy enough to get, don't you think? Now, for item [number two] .
Cristin.number two: My cousin has requested that I obtain for him a set of wings from a water beetle. I know I've seen them around here in Connacht. They shouldn't be too difficult to get. Now for the [third item] .
Cristin.third item: I know what he uses this third item for. Spraggonite hides make wonderful patches in torn leather. Please get a hide from a [spraggonite] either here in Connacht or in Silvermine Mountains. Once you have all three items, return to me here.

A29.offer: Greetings, I'm the master of stonemason hereabouts. You look in need of a decent [weapon]. Perhaps I can help you in that regard, though it may put you in a bit of danger.

Stonemason Harwin.weapon: Aye, though you may scoff at the idea, stone weapons, if made correctly can be quite effective. I can make a [knife], a [club], or a [dirk] depending on the shape of the [chert] I start with.
Stonemason Harwin.chert: Ok, I should be able to manage a dirk for you. I'll need a thin [chert] though to get the best thrusting action. If you bring me one I'll make you a dirk.

A30.offer: Hail! Ever heard of [throatripper]?" (South Black Mountains - 5963,59063,1024)
A30.accept_line: Thank you! I might actually get some sleep tonight.
A30.finish: She is a Seamstress in Ludlow.
giver_turnins: Wow! You did it! As promised, here is your reward. You should take that pelt into Ludlow and talk to [Marie]. It might be more valuable than you think!

Lieutenant Jursen.throatripper: Yeah, an [angry wolf] who has taken up living in these woods.
Lieutenant Jursen.angry wolf: I would have taked care of it myself, but I cannot leave my post. Will you [kill it]? I will reward you!
Lieutenant Jursen.Marie: She is a Seamstress in Ludlow.

Seamstress Marie.services: Well I can do most any leatherwork you may require. Do you have a [pelt] that you wish me to examine?
Seamstress Marie.pelt: I assume you required my leatherworking skills do you not? Let me see it!

npc_lines.Seamstress Marie: Hello, you appear to need my [services]. Well I can do most any leatherwork you may require. Do you have a [pelt] that you wish me to examine? I assume you required my leatherworking skills do you not? Let me see it! Ah! A fine pelt indeed! I will fashion this a jerkin but you will need to obtain another item so that I can sew it properly. Seek out a large skeleon and from it bring me a piece of polished bone.

H34.offer: Greetings, there, <Player>. You look like you could use some cash. I'll tell you what. If you help me, I can help [you].
H34.accept_line: Ah, my sweet Meara. Thank you <Player> for everything. I know her love for me is strong. One day, we will be united, no matter what her parents say. Please take this for your troubles.

Evan.you: Hehe, I can see it in your eyes that you're ready for some adventure! Excellent! Here's a note of grave importance that I must get you to take to Meara in [Mag Mell].
Evan.Mag Mell: Ah, you must indeed be young. Here are my [directions]. Follow the road out of town, make sure to head south. In the distance you'll see some towers, that is Mag Mell. Meara is a guard there, she's wearing green armour. Good luck!

Meara.letter: Here it is. Thank you so much. Please take this for your trouble. I do so appreciate your helping me with this.

npc_lines.Meara: Thank you so much for this letter. Oh, my beloved Evan, how I miss him. My parents have forbidden me from marrying him but I know he loves me so. Perhaps you can take a [letter] back to him for me? Here it is. Thank you so much. Please take this for your trouble. I do so appreciate your helping me with this.

M37.offer: Hail adventurer! I have a task you may be [able to assist] with.
M37.accept_line: Ah! Good work to thee. I have an item here that would suit you well. It is of some value alone, yet I have been told it has unlimited potential.

Aesirdia.able to assist: A thug by the name of [Olag] has been stealing our wares [every night].
Aesirdia.every night: He leaves us stupid notes requesting we deliver him someone by the name of [Wiley].
Aesirdia.Wiley: Yes, we know not exactly when he comes yet we would love to see him [leave for good].
Aesirdia.leave for good: Aye, it is said Wiley is a thief himself. I know nothing more if it.

npc_lines.Olag: You smell like Wiley! Where is he! Boys... lets get em! I'll not let you leave without handing over your wares!

M38.accept_line: Thanks for your help! That little guy was getting on my nerves!

Hurg.a problem: Some nasty minx called Wiley keeps [pestering the town].
Hurg.pestering the town: Yeah! He [won't go away]! He keeps [stealing stuff] from us.
Hurg.stealing stuff: If you get rid of him [I'll] pay ya!

M40.offer: I have given you a task! Prove [yourself] worthy or bother me no more.
M40.finish: I have heard of your great deed! You have killed Hrrgyf! For that, I shall honor you! Take this gift, granted only to the greatest warriors! I shall speak your name to Tyr!
giver_turnins: This would prove sufficient, if you were a child!
Much better, yet I am still not pleased.
Much better, yet I am still not pleased.
I am well pleased. I do require more of you, if you feel [worthy of the task].

Thordia.worthy of the task: Seek Viking Karl at the tower in the hills. He will explain what needs to be done.

Viking Karl.on the hunt: ?There is one vile beast that has feasted on many of my men. Thordia has promised me a great warrior. Kill Hrrgyf, the hill cat that roams the mountains here. Bring me her tooth, as proof of your deed.

npc_lines.Viking Karl: Ah, are you the one Thordia has sent me? Are you [on the hunt]? ?There is one vile beast that has feasted on many of my men. Thordia has promised me a great warrior. Kill Hrrgyf, the hill cat that roams the mountains here. Bring me her tooth, as proof of your deed. My thanks. Take this small reward my men have collected in hopes you would succeed. Thordia will be pleased. I am sure she will reward you when she sees you again.

M41.offer: Hail young one! I have noticed that you do not carry one of my fine [bone hilt swords].
M41.accept_line: Oh great then! Run along and buy me a bronze short sword. I should be ready once you return.
M41.finish: Here is your completed work. I hope it serves you well!
giver_turnins: Good work! I cannot seem to find anymore sveawolf teeth to fashion your weapon. Find one and return it to me.

Gridash.bone hilt swords: Aye! They are some of my finest works! I don't suppose you [would care for one] eh?

M44.offer: You look the friendly sort. Perhaps you [can help] me?
M44.accept_line: Keep your eyes west of the road to ensure reinforcements do not flank you.
M44.finish: You are truly well trained! Fare-thee-well in your future travels.

Tric.can help: I lost my [book of spells] in a battle. I am in no condition to recover it.
Tric.book of spells: It was a battle against a great goblin called Gib and his followers. The rest of my party was slain in battle. I was wounded and forced to retreat to this town. If you could [recover it] I would be grateful.
Tric.recover it: Many thanks. To find the place we battled, follow the road out of this town until you reach the main road. Turn left and [continue] for a few paces. You should notice them.

M49.offer: Hail to thee. I seem to be in a [bit of a snitch].
M49.accept_line: If you could bring back to me on of these legs I would be forever in your debt!
M49.finish: Ah! Thank you so much! I hope this small amount of coin is enough to compensate you. I may have other tasks in which you could help. Return to me later when you have gained more experience and I will tell you of them.

Alomali.bit of a snitch: My master has asked of me [a deed] I cannot complete.
Alomali.a deed: Aye! He asks the impossible! He wishes me to travel to [Striders' Isle] and return to him t he leg of one of [the beasts] there.
Alomali.the beasts: It is the island behind me. A solitary rune stone stands there.

A53.offer: Well met. You look like things are a bit slow and you are in need of some extra coin. How would you like [something to do] ?
A53.accept_line: It seems to be written in three anguages and I can not seem to untangle the words within. I do know of three women that can. [Three sages] were dispatched to study the weather at three towers.
A53.finish: The academy has decided to watch the weather in hopes of someday, being able to see into the future and know if it will rain in a few days. What a daft notion. [About that book]...

Trainer.something to do: I require the use of your brain more than the use of your brawn today. A few days ago, an ancient book was uncovered near [Stonehenge]. Whoever wrote this book must have been wise.
Trainer.Three sages: Each of them is also a master of three different, [ancient languages]. I know enough to figure out what the language is, but understanding it is a different matter.
Trainer.ancient languages: You must first find the tower in Camelot Hills that Sage Nelson has been assigned to. She has studied the Lemnian tongue, spoken on the island of Lemnos. She will tell you the location of the [other two].
Trainer.other two: The other two sages are at different towers. Just take the book to them and let them have a look at it. I still know not what puzzled them about the [weather] there.
Trainer.weather: The academy has decided to watch the weather in hopes of someday, being able to see into the future and know if it will rain in a few days. What a daft notion. [About that book]...

H60.offer: What brings you out this far? Shouldn't you be training at your Master's knee child? Or do you think to connive [knowledge] out of me?
H60.accept_line: I need three more. Stay away from the ruins of the Tower of Tir na mBeo. Its a place of powerful enchantment.
H60.finish: Caithor is the Champion responsible for the enchantment placed on Edan. Duana, in retribution, placed her own enchantment on Caithor. For every hundred years that passes in the land of men, only a day passes for Caithor. He wanders the land, seeking out a child of Duana and Edan destined to retrieve the Moonstone. This will break the enchanetment Duana placed on him. Some say he seeks Fagan's death as well. *the Moonstone:
giver_turnins: Two more ought to do it. Remember Eadienn, Fagan is Lord over Mag Mell, but the town's concerns arn't his. Some say he's the same Fagan of Fagan's feast.
One more, and I'll tell you what I know.
Yes, this will do. I shall tell you one more thing only. Which would you hear of, [Caithor], [Duana and Edan] or [the Moonstone]?

Trainer.knowledge: Aye. I thought so. Well, an old woman like me can't survive long on her own, being to old to practice the trade of my youth. [Knowledge] is my only trade now. The price is four rat tails.
Trainer.the Moonstone: Caithor is the Champion responsible for the enchantment placed on Edan. Duana, in retribution, placed her own enchantment on Caithor. For every hundred years that passes in the land of men, only a day passes for Caithor. He wanders the land, seeking out a child of Duana and Edan destined to retrieve the Moonstone. This will break the enchanetment Duana placed on him. Some say he seeks Fagan's death as well. *the Moonstone:

npc_lines.Maeve, the crone: Have you the rat tails? Ah, the Moonstone. It's a stone wielded by an Enchanter, and the only thing that can break the enchantment placed on Duana and Edan. It is here, in these lands. But none know where. Duana and Edan are the hounds that roam the ground of the ruined Tower of Tir na mBeo. In a time only the elders remember, Fagan held a feast, Edan asked for Duana. Against Fagan's wishes, she said yes. Fagan was enraged, but his geas strickly forbid him from killing the son of a man he had killed. He had his Champion find a way to remove Edan without killing him. Caithor challenged the bard Edan for Duana knowinf Edan would easily die on his blade. To prevent his death and Fagan breaking his geas, he made an ointment and rubbed it on his sword. The first strike hit Edan, and slowly, he was changed into a hound.

npc_lines.Kaegan: First, I need two bits of mud. You can collect t hem from the mudmen wandering just outside the village. Then, I'll need, oh, the fever has taken my mind, I can't remember if I need a dried sand cake from a sandman or the shinbones from a skeletal pawn. Oh, and I need to rest. I can't think of which one it is. It's one or the other. When you get the ingredients, bring them to me. I'm going to lie down and rest while you collect the ingredients.
npc_lines.Keagan: Rhodry, you're back. Oh wait, you're not Rhodry... this fever is making me lose my memory. I hope you have the ingredients. Here, give me a bit of mud first. Thank you Talelia. Now hand me that second bit of mud please. Good, good. Okay, hand me the shin bones. I'll take forever to grind these, but it must be done. Ah thank you, <Player>, ah, got you name right! Well, let me put this together for the towns people. This should surely cure the fever.

H65.offer: Have you time to do a favor for me? I've [promised] Slevin some mist powder. It's very hard to get, and he's paid me quite some money in advance, but I can't travel with this fever I've got. There's some money for you, if you do.
H65.accept_line: Here, take the powder to Slevin at the guard tower on the road past the bridge. You can keep the portion of the money he pays you, for your effort.

npc_lines.Slevin: Hi. Brave aren't you, coming out here? What can I do for you? Ah, you've brought me the mist powder promised me! Thank you. This will bring me a nice fortune. Here, now, here's the portion I prmoised Bran. Now, have you heard of [Roane Maidens]?

M68.offer: The blasted cart has broken, I knew something would go wrong on my [way to Fort Veldon].
M68.accept_line: Fetch it for me and I shall reward ye handsomely. [Step #2]Find Hrrgyf and the book, The Yellow Canary.
M68.finish: Take this note with ya so ya don't have to explain wha' happened here.
giver_turnins: I must tell ya I'm glad I lefy me money purse behind in Dvalin. Go see [my man Brok] there.

Vik.way to Fort Veldon: Ja! Fort Veldon! On my way from Vasudheim. Bu' me and my men were attacked by [marauding wild animals]!
Vik.marauding wild animals: You'd never believe it if I told ya! Huge creatures they were. [Big jaws I tell ya].
Vik.Big jaws I tell ya: Never seen nothin' like it in my life. Was [the biggest cat] I've seen in my whole life, not to mention it scared off all my men.
Vik.the biggest cat: Oh ya, made a funny sound it sure did, sounded like [hrrrrrgyyf] it did. Had a friend too, mean old Spat!
Vik.hrrrrrgyyf: What's that you say? Oh ya! The blasted beast ran off and took my favorite book, [The Yellow Canary].
Vik.Step #2: Well well, lookie what you brought me! Ye done well and I thannk thee!
Vik.my man Brok: Take this note with ya so ya don't have to explain wha' happened here.

M69.offer: Quirk was always getting himslef into trouble or causing trouble. They nearly [ran me out of town]!
M69.accept_line: You see, Quirk was a huldu. He is smarter than most of those silly creatures outside the village, but still a huldu. He helped me in [quite a few tasks], but others didn't like him around because he like to cause a little trouble.
M69.finish: Wonderful! Now I can begin work on my newly designed forge. You have done a great job my friend.

Hilde.ran me out of town: You know, it used to be that people around here were pretty much open to anything and anyone until rumors came in about the Blodfelag.
Hilde.quite a few tasks: He helped me in crafting armor and weapons as well as planning out the design I had for a [new forge].
Hilde.new forge: The other towns people tried to run us out of town, but at the time I didn't want to [lose my job] so I told Quirk he should leave.
Hilde.lose my job: The little bugger stole my plans and took off with them. Last I saw he was heading back towards the huldu camp. Haven't seen him since. Please find him and try to get my plans back.

M75.offer: Hail. You look well. These are tense times for the guards. We have noticed more shadows in the surrounding area lately. We believe something or someone is [getting ready to attack].
M75.accept_line: This is just the proof I needed. Great job! I am going to go and give this to Bork so he can show it to the council. Thank you again for the excellent work.

Agnor Crusher.getting ready to attack: Bork says I am seeing things but I think there is a small creature taking notes on us along the river. Maybe you could go and [investigate] for me.

H76.offer: I have not trained you long, but already you are my favored student. You are also one of my best. Are you familiar with the [dead oak among the trees] that circle the pond deep in the forest behind Tir na mBeo?

Trainer.dead oak among the trees: It has been the center of songs for years. It is dead, but still grows. Lately, a creature known as Mad Sprite has appeared around the tree. He circles it non-stop from mid-night to mid-day reciting [nonsensical phrases].
Trainer.nonsensical phrases: The elders of our class, and the others that follow our Path believe the Map Sprite is an oracle of sorts. An insane one, perhaps, but his message must be [discovered]. Speak with this Map Sprite, and see what you can glean from him.

M77.accept_line: There is a smith to the west that I know well. I have asked him if he could make a special item for you. He says he is [willing].
M77.finish: Aye, he goes by the name of Lilib. Seek him out and tell him I sent you.

Alomali.willing: Aye, he goes by the name of Lilib. Seek him out and tell him I sent you.

The Spirit of the unspoken.riddle: The shadow of life passes us, as does the passage of time. When day turns to darkness, time fades into eternity. What then becomes of life?

npc_lines.The Spirit of the unspoken: You seek the unspoken list! We have seen your venture into the darkness, and kow that which keeps my brethren from peace. I shall read the list only should you speak unto me the answer to a [riddle]. The shadow of life passes us, as does the passage of time. When day turns to darkness, time fades into eternity. What then becomes of life? Your words echo within the ears of my brethren, <Player>! Remember what you have learned and do not speak unto others what you hear this day. Vislun, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>

M96.accept_line: Aye, the evil lay not far from the main road. Look in the mountains to the west soon after day turns to night. Wield your house gift now and go seek the skeletons, or [tell me] if you need a new one.
M96.finish: You have done well. Here is the reward I have promised you! Fare-thee-well in the rest of your travels.
giver_turnins: You have returned to us, and in good order! Have you brought with you the dust of a dwarven skeleton?

Frimeth.is needed: A [scourge] has presented itself at a location not far from here.
Frimeth.scourge: Aye! Tis a place where many of my kind have met their deaths... [A hole] in the bottom the earth that sucks the last bit of life from all dwarves who fall dead upon its barren ground.
Frimeth.A hole: Beware [the hole's power], for should you fall dead yourself you may rise up as one of it's minions.
Frimeth.the hole's power: I could tap this power for you and [fashion an item] of great use. That is if you are brave enough to meet this terror.
Frimeth.fashion an item: Aye! If you could bring me [dust] from one of the [dwarven skeletons] which walks there, I will create it for you.
Frimeth.dwarven skeletons: This dust can only be taken while you wield the gift [bestowed] to you by your house.
Frimeth.tell me: Perhaps you should check your backpack. I think I see your house gift sticking out of the top of it.

M98.offer: You have learned much since I spoke to you last.

Aegan.information and assistance: I have done what I can from here, would you care to further [help my friend]?
Aegan.help my friend: Take this with you and seek out Kell in Fort [Veldon]. You must hurry!

Kell.terrible upsets: Each evening, as dark appraoches, you can see a clan of what seems to be walking bears [coming from the hills] and laying waste to the area.
Kell.coming from the hills: They [scare and steal] any livestock our past dark as well as many of our goods. We can 't seem to get anyone to trade with us or to stay in the area for long.
Kell.Sydney: Sydney can be found in guard tower up on the hill. You should hurry.

Sydney.about bears: They are clans of bear-men, known as the vendo. They [come from the hills] with little else in mind but terrorizing innocents. Be wary, and keep a good lookout.
Sydney.come from the hills: I have watched as night falls how the hills to the west come alive with motion. Please make haste and be careful. There are many different ones out there, but thou must seek [a specific one].
Sydney.a specific one: Seek out the Vendo Bone-Collectors in the surrounding hills. Bring back to me anything you may be able to obtain from them.
Sydney.translate what it says: I only know of one person who could translate such runes. I, however, don?t know where to [find Virge].
Sydney.find Virge: Please find Virge and have him translate. He is the only one who can help solve this riddle now.
Sydney.Rathis: Rathis must be important. Possible a leader. That should be our target.

Virge.keep this: I shall try and translate these runes the best I can and send you back with it.

npc_lines.Kell: I see you have spoken to Aegan. I'm glad you have come, we are having some [terrible upsets] here lately. Each evening, as dark appraoches, you can see a clan of what seems to be walking bears [coming from the hills] and laying waste to the area. They [scare and steal] any livestock our past dark as well as many of our goods. We can 't seem to get anyone to trade with us or to stay in the area for long. Perhaps [Sydney] can tell you more. Sydney can be found in guard tower up on the hill. You should hurry.
npc_lines.Sydney: There have been many rumors throughout my lifetime [about bears] threatening our homelands. I never thought I would see it with my own eyes. They are clans of bear-men, known as the vendo. They [come from the hills] with little else in mind but terrorizing innocents. Be wary, and keep a good lookout. I have watched as night falls how the hills to the west come alive with motion. Please make haste and be careful. There are many different ones out there, but thou must seek [a specific one]. Seek out the Vendo Bone-Collectors in the surrounding hills. Bring back to me anything you may be able to obtain from them. Hmm, it appears there is writing upon these skins. However I cannot [translate what it says]. I only know of one person who could translate such runes. I, however, don?t know where to [find Virge]. Please find Virge and have him translate. He is the only one who can help solve this riddle now. You have returned! I feel you are just in time, the evening comes quickly. All it says is [Rathis]... Rathis must be important. Possible a leader. That should be our target.
npc_lines.Virge: Well hello stranger. What is this you give me? You have gotten this from a fabled vendo! I have nothing like this in my lifetime. Tis quite amazing I tell you. May I [keep this]? I shall try and translate these runes the best I can and send you back with it.
npc_lines.Rathis: You have defeated me, but you shall never defeat the vendo! Do not think you have won!

Sentry Litenberg.a branch: Well then, I know where you need to search. Go to the western shore of the big lake in West Svealand. The lone willow you seek can be found there, just south of Vindsaul Faste. You must take the branch to Eirik of Audliten. Only he can work that wood.

npc_lines.Sentry Litenberg: Ah, do you search these woods for the Lone Weeping Willow? Several seek this tree for it's branches. Do you seek [a branch] from this willow? Well then, I know where you need to search. Go to the western shore of the big lake in West Svealand. The lone willow you seek can be found there, just south of Vindsaul Faste. You must take the branch to Eirik of Audliten. Only he can work that wood.
npc_lines.Eirik: Give me the branch, I can work it into a staff. This is a fine branch. Here, I have fashioned you a staff.

M102.offer: Hail! I have a small problem. A niece of mine, a pleasant child, is accused of [attacking travelers] on the road at night!
M102.accept_line: They won't let you speak to her for long, though, so speak with Sentry Litenberg.

Sarry.attacking travelers: Aye! I haven't had time to talk to her; the guards took her away. Perhaps you could [speak with Sentry Litenberg], at Dvalin, and see what needs to be done to free her. I'm not sure she's there yet; the escorts came for her.

Sentry Litenberg.wish her to live: Fine. You prove she not kill travelers at night, she go free. Have 'til morning, or she die here in tower. Speak with her, if you haven't already. If she not here, she on road to here.

npc_lines.Sentry Litenberg: Sarry send you? Kobold Helen to die in morning. You [wish her to live]? Fine. You prove she not kill travelers at night, she go free. Have 'til morning, or she die here in tower. Speak with her, if you haven't already. If she not here, she on road to here.
npc_lines.The Kobold Helen: Did my Uncle Sarry send you? Can you prove it wasn't me? They say she is a twin to me! Aye, she wanders between the two roads to the south, a little ways off at night. Find her, and bring something of her to my guards to free me. Please hurry! You haven't much time! My thanks! Now I am free!
npc_lines.The Escort Sentry: Ah. You do well. You prove Kobold Helen innocent. This cloth belong to old witch! I recognize it. You kill dirge that attack travelers. You take this. Now, go speak with Kobold Helen. She want to thank you. Then we escort her home.

M106.offer: Hail! It is good you have returned. I have meditated long on what action we must take to secure the Rod of Mimir. Before we can journey into the depths of the realm, we must [learn] more of the rod and what obstacles may lay in our path.

Inaksha.learn: I know of a young shaman. Corath, I believe is his name. He knows much of the thul. Perhaps he could enlighten us on what we should expect. He was last seen [adventuring] within the western part of Svealand. Seek him out and inquire about the rod and the Thul.

M108.offer: Have you [found] truth in my visions?

Inaksha.found: I knew you were the proper choice for this task. The Thul and the Rod of Mimir you say? Perhaps this is what I have seen in my visions! It is said in myth that the Thul were the great seekers of wisdom and the purest of heart and spirit. I must [meditate] on this and decide on where next to direct your focus. I thank you for your service!

M111.offer: Well met, <Player>. Our Lady Eir has giving me [visions] that you would come. The goddess has delivered you to us.
M111.accept_line: Oh thank you! We are truly blessed today. Perhaps you will find something of value that you can use to champion the lands of Midgard. Let me see if I can remember how to [find the creature] from my visions.
M111.finish: The foul stench of the creature is enough to almost guide you there but you may find it by heading down the road and walking on the ridge across from the Svartalf village. May Thor himself smile on your journey.

Saydyn.visions: I have seen visions of a vile creature that has turned against the gods themselves. I could only watch, helpless, as it captured lone travelers and changed them into the [walking dead].
Saydyn.walking dead: If he is not stopped, he will gather an army of dead and begin launching attacks on the cities of our fair lands. Lady Eir has called upon you to help us. Will you [answer her call]?
Saydyn.find the creature: The foul stench of the creature is enough to almost guide you there but you may find it by heading down the road and walking on the ridge across from the Svartalf village. May Thor himself smile on your journey.

M114.offer: Unjust! Yes, I have been wronged! I shall not rest, nay, I [can't rest]!

Rollo.can't rest: Surely, the smith told you? My story is one [passed down] the line of dwarven smiths. The story of how I, Rollo, failed my master, <Player>.
Rollo.passed down: Aye, it is passed down. <Player> left me to care for items he had forged or helped create for use by all Dwarves. I failed! Ugnof and his men heard of this changeable item and [stole it].
Rollo.stole it: Aye, stole it. Killed me. For 300 years, the spawn of Ugnof have been carrying the <Player> item. For 300 years I have wandered these hills cursing his name! I shall not rest until someone can [retrieve the <Player> item].
Rollo.retrieve the <Player> item: Aye, fare well, then, seek out Ugnof Toestubber in the lands named Western Svealand (You will find Ugnof walking outside the perimeter of Hugginfel with a Blodfeleg [Thralldriver] and a Blodfeleg Warhound, both will join in the fight.) Return with <Player> to Hilde, in Haggerfel, and my soul shall rest!

M115.offer: Is it true you are a [protector] of Midgard?
M115.accept_line: One rainy night, a wild man came out of the lands directly behind our tent. He kept babbling about evil spectres and weird mages summoning creatures for the night. I thought he had lost his mind until the same thing happened a [few nights] later.
M115.finish: I would start by looking in the forest where the travelers came from. You might find something off in that direction. Be wary my friend. We wouldn't want to have to go hunting for you as well. [Step #1] Travel deep into the forest and find Ulga. To find Ulga, from Aylarn (in front of lean-to) run west, then you'll see the tower and the camp of Bloodfellags. At the camp take the path and head a bit northwest (maybe a bit more north than west) then we saw her wandering around. *Alternate directions: Go to Audliten, go north across the bridge and take a left at the crossroad. Follow that trail a ways until you get to the top of the hill where there is another crossroad. Take a left (If you go right, you will end up at the West Gate). Follow the path until the next crossroad. There are 2 stumps, one on the south side of the path and one on the north side. If you stand next to the one on the south side and point yourself due South, go forward and you will run into a tree. Just past that tree is where I saw her each time. I hope this helps reduce some of your search time. Be careful, there are also some wolfpacks running around there too. Ulga conned blue at lvl 15 Approximate Loc sights (she does roam): 34560,21480 32525, 23114 36448, 22846 37500, 19300 34600, 22300 Kill Ulga, she conned blue to a level 15. She did attack, did not have to provoke her.

Aylarn.protector: I have heard rumors of an evil creature that wears a magical cloak. Perhaps you would like me to [share the tale] I heard.
Aylarn.few nights: A young dwarf came stumbling out of the brush and cried for hours. He said he was the son of Arik of Haggerfel. He said he was only 14 winters old and had become [lost].
Aylarn.lost: He said a strange robed creature that called herself Ulga, had led him into the forest in promise of adventure and [cast some magic] on him. He said he wandered the forest for the last two nights.
Aylarn.cast some magic: I did not have the heart to explain to him what had happened. If there is a creature stealing life wandering about the forest, then someone should put an end to that. Don't you think?

M119.offer: Greetings fellow adventurer. Would you care to hear a [tale]?
M119.accept_line: I'm glad to hear you're up for a challenge, no matter how fantastical the story is. You can find <Player> to the southwest of here, along with her kinsmen. What they are in search of, though, I do not know. Good luck adventurer!

Sentry Dwarn.tale: Wonderful, let me tell you of [<Player>], the pious Saracen.
Sentry Dwarn.<Player>: Aye, <Player>, never a more pious woman was to be had here in Midgard. She was a slave here, brought back from a raid on a settlement in northern Albion. She never complained about her plight, but she continuously [prayed].
Sentry Dwarn.prayed: She prayed several times a day to her God. When the fever struck her, she prayed even harder, asking him to [preserve her piety]. He granted her wish.
Sentry Dwarn.preserve her piety: It was said that her God took part of her soul and imbued it within a [tunic] she had been making.
Sentry Dwarn.tunic: This tunic, once given her spirit, danced away, out into the forest and was never seen again. I, for one, believe that no such thing happened, but if you're up for some [adventure], I can tell you where most think it is.

M121.offer: The lady Amora here in Fort Atla has been here for several weeks because she is [unable] to travel.

Trainer.ill: They have been [staying] in one of the homes here in town to keep the poor girl warm. Please help them, they are in great need.

Amora.Magnild: Yes, my poor darling Magnild was bitten by a [water snake] while traveling into town. Unfortunately, the bite has not healed and she is not feeling very well at all.
Amora.water snake: Oh, it seems the venom of the snake was very powerful. I have sent word to t he healer and she has told me she needs five vials of [snake venom] to cure the child.
Amora.snake venom: I do not feel right leaving Magnild [here alone] this ill, so I fear I can't hunt the snakes myself.
Amora.here alone: Please go outside the city and [collect] the five vials of venom and take them to Kari, the healer.
Amora.collect: I am indebted to you always if you do the for me.

Kari.work: You have aided in this situation beyond what is expected. I thnk you.

npc_lines.Amora: Be still Magnild, all will be alright soon and you will be well once again. Hello stranger, may I ask your <Player>? It is a pleasure to meet you. I am so glad you have come to aid me and [Magnild]. Yes, my poor darling Magnild was bitten by a [water snake] while traveling into town. Unfortunately, the bite has not healed and she is not feeling very well at all. Oh, it seems the venom of the snake was very powerful. I have sent word to t he healer and she has told me she needs five vials of [snake venom] to cure the child. I do not feel right leaving Magnild [here alone] this ill, so I fear I can't hunt the snakes myself. Please go outside the city and [collect] the five vials of venom and take them to Kari, the healer. I am indebted to you always if you do the for me.
npc_lines.Kari: Ahh, you look as if you have been having a rough time. Have you brought me the vials of snake venom? I shall begin [work] at once in making the potion to cure the sick girl, hopefully all my training will not fail me. You have aided in this situation beyond what is expected. I thnk you.

M129.accept_line: Well let's see here. I think I may have something that you can do for me. Let me check my [scrolls].
M129.finish: Great job! Here are a few coins as a reward. Return a bit later and I may have more work for you. I have to update my scrolls now.

Bork.looking for something: Hmmm, I may have some work for you. Would you be [interested] in doing a little hunting for me?
Bork.scrolls: Ok here is a tough one. A savage lynx stole a baby from her crib yesterday. Hunt one of these foul creatures down and slay it, then return. Savage lynx are directly West of the Healer hut, go up and over the hill, to a clearing that is surrounded by trees, you should find plenty of them there. [Step #1] Hunt a savage lynx and slay it. [Step #2] Return to Bork Another variant:
Bork.Step #2: Hello again. Are you [interested] in more work already?
Bork.interested: Well let's see here. I think I may have something that you can do for me. Let me check my [scrolls].

M134.offer: Ah, you startled me! Are you here because of [Krrrck]?
M134.accept_line: You can find Krrrck living in Skona Ravine along with the other wild creatures. It is said the sadness that penetrates his heart will never be eased until he returns to his goddess and is avenged. Find him and release his soul. He has recently been seen to the west and south of the circle of stones in Skona Ravine.

Arnleif.Krrrck: Ah such a sad tale. Originally, Krrrck was a priest of <Player>, helping oyung Hunters learn the ways of the woods, as well as tutoring villagers on how to survive the harsh winters. His name was [Erik].
Arnleif.Erik: Erik was very improtant to <Player>, and she rewarded him well for his services. Loki, ever the mischief-maker, decided to trick <Player> and turned her friendly priest into a [frog].
Arnleif.frog: A large troll indeed! When the Goddess came to find Erik, all she found in his temple was this large frog. Not knowing what had happened to Erik, <Player> went in [search] of him.
Arnleif.search: She searched high and low for him, coming back to his temple twice a day to see if he had returned. The only one waiting for her was the [miserable], lonely frog.
Arnleif.miserable: <Player>, still unhappy with the disappearance of her priest, took the frog to [Skona Ravine] where he could be with other wildlife.
Arnleif.Skona Ravine: Skona Ravine and a wonderous place, filled with many creatures and various healing plants. It is said that Erik wishes to be released from his [imprisonment] and rejoined with his goddess, <Player>.

M137.offer: Good day to you. I have heard stories of your travels being told at some of the tables at our local inn. I wish someone like you were around during [last winter].
M137.accept_line: Oh thank you! I will tell you what I know. The creature that robbed me kept repeating the same words over and over. It said swift as swift may be, you can catch me. I believe I was near the boundary gates but I can't be for sure. I will reward you greatly for my ring if you manage to find it. Journey well and good luck.
M137.finish: Oh thank you so much. I am so happy. Thank you! Thank you! Oh. Oh but wait. Here, you should keep it. You've gone through so much to get it. I've learned it's not the most important thing to me at all.
giver_turnins: Oh, you have returned! Do you have my ring? I will pay you 40 silver for it. Just give it to me.

Sugnhild.last winter: Last winter was indeed a sad one for me. I lost my [loved one] and also the ring that he gave me in case something might befall him.
Sugnhild.loved one: Gudlor is the town leader, Perhaps you should see him sometime.
Sugnhild.ring: I wish I could have my ring again. [Maybe] you could go and get it for me.

npc_lines.Swift: Get away from me! I don't have any stupid ring. Leave me alone.

M138.offer: You are here just in time! I just have gotten a report that the svartalf have send [assassins] to slay Saydyn, our town healer. You must stop then before they can do that.

npc_lines.Saydyn: Thank the gods you were around to save me. I would shudder to think what may have happened if you were not there. Perhaps this gift may aid you in protecting other people as well.

M139.offer: Greetings, are you [worthy of the hunt]?
M139.accept_line: You are doing well! Continue to pass me the bear claws!
M139.finish: You have proven yourself well youngster! I hope the coin serves you well.

Aegan.worthy of the hunt: Oh ho! Another bright young come to help Midgard fend off her enemies, eh? Wonderful, that's what I say! Wonderful! With the rise of the [Albion] and [Hibernia] armies,Midgard will need all the she can get!
Aegan.Hibernia: I have spent a great deal of my life hunting the [maulers] of this region
Aegan.maulers: Bring me the claws of a mauler cub and I shall [reward] you

H152.offer: Forgive me if my crying bothered you. It's hard to be anything but sad after what i saw the other day. Such [horrible thing] I've seen lately.
H152.accept_line: It is good to see you have returned, <Player>. I was worried that the task I asked of you was too great. Were you able to free my beloved Osier? I shall need some proof from you.
H152.finish: This was the ring he was going to give me that night. I shall treasure it always, knowing he was going to ask me to marry him. I had forgotten about this necklace until just now. The silly man was so handsome, but he didn't think it. He bought this 'spectral' necklace, as he called it, to make himself more attractive to me. I'd like you to have it with my gratitude for freeing Osier from that torture. I hope it serves you well.
giver_turnins: Oh, this is his satchel. I made this for him shortly after we first met. Osier had this with him when they took him. I forget what he had inside it at the time. Let me look.

Odharnait.horrible thing: Have you ever seen the harvest rituals that are performed in some areas around here? Most of them are simple, thanking the earth and the goddess for this year's bounty and ensuring there will be a plentiful harvest next year. But in some places like Shannon Estuary, where I just came from, they have turned to the ancient ways. They have brought back [the wickerman] sacrifice!
Odharnait.the wickerman: Oh, it is awful! They take people and put them into a large wicker cage shaped like a man. When everyone is inside, they light it on fire! Oh, those poor souls, trapped in there, sacrificed to next year's harvest. I recently witnessed one of these rituals and I fled here, since it brought back such [sad memories].
Odharnait.sad memories: About 10 years ago, my beloved Osier and I were visiting Shannon Estuary around the time of the harvest. The celebrations got out of hand, and the wickerman was raised. Osier was swept up in the masses and thrown into the wickerman. I watched in horror as he was burned with the others, a sacrifice to the mother earth and the harvest. I fled here to Silvermine Mountains and have stayed here. I haven't [left here] until recently.
Odharnait.left here: I traveled down to Shannon Estuary to visit Osier's relatives. While i was there, I went for a short walk one night. I couldn't believe my eyes - a spectral presence wandered past me and stopped. It was shaped like a wickerman, and burning, but when it looked at me, its eyes were human. I realized then who it was - my beloved Osier. He lunged at me and I fled in horror, even though I could feel he [needed something] from me.
Odharnait.needed something: I think he recognized me too. I think he wanted me to free him from that ghastly existance he has been forced into. But, I am too full of sorrow and fear to do anything. I need [someone fearless] to help me.
Odharnait.someone fearless: I think you are brave indeed, <Player>, to agree to help me with this. My whole way back up here I thought about how Osier could be freed and I think I [have a plan].
Odharnait.have a plan: I think if you were able to douse the flames that consume Osier, it would free him from this world. But ordinary water will not quench those spectral flames and no ordinary container can carry that water. You must make [an enchanted one].
Odharnait.an enchanted one: After some research, I have found that the bladder of a large red wolfhound, when enchanted, will hold the magical water you require. Seek out these [creatures] in Lough Gur or Lough Derg. When you have a bladder, take it to Uistean in Connla for more help.

npc_lines.Uisetan: Hrmph, you expect me, a noble Lurikeen, to talk to the likes of you? I can't believe a Firbolg like you would even think of trying. If you're in such a desperate need for an enchanter, go see that Firbolg Kiana in Ardee in Connacht. Now, be off!
npc_lines.Kiana: So, Uistean wouldn't help you? He's a terrible snob. I shall enchant it nicely for you. I will also tell you where to get the magical water you will need. There is your enchanted bladder. Now to fill it and quench the fires that consume Osier, you must seek out the dew sheeries. The best place to find them is Lough Derg, although I have seen some in Lough Gur. When you kill the dew sheerie, the enchanted bladder will draw the water out of the sheerie and into itself. Once it is filled, wait until nightfall then seek out Osier in Shannon Estuary. Give him the bladder and it should quench the flames. Be warned, he will most likely attack you, for he has no knowledge of good any more. He may also call for the other spectral wickermen to help him in this mission. When you have freed him, return to Odharnait.
npc_lines.Osier: Free me...please...free me from the flames! Oh they burn! They burn...please... Oh thank you...aahh...I shall be free now...thank you...take this to my sweet Odharnait...please...

M153.offer: You seem to be string enough to take on a real monster. A bounty issued for a [creature] that is terrorizing the lake near Galplen. Perhaps you have heard of it?
M153.accept_line: Well you are a brave soul. The creature can be found in the darkest depths of the Myrkwood lake. Good fortune on your jouirney and I really hope to see you again, my friend.
M153.finish: I have heard that Raker, the town enchanter, has been looking for one. Perhaps he can do something with it. You should do talk with him.
giver_turnins: You have returned. Amazing! Did you bring anything of Njessi back?
The god themselves must be watching you! You have brought back the creatures head. Here is your reward. I know of something you can do with [this head].

Bork.creature: Well here is all I know. It seems to many of the more adventurous sort of the land have called this creature, [Njessi].
Bork.Njessi: I agree that's a very strange name for a monster but I did not choose it. The [reward] for slaying thjis foul beast is quite large. That is good for [many have perished] trying to collect it.
Bork.many have perished: Would you be interested in the [bounty]?
Bork.bounty: The bounty is 70 silver for the head of the [creature]. What do you think?
Bork.this head: I have heard that Raker, the town enchanter, has been looking for one. Perhaps he can do something with it. You should do talk with him.

Gord.not: Now these are very powerful staffs. You will be expected to uphold the traditions of all the Spiritmasters that have come before you. I will give you one of the staffs that I have already prepared. That way you din't have to wait.

npc_lines.Raker: Greetings. Bork said you miught be coming by. I have heard tales of your travels as word spreads quickly around these parts. Please give me the skull so I can take a look at it. I have an interesting idea. I believe that a magic staff can be crafted by driving slivers of skull bone deep into hardened wood. Only Gord in Galplen could make one of those. You must journey there and meet with him. He will be able to help you.
npc_lines.Gord: I can make a staff that you will be able to use. The head is starting to rot though so I must start now. Would you like me to [make one] or [not]? Now these are very powerful staffs. You will be expected to uphold the traditions of all the Spiritmasters that have come before you. I will give you one of the staffs that I have already prepared. That way you din't have to wait. Here is your staff. Now I expect you to spread the word and tell others that I can create these staffs. Just be sure and tell your friends to bring one of the Njessi heads so I can craft a new staff for the next person. May Hel guide your hand in battle.

M164.offer: Hail, the town needs your help. I have received word from our spies that the Blodfelag are planning to attack. We must stop them before they do. Do you think you have the strength of [character] to help us?
M164.accept_line: Ahh, good! Perhaps this may not be our darkest day afterall. The Blodfelag have a camp down the road past the Svartalf village where they plan to attack from. You must go to that camp and find their Captain, a man called [Thegn Aki]. He is an infamous killer who wil show no mercy to you or any that aid you. I suggest you gather as many men as you can before you attack his camp.
M164.finish: Go gather your forces and quit wasting time! There will be time to worry about Redhands later. May the gods have mercy on us if you fail.

Gudlor.Thegn Aki: It is said he wears a special helm, crafted for his sire, the great [General Aki]. I am sure it is magical however I am not quite sure its purpose.
Gudlor.General Aki: General Aki was said to be a great leader among men. Unfortunately, he only allowed men in his ranks. He was a friend of [Konung], Botolf's father. General Aki was reumored to be able to use magic as well, only his dead enemies knew just how much though.
Gudlor.Konung: Go gather your forces and quit wasting time! There will be time to worry about Redhands later. May the gods have mercy on us if you fail.

A172.offer: Welcome young one! It is good that you have decided to join the forces of Albion as this is a dark time for its people. Our borders are in need of [adventurers] such as you.
A172.accept_line: Speak to Olorustos. He will instruct you further.

Trainer.adventurers: Aye! Your services are needed now! If you are [interested] and adventure is what you seek.

Olorustos.a message: Yes! There is a guardian by the name of Aron. He stands on eternal watch against those who would wish to steal our treasured artifacts. It is to him you must deliver this message. He stands along the riverbanks just west of the road. Hurry to him!

npc_lines.Olorustos: You have been chosen to assist me in delivering [a message]. I'm sure it will be worth your time. Yes! There is a guardian by the name of Aron. He stands on eternal watch against those who would wish to steal our treasured artifacts. It is to him you must deliver this message. He stands along the riverbanks just west of the road. Hurry to him!
npc_lines.The Guardian Aron: Hail citizen! How can this guardian assist you? Ah! It appears that we are about to be attacked! I would think these thieves would tire of their losses. So be it! If you wish to join in the defense of Avalon, I will not stand in your way! Guards!!! To me!!!

M173.offer: Hail Spiritmaster! Many great adventures await you, but you must first become aware of our past. [Anrid], a powerful Spiritmaster has decided to lead you along this path. Perhaps with her teaching and your adventurous spirit, the Grenlock clan can once again be united!
M173.accept_line: I am glad to see you follow the path of the House of Hel! Anrid can be found at a tavern near the north gate of this city. Good hourney to you Spiritmaster!

Anrid.a tale: Many hundreds of years ago there was a great clan of Norsemen in the northland of Midgard. They were known as the Grenlock clan, and of them was a great chieftain who strove for peace and kinship among the people. the great man, chieftain Svan Alfevsin lived and worked among his people and was greatly respected. It seems that [history] is never kind to the good hearted, like Svan Alfevson.
Anrid.history: A great tragedy befell the northlands and their king. An unnatural winter befell the land of the north, known as Urfenlong, freezing the land and water tributaries solid. Being that the Grenlock clan had always lived in a harsh climate they prepared each year with grains and livestock for a harsh winter. However, nothing could have prepared them for the [Urfenlong].
Anrid.Urfenlong: In the third year of the Urfenlong, the land and the seasons were locked in a frozen icy grip. Svan Alfevson called upon his four sons and told them to begin gathering the northland armies and supplies still left. The old king wished for his sons to move the armies and peoples of the Grenlock southward to safety, away from the impending doom of the ice. Great ice sheets moved like living things in the far north, devouring everything in their path and the farthest points of civilization had already succumbed to [the ice].
Anrid.the ice: As the ice moved closer and closer to Svergren Keep, the old king met with his sons one last time. Svan removed his own armor and divided it among his sons keeping only his helmet. Next the king took the Grenlock Crest, the family seal from upon the Keep's wall and with the blade of his battleaxe broke the seal into five pieces. Once again Svan divided the pieces of the crest, just as he did his own armor, and gave a piece to each of his four sons and [kept a piece] for himself.
Anrid.kept a piece: Svan's intention was that one-day, after the terrible unyielding winter that he and his sons would once again reunite and bring the Grenlock clan back together. Several says after Svan's sons left the northland, Svergird's Keep and its ancient stone walls were swept away by the white tide of ice and snow. The terrible storm took the old king with it, and all which remained of the northland. Svan's four sons, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, and Div marched southward, tearing through [unknown territory].
Anrid.unknown territory: They passed through Odin's Gate and into the untamed lands continuing to push southward, where they hoped the storm could not reach. The brothers hoped that the mountains of Odin's Gate would hold back the sheets of traveling ice, yet they knew it was not safe to stay that far north. The people of the northland continued to push forward for two years, never settling, always living in fear of what could come over the mountains and sweep them away. A year later due to starvation and exhaustion, the brothers stopped the clan and settled near the sea, [nestled safely] in the mountains near what is now Vasudheim.
Anrid.nestled safely: They hoped that the mountains would stop any invading force, including the elements. It just so happens that the brothers settled in the area that is known today as Jordheim. After several more years the clan had settled in their new home. The brothers once again gathered armies from the north. The intention was for the four of them to split up in the four directions, north, east, south, and west, and explore the new territory they would call home. [Siv was the first] of the brothers to push out of their new home and travel westward.
Anrid.Siv was the first: Siv, the youngest of the brothers, put together a small following of an army and led them westward to that shore. Siv and his men settled in the area that is now known as East Svealand. It was here that his followers settled a small township and continued to explore the area in which they perceived to call home. Siv continued to live in East Svealand to the [end of his days] in peace.
Anrid.end of his days: It is rumored that his [spirit still walks] the lands which he inhabited.
Anrid.spirit still walks: You would be wise to seek Siv out and prove this rumor true!
Anrid.ready to continue: As you know Siv had three more brothers. The second brother <Player> decided since Siv was making new settlements outside of their new home that he would patrol the land. <Player>'s goal was to protect all those who survived the journey from the northland. <Player> made friends with many of the creatures that lived in the surrounding areas. It was his goal to make pacts with these creatures so that the land would stay [safe] for all those that lived there, both human and creature.
Anrid.safe: <Player> was very successful in this attempt and many aggressions were worked through. Therefore many lived in peace during his lifetime. He lived a very long time, just as his brother Siv. His spirit resides on this plane in the forests of Myrkwood among his companions, the creatures of those forests. He may have information that will help you upon this journey. He can be found among the creatures of [Myrkwood].
Anrid.Myrkwood: Seek out <Player>'s Spirit! Return to me when you have finished.
Anrid.fulfill the wish: The crest pieces can only be merged in the fires of a [forge within Muspelheim]. It is our hopes that should be this accomplished, Svan Alfevson will hear our calling and deliver unto us the final piece.
Anrid.forge within Muspelheim: Take these four pieces and seek out the dverge fire-eaters within Muspelheim. They may distrust you at first, but I am told they hate the fire giants that also walk within the fire realm. If you are able to make into the forge of five anvils, deliver all four piece to one named Sinyr. He will do his best to fashion the Grenlock [crest pieces] into one.
Anrid.crest pieces: If the last of the five piece are delivered unto you, Sinyr will make the crest while once more. I look forward to your return! You champion our cause, and we are honored you have taken on this task. Fare thee well!

Many hundreds of years ago there was a great clan of Norsemen in the northland of Midgard. They were known as the Grenlock clan, and of them was a great chieftain who strove for peace and kinship among the people. the great man, chieftain Svan Alfevsin lived and worked among his people and was greatly respected. It seems that [history] is never kind to the good hearted, like Svan Alfevson. A great tragedy befell the northlands and their king. An unnatural winter befell the land of the north, known as Urfenlong, freezing the land and water tributaries solid. Being that the Grenlock clan had always lived in a harsh climate they prepared each year with grains and livestock for a harsh winter. However, nothing could have prepared them for the [Urfenlong]. In the third year of the Urfenlong, the land and the seasons were locked in a frozen icy grip. Svan Alfevson called upon his four sons and told them to begin gathering the northland armies and supplies still left. The old king wished for his sons to move the armies and peoples of the Grenlock southward to safety, away from the impending doom of the ice. Great ice sheets moved like living things in the far north, devouring everything in their path and the farthest points of civilization had already succumbed to [the ice]. As the ice moved closer and closer to Svergren Keep, the old king met with his sons one last time. Svan removed his own armor and divided it among his sons keeping only his helmet. Next the king took the Grenlock Crest, the family seal from upon the Keep's wall and with the blade of his battleaxe broke the seal into five pieces. Once again Svan divided the pieces of the crest, just as he did his own armor, and gave a piece to each of his four sons and [kept a piece] for himself. Svan's intention was that one-day, after the terrible unyielding winter that he and his sons would once again reunite and bring the Grenlock clan back together. Several says after Svan's sons left the northland, Svergird's Keep and its ancient stone walls were swept away by the white tide of ice and snow. The terrible storm took the old king with it, and all which remained of the northland. Svan's four sons, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, and Div marched southward, tearing through [unknown territory]. They passed through Odin's Gate and into the untamed lands continuing to push southward, where they hoped the storm could not reach. The brothers hoped that the mountains of Odin's Gate would hold back the sheets of traveling ice, yet they knew it was not safe to stay that far north. The people of the northland continued to push forward for two years, never settling, always living in fear of what could come over the mountains and sweep them away. A year later due to starvation and exhaustion, the brothers stopped the clan and settled near the sea, [nestled safely] in the mountains near what is now Vasudheim. They hoped that the mountains would stop any invading force, including the elements. It just so happens that the brothers settled in the area that is known today as Jordheim. After several more years the clan had settled in their new home. The brothers once again gathered armies from the north. The intention was for the four of them to split up in the four directions, north, east, south, and west, and explore the new territory they would call home. [Siv was the first] of the brothers to push out of their new home and travel westward. Siv, the youngest of the brothers, put together a small following of an army and led them westward to that shore. Siv and his men settled in the area that is now known as East Svealand. It was here that his followers settled a small township and continued to explore the area in which they perceived to call home. Siv continued to live in East Svealand to the [end of his days] in peace. It is rumored that his [spirit still walks] the lands which he inhabited. You would be wise to seek Siv out and prove this rumor true! Hail! Are you [ready to continue] along the path to unification? As you know Siv had three more brothers. The second brother <Player> decided since Siv was making new settlements outside of their new home that he would patrol the land. <Player>'s goal was to protect all those who survived the journey from the northland. <Player> made friends with many of the creatures that lived in the surrounding areas. It was his goal to make pacts with these creatures so that the land would stay [safe] for all those that lived there, both human and creature. <Player> was very successful in this attempt and many aggressions were worked through. Therefore many lived in peace during his lifetime. He lived a very long time, just as his brother Siv. His spirit resides on this plane in the forests of Myrkwood among his companions, the creatures of those forests. He may have information that will help you upon this journey. He can be found among the creatures of [Myrkwood]. Seek out <Player>'s Spirit! Return to me when you have finished. I cannot believe I hold all but the last piece of the crest! You have done wonders my friend! We have only to merge the five piece into one and [fulfill the wish] of a fallen king, now kept for hundreds of years. The crest pieces can only be merged in the fires of a [forge within Muspelheim]. It is our hopes that should be this accomplished, Svan Alfevson will hear our calling and deliver unto us the final piece. Take these four pieces and seek out the dverge fire-eaters within Muspelheim. They may distrust you at first, but I am told they hate the fire giants that also walk within the fire realm. If you are able to make into the forge of five anvils, deliver all four piece to one named Sinyr. He will do his best to fashion the Grenlock [crest pieces] into one. If the last of the five piece are delivered unto you, Sinyr will make the crest while once more. I look forward to your return! You champion our cause, and we are honored you have taken on this task. Fare thee well! We have heard of your deeds! Let us see the finished crest! The Grenlock clan us whole once more! you have performed a deed unlike any other within Midgard. Whenever anyone speaks of the Grenlock, may they utter your honored named as well! We bestow upon you this simple item, as nothing we could provide would be a just reward! Thank you!
npc_lines.Sinyr: What have you Kobold? I have little time for games. Oh! A piece of the Grenlock crest! Have you more? You are indeed a great Spiritmaster! You don't have another do you? My word! This is beyond belief!! You are lucky to have come by so many pieces. I may fall dead if you have a fourth! I now see what must be done! Stand aside! I must forge anew this ancient crest! There! I still cannot believe that the crest is whole once more. This day shall forever be spoken by the Dverge!
npc_lines.The Svan Alfevson: You have done well in returning that which is mine! For your tireless effort in fulfilling my ancient request, I bestow upon your smith the final piece of the Grenlock Crest! Use it wisely or you shall feel my wrath!

The elder sveawolf.herbs: These herbs will not work on your kind in case you are wondering. Take them and you will find her on the hard traveling path that leads from your haunted town. She is near the pointed ears den. Approach her slowly. She is wounded and will strike out at you if she doesn't know your scent. Allow her to smell my scent on you, then feed her the herbs. Make sure she leaves the area. Then return here so we may speak again. Go now and may the goddess light your path.

npc_lines.The elder sveawolf: First rub your hands through my fur to take up my scent and take these [herbs]. These herbs will not work on your kind in case you are wondering. Take them and you will find her on the hard traveling path that leads from your haunted town. She is near the pointed ears den. Approach her slowly. She is wounded and will strike out at you if she doesn't know your scent. Allow her to smell my scent on you, then feed her the herbs. Make sure she leaves the area. Then return here so we may speak again. Go now and may the goddess light your path. Ah you have returned. Good work. Perhaps this will be a step forward between our two clans. May the goddess shine favorably on you.

M189.offer: Greetings friend. Have you heard the news? My wife is due very soon. I am so happy. I am hoping for a wonderful baby girl but I will be happy with just a healthy baby. I have had to give up my studies and [stay home] to watch over my wife.
M189.accept_line: I guess they were friends until they bought my book. I saw them get angry and they started fighting. They almost crushed me by accident as they [rolled around] the floor. Finally, they tore my poor book in half.
M189.finish: The crown sounds like it could be a worthy prize for someone strong enough to go get it. If I were you, I would go to the stables and get a horse. You can reach Galplen much faster if you ride. Aki should be selling his wares somewhere around town. Talk to him about it.
giver_turnins: Wait! I have an idea.

If you can get the book back from the trolls maybe you can seel her the book. I am sure she will pay quite a few coins for it. It seemed really important to her. I don't understand why anyone would want to study the [werewolves] anyway.

Darrius.stay home: I have even had to sell some of my most treasured objects to gather money so I will be able to support my family. I am almost saddened that I may never get to journey back to Galplen in search of the crown I [read] about.
Darrius.read: Aye, I had this old book and I had managed to translate some of it. It told a story about werewolves and how they came from a far away land to our shores and settled down in the fort of Askheim, in Myrkwood. It also mentioned the leader of the werewolves, a Baron Falwar, has a mystical crown. The crown has been passed down from werewolf leader to leader. At least I managed to earn a few coin from the sale of the book. I [sold it] to two trolls.
Darrius.sold it: It is an [interesting] story. Would you like to hear more about the tale of two trolls?
Darrius.rolled around: I told them to get out. I was amazed that they wanted their money back because the book was torn up. They are probably somewhere in Gaplen trying to sell someone what is left of the book. I am kind of [glad] I sold the book.
Darrius.glad: A few days after the trolls bought the book, a strange woman came through town searching for it. She said that an old Runemaster had told her I had it. She seemed really upset when I told her I sold the book and wanted to know [who] bought it.
Darrius.who: I told her that the troll called himself Aki and had said he was returning to Galplen. The woman said she studied werewolves and wanted any knowledge the book contained. I told her I didn't know anything else.
Darrius.werewolves: They are cursed. Legend tells of people who could change into forest creatures but only because of their faith. The werewolves can change others into werewolves with but a single cite. That is why I did not mind trying to [steal from them].
Darrius.steal from them: The crown sounds like it could be a worthy prize for someone strong enough to go get it. If I were you, I would go to the stables and get a horse. You can reach Galplen much faster if you ride. Aki should be selling his wares somewhere around town. Talk to him about it.

M190.offer: I am pleased that you have returned to me. I have need of your services again. I have had more visions while studying this map. I believe [the visions] will help us learn about the elves Fressen spoke of, and this mysterious Gahsir.
M190.accept_line: You have returned. Did you find the woman I saw in my visions? What did she tell you of the elves?
M190.finish: Travel into the fires of Muspelheim and bring me the fur of a firecat and a noxious hound. The warmth of their fur will protect you from the cold of the Rod. Return to me when you have both and I shall weave them into a bag for you.
giver_turnins: I figured she would say that. Any who have the Rod of Mimir must be stopped, and the dark one seemed to think that of the elves. And did she speak of Gashir? Who or what is he?

A demon! We must stop them from summoning up Gashir and retrieve the Rod of Mimir from these evil creatures. These elves must be creatures of magic, for mortals such as you and I cannot hope to weild the Rod ourselves. If that foolish dark one had tried as he wished, he would have frozen to death, for the rod is filled with the snow and cold of the North. I shall help you to protect yourself from the Rod. I shall [weave a bag] to carry the rod in, so it will not harm you.

Inaksha.the visions: In the first vision, I saw a young Norseman and woman, in a far away land. I know not what this means, although I do not think they live anymore. Another vision followed that one - a vision of a second young Norsewoman, surrounded by red, crowned in gold. I see her in a town, in the shadow of a city, and the sound of water fills my ears. Seek out this [Norsewoman], and ask her of Gashir and the elves. Return to me when you have talked with her.
Inaksha.weave a bag: Travel into the fires of Muspelheim and bring me the fur of a firecat and a noxious hound. The warmth of their fur will protect you from the cold of the Rod. Return to me when you have both and I shall weave them into a bag for you.

Jana.knowledge: My visions did not reveal what you want to know, only that you would come seeking me. Tell me what you wish to learn about.
Jana.childhood: My grandparents died when I was very young, but before they died, they told me of their raiding days. They were in a raiding party that ventured into Hibernia. One night after they had made a camp for the night, they told stories of the magic of the gods. My grandmother told the tale of the Rod of Mimir. A group of elves, which had gained the ability to understand our language, overheard the story as they prepared to [ambush the camp].
Jana.ambush the camp: During the ambush, they killed everyone except my grandparents. They took my grandmother captive as my grandfather escapted into the woods. The elves forced my grandmother to tell them all she knew of the Rod of Mimir. It was many days later that she managed to escape, and she and my grandfather fled back to the safety of Midgard. The [elves pursued] because they did not want anyone to know they sought the Rod.
Jana.elves pursued: Once here, they began their search, and captured passing travlers until they learned fro the proper ritual to summon Mimir. With the Rod, they can summon Mimir and force him to do their bidding. Unfortunately, their tongues are not well adapted to our language, and Mimir comes out as Gashir. After reading many ancient texts, I have discovered that there is another creature named Gashir, an evil demon who delights in destruction and chaos. If Gashir is released in this world, we will be doomed! That is all I can tell you of Gashir and the elves. I beg you, if you have the ability to stop the elves, please do so.
