npc_lines.Jana: Greetings. Please do not look surprised that I knew your name. I had a vision of you coming to me. Inaksha isn't the only one who has visions. You seek [knowledge], do you not? My visions did not reveal what you want to know, only that you would come seeking me. Tell me what you wish to learn about. Gashir? I have not heard that name since I was a child, and those that dared to speak it did so only in a whisper. If you seek knowledge of Gashir, you must also desire knowledge of the elves. You did well to come to me, for I know of both. Come closer and hear a story of my [childhood]. My grandparents died when I was very young, but before they died, they told me of their raiding days. They were in a raiding party that ventured into Hibernia. One night after they had made a camp for the night, they told stories of the magic of the gods. My grandmother told the tale of the Rod of Mimir. A group of elves, which had gained the ability to understand our language, overheard the story as they prepared to [ambush the camp]. During the ambush, they killed everyone except my grandparents. They took my grandmother captive as my grandfather escapted into the woods. The elves forced my grandmother to tell them all she knew of the Rod of Mimir. It was many days later that she managed to escape, and she and my grandfather fled back to the safety of Midgard. The [elves pursued] because they did not want anyone to know they sought the Rod. Once here, they began their search, and captured passing travlers until they learned fro the proper ritual to summon Mimir. With the Rod, they can summon Mimir and force him to do their bidding. Unfortunately, their tongues are not well adapted to our language, and Mimir comes out as Gashir. After reading many ancient texts, I have discovered that there is another creature named Gashir, an evil demon who delights in destruction and chaos. If Gashir is released in this world, we will be doomed! That is all I can tell you of Gashir and the elves. I beg you, if you have the ability to stop the elves, please do so.

M191.offer: Spat! [Spat], that crazy mean old cat. You know he's given me troubles before comin' this way.
M191.accept_line: If you bring me Vasa's tail from Spat it would make this whole shoddy trip worth it and I can make it worth your while too ya see.
M191.finish: At least my trip into Mularn is now worth it. I've been tryin' to get that cat for ages.
giver_turnins: Haha, you did it! I will not ask how you coaxed this prize from that crazy old cat but I thank you!

Vik.Spat: I've had some troubles with that nasty friend of Hrrrrgyf's. If you have a minute, I'll [tell you] about that cat Spat and maybe you can give me a hand with him.
Vik.tell you: Always getting into trouble that one is. You'd never believe the [audacity of that cat].
Vik.audacity of that cat: He attacked the wagon with the others and got into a spat, which is why I call him Spat you see, [always been a fighter] that one.
Vik.always been a fighter: Spat picked a fight with that grendalorm, and bit the end of [Vasas tail] right off, just liek that and took off into the hills.
Vik.Vasas tail: Funniest thing I've ever seen I gotta tell ya, but you also gotta know I'd like to [have that tail].

M192.offer: I see a wise person stands before me. Did you take heed of my warnings, friend, or do you come to mock me, as so many others do? Most folk find me odd because of my studies of [spiders].
M192.accept_line: Oh ho! You've returned! Glorious! Now, for the next task. You need to retrieve some more [parts] for me.
M192.finish: I fear Midgard is in peril friend. Quickly, travel to Myrkwood, he will meet you at the web covered tree near Spindelhalla. Quickly, you must hurry!
giver_turnins: <Player> has truly outdone himself this time. I do now see the oddities of which he spoke about in his last letter. Now friend, there is [more to be done].

You continue to amaze me brave Kayje. Now, before this rite can be performed, you must take this bundle to Averrius, in Myrkwood. He is an enchanter and can open the magic within these pieces so I may properly focus on the corruption.
The package, thank you friend, thank you. Please wait while I perform this rite and cease the corruption of the Blodfelag once and for all.

While I though it was merely a legend, something to scare children with at night, I see now that I have been a fool. There is a spider of immense power called the [Widower] who roams the woods of Myrkwood.

Yver Tiu.spiders: There are so many varieties in Midgard, it would take me days on end to list them all. I'm sure a seasoned adventurer like yourself has seen many of them. Perhaps, though, you'd be willing to assist an old man with a project?
Yver Tiu.parts: My friend, <Player>, who lives in Fort Atla has recently made a strange discovery with some spinnerets. He wants me to look them over. Please take this note to him and bring the spinnerets back to me so I may further examine them.
Yver Tiu.more to be done: You are truly a skilled and valuable asset to Midgard. For this, I salute you! Through your bravery and selflessness, you have demonstrated that you are more than [trustworthy] for my next task!
Yver Tiu.trustworthy: While you were out and about for me, I sent others like you on similar quests. All have returned various spider parts to me, and I am most disturbed at what I see. I believe there are those that are deliberately tampering with the [forces of magic].
Yver Tiu.forces of magic: I know of one way to cull it, but I require another favour from you. Deep within west Svealand live the Blodfelag clan. Within their ranks are shamantic priests known as the [haxa].
Yver Tiu.haxa: Because the Blodfelag are purely Norse, they have defiled the laws of nature by attempting to subvert the Shaman's magic to their own twisted ways. They have destroyed the land around them with their corruption, as well as the animals. These spider parts tell me that their magic is spreading to other parts of the land, not just remaining localised around their fortress. I must obtain a haxa charm necklace in order to perform a [rite] to banish their magic from corrupting any others.
Yver Tiu.rite: It would take far too long to explain right now, and we are quickly running out of time. Please retrieve this necklace for me so I might curb those that would harm Midgard.
Yver Tiu.Widower: He is thusly called for the men he has killed and widows he has made. While his power seems weak at the moment, I cannot help but think that it will grow strong soon. My brother has agreed to help up with this. He shall meet you in Myrkwood and together you shall find this creature and slay him. Should he regain his powers, there's no telling [what will happen].
Yver Tiu.what will happen: I fear Midgard is in peril friend. Quickly, travel to Myrkwood, he will meet you at the web covered tree near Spindelhalla. Quickly, you must hurry!

npc_lines.Darius: Ah, a note from Yver, my old friend. I see he wants you to deliver these spinnerets to him. I wish I had been able to make the delivery myself, but my wife is due any day now. Here are the spinnerets. Be careful, they are very delicate.
npc_lines.Averrius: Interesting, very interesting. Let me see what I can do with this. Please wait. I am finished. You may return these to Yver. He will now be able to do his rite. I hope he discovers who is behind all this.
npc_lines.Yver Yiu: It seems I was wrong about the Blodfelag. While there magic is corrupting the wilderness, it is not them that defiles the spiders. Nay, there twisted magic has not spread much farther than their fortress, as I originally said. There is another [force at work here].
npc_lines.Widower: For so long I have been imprisoned within this fleshy body. You shall feel my pain and Midgard shall feel my wrath!!! You think you can defeat me you children of Valhalla? Try then, fools! I shall be the death of you both! The Arachites will slay your family and eat your children.
npc_lines.Yric Tiu: So, Averrius, I should have known. You Arachite traitor! How dare you defile Midgard with your devious magic! We shall destroy you! You have done well young Kayje. I wish to reward you for your valiant attempts. I will make you a shield with the parts from his carapace. Let me imbue them with the power of Valhalla. This will only take a moment. Here you are. Use this shield well, and never forget the lessons we both learned here today.

M194.offer: Ah my friend. You got word I needed you. I've received word from Masrim again. There have been more sightings of [the Albion undead] recently.
M194.accept_line: So you return. Gunnolf sent word he has you go to Masrim. That was good , for she knows more of this than anyone. What did you learn from her?
M194.finish: Here is your axe, my friend. May the House of Loki keep watch over you until Masrim and I need you again, and we most certainly will need you if this pact between the realms is true!
giver_turnins: Aye, a reward. You've earned it for bringing me this knowledge. You must choose from the weapons I've been making. Would you prefer a [sword], or an [axe]?

Morlin Caan.the Albion undead: I fear that killing Pellinistra didn't end the reign of the undead here in our beloved land. I think someone has either taken her place or more likely [someone] was controlling Pellinistra and now has chosen someone else to lead the undead against us.
Morlin Caan.someone: We will not be rid of the undead until we are sure we have found and dealt with the one from Albion that leads this fight. Will you aid Masrim and myself again in [purging our land] of this evil that plagues it?
Morlin Caan.purging our land: I knew we could count on one from the House of Loki. In the note Masrim sent to me, she spoke of messages she had received from across the land. The most pressing message came from Gunnolf in Vindsaul Faste on the edge of West Svealand, although he did not include many details. Travel to him now and find out what you can of these new undead [invaders] on our land.
Morlin Caan.axe: An axe, eh? Would you prefer [one handed] or [two handed]?
Morlin Caan.two handed: Here is your axe, my friend. May the House of Loki keep watch over you until Masrim and I need you again, and we most certainly will need you if this pact between the realms is true!

Gunnolf.what I've seen: I was out on patrol recently in Yggdra Forest. As I was returning, I happened to catch a glimpse of a person dressed in black meeting with another in the same attire. I didn't think too much of it, for both seemed harmless enough. I saw something pass from one hand to another - something round and white, kind of like a bone or a skull. They both [headed off] in opposite directions after the item changed hands.
Gunnolf.headed off: It was a few days after that the reports started coming in from travelers about a group of undead roaming the Forest. They have been seen in [many places].
Gunnolf.many places: They seem to avoid the guards and patrols, but the travelers speak of them near the water at night. Since they avoid the patrols, I believe you will be able to find them, If you see them, do not hesitate to attack. Masrim has said she cannot solve the riddle of who controls the undead without knowing how they are controlled.

Masrim.a few creatures: The sidhe draoi still use scrying crystals. Head to Skona Ravine. When you reach the circle of stones, head west down a deep ravine, When you come out of the ravine, head south to the water. The sidhe draoi live alond the water. When you have a scrying crystal, return to me." (or he will send you to the Isalf Scryers in Yggdra or Uppland Go to Skona Ravine and kill a Sidhe Draoi Step #5
Masrim.find her: Tell me, were you able to learn the name of the creature we seek? Tell it to me know.

npc_lines.Gunnolf: Hail. I recognize you from Masrim's description. She was sure that once Morlin spoke to you of the evil invading our land, you would once again rise to the task. I was afraid to include too many details of what I've seen in my note. I did not want to spread panic across my beloved homeland. Let me tell you [what I've seen]. I was out on patrol recently in Yggdra Forest. As I was returning, I happened to catch a glimpse of a person dressed in black meeting with another in the same attire. I didn't think too much of it, for both seemed harmless enough. I saw something pass from one hand to another - something round and white, kind of like a bone or a skull. They both [headed off] in opposite directions after the item changed hands. It was a few days after that the reports started coming in from travelers about a group of undead roaming the Forest. They have been seen in [many places]. They seem to avoid the guards and patrols, but the travelers speak of them near the water at night. Since they avoid the patrols, I believe you will be able to find them, If you see them, do not hesitate to attack. Masrim has said she cannot solve the riddle of who controls the undead without knowing how they are controlled. You have returned! I am most pleased to see you survived. Did those vile creatures have anything that might give us a clue as to who is controlling them? Why, this is the skull I saw the two cloaked figures exchanging! I should have known they were up to no good. I am a fool for thinking they were harmless. You must take this skull to Masrim immediatley. Hopefully her ancestors will be able to help her figure out who was using it. The safety of Midgard lies in your hands. May the House of Loki watch over you.
npc_lines.Masrim: Welcome back. I wish we were meeting again under better circumstance, but these are bad times. It is up to us to make them better. Morlin sent word he was sending you to Gunnolf. Did you have any luck with him? Did you obtain anything that will help our cause? Hmmm. I have seen many bones in my day, but you don't need me to tell you this was the skull of some resident of Albion, dragged up from the grave to serve and evil purpose. Give me a minute to speak with my ancestors to see if we can identify those responsible for this deed. Ah, the one who is doing this is shielding herself from view. All I can tell is that she is female. If I had not broken my scrying crystal last week, I would be able to see more. They are hard to come by these days, but I know of [a few creatures] that use them. The sidhe draoi still use scrying crystals. Head to Skona Ravine. When you reach the circle of stones, head west down a deep ravine, When you come out of the ravine, head south to the water. The sidhe draoi live alond the water. When you have a scrying crystal, return to me." (or he will send you to the Isalf Scryers in Yggdra or Uppland Go to Skona Ravine and kill a Sidhe Draoi Step #5 Welcome back. Give me the scrying crystal please. She knows you have defeated her undead in Yggdra Forest, and has fled to Uppland. I fear she may be trying to return to Albion to protect herself. She hides now near Mjollner Faste. You must [find her]. Tell me, were you able to learn the name of the creature we seek? Tell it to me know. Ah, that is not an Albion name. That sounds almost Celtic. Did you get anything else from her? This talisman bears a tree on it! That is not the symbol of Albion. Strange things are happening here. Was there anything else? This book is not written in the language spoken by Albion. In fact, this looks rather like the druid texts I've seen before. I believe that the vile Hibernians have a hand in this plot. I shall have to investigate it more. For now, return to Morlin. He needs to know that there is a good pissibility that Hibernia is in league with Albion and that our realm is in mortal danger. Tell him the Hibernians are involved in this plague. Go now!
npc_lines.Masrin: Head west from there, up the mountain to a large lake, I believe an undead protector guards her so be careful as you approach. Learn her name if you can. Go now and remove her from our land. Our fate rests in your hands. Find Eibhilin and kill her. (New Frontiers loc Uppland at 20k 27k, south of the relic keep, not far from the Snowshoe Bandit camp.) Step #6
npc_lines.Morlin Cann: The Hibernians are involved? This is worse that we thought! If they are in league with those in Albion, Midgard could be doomed. I must get in touch with Masrim immedialely and see what she has learned. For now though, I owe you [a reward].

A197.offer: Greetings, my brother. Are you [well this day]?
A197.accept_line: Your help is most appreciated, <Player>. I have prepared a ritual prayer that will help us [determine Burhoff's will].
A197.finish: Wonderful, you have survived that encounter. Search the graveyard for Bishop Burhoff. I have seen him wandering there at night. Give him the skull and he will speak with you.

Brother Lensar.well this day: I am glad to hear that. I myself am well too, but not everyone in this world is. I am thinking of one soul in particular. His name is [Bishop Burhoff].
Brother Lensar.Bishop Burhoff: Bishop Burhoff was the most trusted advisor of Lord Aryon. Lord Aryon ruled a castle in Avalon Marsh. During Mordred's Rebellion, the castle was attacked, and Lord Aryon rallied his men to defeat Morgana's armies. Lord Aryon and his men were just about to win when they were betreyed by Bishop Burhoff. He had kept his loyalty to Morgana a secret. He arranged for Lord Aryon to be stabbed and poisoned, then he opened the gates to Morgana's evil creatures. As Lord Aryon lay dying, his men being massacred, he cursed Bishop Burhoff for his treachery. A knight heard the curse, and sacrificed himself to make sure Bishop Burhoff died and [the curse was fulfilled].
Brother Lensar.the curse was fulfilled: The curse insured that Bishop Burhoff would haunt the Vetusta Abeey in the night. But we of the Church believe that Bishop Burhoff has come to feel regret for his actions and we wish to know more. All we are lacking at this point is a brave soul to assist us. Do you happen to [know of one].
Brother Lensar.determine Burhoff's will: Lately we have seen Burhoff's spirit roaming the halls of this Church late at night. We believe that he wants to talk to us, but cannot yet. I believe he needs something from his former life to [link him to this world].
Brother Lensar.link him to this world: I believe his remains will work as the link. You will have to defeat him to get access to his remains, for he guards them closely. If you could get his skull, that will be enough. Venture to Vetusta Abbey now, and return when you have it!

Bishop Burhoff.a church: If I am in a church, then perhaps the time has come to lift the curse that is upon me. If I only I could rid myself of this curse. I could seek out Lord Aryon in the otherworld and [beg his forgiveness]. But as long as I am cursed, I cannot seek him out to beg his forgiveness.
Bishop Burhoff.beg his forgiveness: Aye, I would beg his forgiveness. I was entranced by Morgana's beauty and spells, and didn't see the error of my ways until I lay dying. I only wish now to make it right. But I need help to [break the curse].
Bishop Burhoff.break the curse: To break the curse, I need a adder fang. I will use it to slice my [ties to this earth], breaking the curse. When I was alive, you could find them in Forest Sauvage. I'd start there.
Bishop Burhoff.ties to this earth: Once you have it, return to me here. Take this skull with you, so that you may speak to me again when you return. The blessing of the Church upon you, my child.

npc_lines.Bishop Burhoff: You wish to speak to me? Am I in [a church]? If I am in a church, then perhaps the time has come to lift the curse that is upon me. If I only I could rid myself of this curse. I could seek out Lord Aryon in the otherworld and [beg his forgiveness]. But as long as I am cursed, I cannot seek him out to beg his forgiveness. Aye, I would beg his forgiveness. I was entranced by Morgana's beauty and spells, and didn't see the error of my ways until I lay dying. I only wish now to make it right. But I need help to [break the curse]. To break the curse, I need a adder fang. I will use it to slice my [ties to this earth], breaking the curse. When I was alive, you could find them in Forest Sauvage. I'd start there. Once you have it, return to me here. Take this skull with you, so that you may speak to me again when you return. The blessing of the Church upon you, my child. You have returned. Do you have the adder fang for me? I wish to leave this world and seek out Lord Aryon in the beyond. Please give it to me now. Thank you! I have a reward for you for helping me. It is something I will no longer need now, but I think you will like it and it will serve you well. I thank you again for helping me, and I know the Church thanks you too. Now to seek out Lord Aryon's forgiveness.

M201.offer: Ah, you have never heard of us? We are rather small, I admit, but our work is very serious, I assure you! In fact, I am in the process of studying a specific spider as we speak! Have you ever heard of the [Ickerius] spider?
M201.accept_line: Ah so kind of you. I was bitten the other day by a female juvenile red-back, and while I was able to treat myself with an antivenom I made, I'm not still feeling all that well. Could you run to Audliten and retrieve the silk for me from [Garon]?
M201.finish: Here you are friend. I had my compatriot, <Player>, look over the silk. He said it had properties that would benefit someone like you. I hope you can use it for some time to come. Again, I think you for all your hard work!
giver_turnins: Welcome back friend! I'm glad to see you in one piece. I hope you don't mind, but I have one more task for you to do for me. I hope you're [up for it]!

Ah ha! You're back! Excellent! Do you have the specimen for me? You hand Yver Tiu the Ickerius spider body. Yver does a cursory exam of the ickerius body before putting it in a large bag he has at his side.
Excellent work my friend! Excellent work! Here, I think you'll appreciate this fine token of my [sincere gratitude] for all your hard work.

Yver Tiu.Ickerius: The Ickerius arachnid, also known as the Ick spider, is a small tree spider, roughly three feet in length with a yellow tinge to it's body. Truly a marvelous creature, one we're lucky to have found. It's [silk] is used to make some of our fishing nets.
Yver Tiu.silk: Some of the strongest silk comes from the Ick spider. Amazing, really, that such a small creature can produce something of such quality and strength. I was [wondering], since you are here, would you care to run an errand for me?
Yver Tiu.Garon: Ah, this silk looks very nice. Did he happen to have any notes on where he found it or anything? [Step #3]Give the scroll to Yver.
Yver Tiu.Step #3: Ah, his notes, excellent! Oh ho! What have we here? Possible magic properties within the silk? Excellent! But, that means that we have more [work] ahead of us to protect and scrye out why this silk is magical.
Yver Tiu.work: Aye friend, more work! While you were gone, I read more of Garon's letter. He said there was a small nest of baby spiders on the wooded isle near Audliten. There is something [preying] on them.
Yver Tiu.preying: Aye friend. They upset the balance of nature. You should hurry to Audliten at once. There you will find a small wooded isle. On the isle are the plague rats. Kill them and return to me when you are finished.
Yver Tiu.up for it: Excellent! Remember the ickerius spider I told you about earlier? Well, it seems there's one that roams about in Gotar! We need this specimen for study! The locals have called it [Ick], apparently, ickerius is too hard for them to pronounce.
Yver Tiu.Ick: Aye, the ickerius spider is a nasty spider. Be careful, it has a powerful bite. I can give you directions. Travel to Nalliten, from there, go south on the road. When you reach the fork, go southeast over the bridge. He is near the mountain.
Yver Tiu.sincere gratitude: Here you are friend. I had my compatriot, <Player>, look over the silk. He said it had properties that would benefit someone like you. I hope you can use it for some time to come. Again, I think you for all your hard work!

npc_lines.Garon: Greetings friend! Welcome to Audliten, though you seem to be a more seasoned traveler, I'm sure no introduction is needed for our fair town. What brings you to Audliten today? Ah, from Yver! Excellent. I see he's been bitten by a female red-back. Terrible lot that. It's good that's he's been able to treat the wound though, they can be deadly. One moment please. Here you are friend. I've managed to pull the strands apart for easier inspection of the individual strands. I'm sure Yver will appreciate that. Make sure to keep it flat, or they will bunch. Here is some of my research. Please give it to Yver.

M202.offer: Did you meet with Coplin and get the [second] piece of the crest?
M202.accept_line: Wonderful. You are doing well. Perhaps on this track we can once again restore the Grenlock Crest to its original glory! Be safe in your travels!

npc_lines.Pompin the crier: Lieutenant Brude in the Snowdonia mountain fortress needs someone to perform a simple errand. Report to him directly if you're interested in the job.

M208.accept_line: You have returned. Did you obtain that which was required of you?
M208.finish: I see you have met Siv. He was very kind to his people, always wishing them the best and his family. Perhaps someday the Grenlock Clan name will be restored. Safe journey Spiritmaster.

Siv Alfevson.granted: I traveled many years, running in fear from the terrible consuming northern storm. After may years my brothers and I settled our armies and clan and built shelter and a new civilization after the terrible storm that wiped away our homeland. Our father stayed behind, leaving us with only pieces of his armor and pieces of our great clan crest of Grenlock. I too stay behind to watch over what is left of [our clan] here in these parts.
Siv Alfevson.our clan: There is little of the Grenlock Clan left, only our people and the shards of the crest my father entrusted me to us, both now scattered to the wind. You must make sure to gather the crest piece from my long dead wife, [Ulga}. This must be done at all costs!

Ulga.Siv: It is doubtful that he has sent you! If you wish the crest, you must take it by force!

npc_lines.Siv Alfevson: Life is never to be taken for [granted] for one always reaps what they sow. I traveled many years, running in fear from the terrible consuming northern storm. After may years my brothers and I settled our armies and clan and built shelter and a new civilization after the terrible storm that wiped away our homeland. Our father stayed behind, leaving us with only pieces of his armor and pieces of our great clan crest of Grenlock. I too stay behind to watch over what is left of [our clan] here in these parts. There is little of the Grenlock Clan left, only our people and the shards of the crest my father entrusted me to us, both now scattered to the wind. You must make sure to gather the crest piece from my long dead wife, [Ulga}. This must be done at all costs! Search for her soul and ask for the Grenlock Crest shard. Should you succeed, the House of Hel shall make us whole! I can assist you no more Spiritmaster. May the gods guard you on the rest of your journey, just as they have done with me.
npc_lines.Ulga: How may I help you young one? The only way you could know about the Grenlock Crest is if my husband [Siv] had spoken to you or you are an agent of evil! It is doubtful that he has sent you! If you wish the crest, you must take it by force! I have failed you my love!

npc_lines.The elder sveawolf: Thank you. I am old and the way there is long, else I would guide you there myself. You must search out Wildtooth in West Svealand and stop her. You will find her near the fort of the blodfelags. I wish you well.

M217.offer: Hi there, have you ever heard of the Svartalfs? They're terrible! They are callous, cold-blooded killers, and I think my brother is [working for them]!
M217.accept_line: Thank you so much! You have no idea what this means to me. Piercer has been living in West Svealand, above and north of the main Svartalf camp. Be careful and stay far away from them, they don't [trust] anyone and will often attack.
M217.finish: Ah you're right. Piercer won't trust you either. Hmmm, let's see, I know! Tell him you have a message for Halvor. That's his real name and if you use it he'll know I sent you. Good luck, I just hope it's not too late. He's the only family I have.

Thrand.working for them: Yes, working for them. But my brother isn't anything like that. He's great at hiding in the shadows and maybe he's redistributed a little wealth, but I don't think that he'd work for the Svartalfs. He is a good person, not a killer! I just know something is wrong. He won't tell me anything though, he thinks he's protecting me. But he might talk to you. Do you think you could go [see him] for me?
Thrand.trust: Ah you're right. Piercer won't trust you either. Hmmm, let's see, I know! Tell him you have a message for Halvor. That's his real name and if you use it he'll know I sent you. Good luck, I just hope it's not too late. He's the only family I have.

Piercer.kill someone: Shhhh! Not so loud. Yes, murder. You're probably not familiar with the Svartalfar, so before I ask you to help me I'll explain a little about them. The Svartalfar, the Arachites and the Varulv are all involved in a long-standing dispute over the Myrkwood area. The Svartalfar think that they were there first and that the other two groups are invading their [territory].
Piercer.territory: The three factions are constantly fighting amongst themselves, sometimes in open combat, but more often they send agents to murder key personalities and sabotage plans. The Svartalfar have become adept at sneak attacks and assassinations and are pretty unscrupulous about what they'll agree to do to increase their holdings and resources. I didn't realize they were such a bad bunch when I first got involved and now they won't let me leave. They say they're going to kill my brother Thrand if I don't do this job for them! Can you [help] me?
Piercer.help: Maybe Graesen will talk to you. I report to him, and if you tell him that I'd be a terrible assassin maybe he'll just let me leave. See the camp below? Graesen is just to the east of it.
Piercer.returned: A Svartalfar named Rip was told to do the job. He's big, mean, and won't stop until he's done it. I think the best thing would be for you to take the initiative and go after him first. He is Southwest of here, under a tree outside the main camp.

Graesen.Piercer: He's a new guy, and a pitiful fool that don't have no guts. Promised he'd do a job, now says he's scared.
Graesen.do it: The agent is in Myrkwood, disguised as an arachite priest (or weblasher or shadowslinker for another version). Just tell him Graesen sent you.

npc_lines.Piercer: What are you doing here, spying? Give me one good reason I shouldn't just kill you right now. So! You know my real name, do you? Keep your voice down, there are unfriendly ears nearby. My brother Thrand must have told you. I don't blame him for worrying, I'm in real trouble this time. I got involved with these treacherous Svartalfar and now they want me to [kill someone]. Shhhh! Not so loud. Yes, murder. You're probably not familiar with the Svartalfar, so before I ask you to help me I'll explain a little about them. The Svartalfar, the Arachites and the Varulv are all involved in a long-standing dispute over the Myrkwood area. The Svartalfar think that they were there first and that the other two groups are invading their [territory]. The three factions are constantly fighting amongst themselves, sometimes in open combat, but more often they send agents to murder key personalities and sabotage plans. The Svartalfar have become adept at sneak attacks and assassinations and are pretty unscrupulous about what they'll agree to do to increase their holdings and resources. I didn't realize they were such a bad bunch when I first got involved and now they won't let me leave. They say they're going to kill my brother Thrand if I don't do this job for them! Can you [help] me? Maybe Graesen will talk to you. I report to him, and if you tell him that I'd be a terrible assassin maybe he'll just let me leave. See the camp below? Graesen is just to the east of it. You're okay! I was so worried! Graesen came and said that he'd tricked you into working for them, then sent you into a trap! You're a true friend for risking yourself for me. Did you bring anything back with you? I've heard of Priest Thaxtix, he's the one the Svartalfar want me to assassinate. He and his priests have been performing ceremonies and sacrifices to gain enough power to launch a full attack on the Svartalfar. That's why Graesen wants him and his followers out of the picture so badly. You've got a lot more than that to worry about though. I overheard Graesen order someone to kill you if you [returned] from his trap! A Svartalfar named Rip was told to do the job. He's big, mean, and won't stop until he's done it. I think the best thing would be for you to take the initiative and go after him first. He is Southwest of here, under a tree outside the main camp. Nice work, I'm glad Rip won't be bothering us anymore. I wish I had courage like yours. Then my little brother wouldn't be in danger. Will you please [help] me take care of Priest Thaxtix? Please go and kill Priest Thaxtix for me. You might need to bring a few friends along to help because Thaxtix is usally surrounded by his lesser priests. Bring back proof that he's dead, so I can turn it in and then quit the Svatalfar. Here is some silver for you also, to reimburse some of what you've spent on travel. Taking a horse from Huginfell to Myrkwood and back can get expensive. You're back! Did you bring proof that you killed Priest Thaxtix? I don't know how to thank you, you've done so much for me and my brother. Perhaps you can get some use out of these boots. I came by them honestly, and they have some useful properties. Thanks gain for your help.
npc_lines.Graesen: What brings you skulking around here? Lookin' for work? I've got plenty hereabouts. Good money in it for you, too. 'Course we don't want none of them types that gets cold feet, like [Piercer]. He's a new guy, and a pitiful fool that don't have no guts. Promised he'd do a job, now says he's scared. I 'spose we could call it off, but someone would need to contact our arachite agent and tell him. That ain't gonna be easy. Those arachites are fighters and he'll probably attack before he hears the message. Want to [do it]? The agent is in Myrkwood, disguised as an arachite priest (or weblasher or shadowslinker for another version). Just tell him Graesen sent you.
npc_lines.The arachite priest: Then Graesen sent you to your death, fool! We know his plans, and every arachite will defend Priest Thaxtix to the death. Let me give you a taste of where my loyalties lie! If the Svartalfs sent you, tell them we will all fight to the end. [Step #4] Obviously Graesen tried to trick you by sending you into a trap. You can go back and tell Piercer of Graesen's trickery OR you can return and report to the treacherous Graesen. **Return to Piercer version** [Step #4] Talk to Piercer.
npc_lines.Rip: What are you doing here? I should thank you for saving me the trouble of finding you. Prepare to die!
npc_lines.Priest Thaxtix: You shall pay for this outrage against the Arachites! You shall pay...

M218.offer: Have you [obtained] Ove's piece of the crest?
M218.accept_line: Ah! What a sight to behold! You have done well! In time I will call upon you. We shall not rest until the Grenlock crest is made whole once again!

M220.offer: Welcome! Are prepared to [complete] the journey you started long ago?
M220.accept_line: Very well the, let us proceed.
M220.finish: I cannot believe I hold all but the last piece of the crest! You have done wonders my friend! We have only to merge the five piece into one and [fulfill the wish] of a fallen king, now kept for hundreds of years.
giver_turnins: The last of Svan's sons went by the name Gunnar, a mighty warrior and wise in the ways of worship. Gunnar outlived his brothers and like his father was a good man. Yet, the tradegy of his father's death struck Gunnar very hard. Even the birth of his own sons could not raise him from the pain. So it was that on a cold morning within the town of Vasudfheim, the ageing Viking took up his axe and headed towards Mularn. He paused only briefly to purchase supplies within Haggerfel. Then, according to the townsfolk, Gunnar set out into the fires of Muspelheim and [did not return].
Were you successful?

Anrid.did not return: In tribute of the great warrior, as baby born each generation within Vasudheim bears Gunnar's honored named. Gunnar carried with him, the fourth piece of the Grenlock crest. If you are to find this piece, you must start your journey within Musoelheim! When you have obtained it, return to me.

npc_lines.The Shade of Gunnar: You honor Gunnar's passing! Tread well the treasures that lay within!

M228.offer: You might not like what you hear. Fridgeir used to be a guard here in Huginfel, one of the best actually. I sent him on a secret mission to spy on the [Blodfelag] and he never returned.
M228.accept_line: Good luck my friend. Whatever you do, do not let Redhands capture you. Otherwise you may find out that there are things far worse than death.

Gudlor.Blodfelag: I have been told that he was captured and his tongue removed. Redhands had one of his Runemasters cast a mind control rune on Fridgeir, turning him into nothing more than a [guard dog]. Now he serves as a warning to any who would dare cross Redhands.
Gudlor.guard dog: I think naught can be done for this Frdgeir and have not told Sugnhild of his plight. Perhaps one day someone will tell her but that is not today. Someone should also [go to the Blodfelag keep] and put Fridgeir out of his misery.
Gudlor.go to the Blodfelag keep: What? You think you could? Well all I know about the location of the keep is that it is very far down the road. You will have to get past many dangers to [acutally] reach it.

npc_lines.Fridgeir Gestsson: Oh thank you great Tyr. Please tell my wife I love her.

M229.offer: Well met. Do you have any news for me?
M229.accept_line: Thank you. I shall pray to Tyr tonight in hopes he will watch over you. I shall be forever in debt to you my friend.
M229.finish: My husband's spirit can now rest. I can never repay you enough but perhaps this may help you.

npc_lines.Konung Botolf Redhands: Thou shall kneel when thou comes before me, swine!

M231.offer: You did a great job getting rid of that infamous Blodfelag camp. I hear they may be making other plans now, so be wary.
M231.accept_line: Good! The story starts many years ago when Huginfell was first being settled. Back then, the Blodfelag had not yet banded together and Redhands was still just another misguided warrior with a [few followers].
M231.finish: Go now and one warning. If you are slain while wearing the crown, it may have the power to animate your corpse and slay your friends. Be forewarned, the crown is truly twisted evil. Safe journey to you, my friend.
giver_turnins: Greetings. I can tell by the look on your face that you were not able to destroy the book. Hand me the book and we shall see about sending you somewhere you can make a difference.
Thank you. At least you tried and that is what truly counts. There is another thing that remains undone. The [evil crown] of the Blodfelag still exists.

Gudlor.well: Sadly, we have had our share of problems here in Huginfell. The Svartalf raids continue daily but we have managed to survive. There has been [something] else that has been plaguing my mind, but before I tell you what it is, I must tell you another older story. Do you have some time to listen?
Gudlor.few followers: Redhands began gathering more followers and set about his plans to take over the local ruffians. It is told that he sent his men into the far reaches of Raumarik seeking something to give him enough power to take complete control of the area. His men returned with an ancient [tome of runes].
Gudlor.tome of runes: The tome was said to have some of the most powerful runes in existence. They were called the runes of creation, which were used in the formation of Midgard itself. Unfortunately, most of the runes in the book were beyond the understanding of mere [mortal] men.
Gudlor.mortal: Redhands called upon Lord Loki to aid him in his quest and a child came to him, bearing a dark ring. The child told Redhands the rind was cursed and somehow gave its bearer the power to read the tome. Redhands called upon his most trusted Runemaster and had her [wear the ring].
Gudlor.wear the ring: She screamed and fell to the ground as a rotting corpse. Next, Redhands called on his second most trsuted Runemaster and ordered hiim to wear the ring. He slipped the ring on and began to decipher some of the tome, learning its [dark secrets].
Gudlor.dark secrets: The first ones he learned about were the rune of power and the rune of damnation. The Runemaster attempted to craft a crown with the rune on it, but could not master the skills needed. He did, however, create a crown that made its bearer extremely strong and qucik but slowly drove them [insane].
Gudlor.insane: Redhands knew a good use for such a cursed item. He gave the crown to the leader of the Blodfelag as a gift. The Blodfelag Commander wore the crown and was slowly [driven mad].
Gudlor.driven mad: The Commander's men could no longer trust him to make good decisions and Redhands was more than willing to take control in his place. Redhands ordered the Commander to give up his crown or die. The Commander was not willing to give up his cherished crown and was last seen heading into Muspelheim, vowing to [never surrender] his crown to anyone.
Gudlor.never surrender: He is probably still there with that cursed crown on his head. Next, Redhands turned [his attention] to us.
Gudlor.his attention: He had his Runemasters carve Runes of Damnation around the town to summon and control legions of dead to attack us. If not for Sugnhild's brave husband, Fridgier Gestsson, we would have been [surprised] and the town lost.
Gudlor.surprised: Fridgeir managed to alert his wife just as the last symbol was carved and we hunted the Runemasters, slaying them. The shadows rose from the mists and started slaying who stood against them. That was the longest [night]of my life.
Gudlor.night: The battle lasted until dawn when the shadows were driven away by the morning light. I went searching for survivors and only [found this].
Gudlor.found this: I honestly do not know if this book can be destroyed. I pray to Odin every night, hoping that someone will be able to take [the book] from me without taking my life. Only time will tell though.
Gudlor.the book: Now you need the rinf that came with the book. I gave it to Agnor Crusher so I would not be tempted to use the book. He hates protecting the ring but I can trust no other with it. You can find him guarding the northern part of the town from the Blodfelag. Thank you, my friend, for undertaking this dangerous quest.
Gudlor.evil crown: Someone must go and get the crown back so innocents are not controlled by its twisted powers. I think that person is you. You should be able to get where the crown is with little danger because of your strong will. In any case, it will be safer with you. Legends say the Blodfelag king, Strykel, went deep into Muspelheim to hide. I do not believe he made it very far before he was completely [taken over] by the crown.
Gudlor.taken over: It changed him into a demonic monster and he is said to roam a fiery island just east of the Muspelheim gate. By Odin's will, you should be able to find Strykel and release his spirit to the gods. It shall be left to you how to guard the crown. Perhaps we shall try to destroy this book again another day. Until then, I shall guard it with [my life].
Gudlor.my life: Go now and one warning. If you are slain while wearing the crown, it may have the power to animate your corpse and slay your friends. Be forewarned, the crown is truly twisted evil. Safe journey to you, my friend.

Agnor Crusher.do for you: I knew this day would come. You are taking the book to destroy it? I hope you are strong enough not to give into the temptation that has claimed the others. I have been wearing this cursed ring since Gudlor asked me to [protect it].
Agnor Crusher.protect it: I swear, I think that some of the creatures around here know I have it. The way they look at me makes me very nervous and paranoid. The ring is not even quenched and it still bothers me. I will tell you what I have learned about [the ring].
Agnor Crusher.the ring: To quench the ring you must travel into Uppland, place the ring on your finger and then slay a boreal cockatrice. The ring will only be fed if you are wearing it when the creature dies. Be very careful, the ring will make you feel much weaker while wearing it. Once you have quenched its thirst, return here and I will tell you how to destroy the book. May Odin smile upon you, my friend.
Agnor Crusher.a boulder: The book was actually found there and not in Raumarik. I think that is the best place to try destroying the book. I will know you have failed if the ring appears back on my finger. If the our plan fails, just return the book to Gudlor and we shall try again. I think he was planning on sending you after that cursed crown as well. The ring can only be used to read the book near nidnight. Just stand next to the boulder and wear the ring, then read the spell from the book. Anyway, you should be off. Time is short and you do not want to have both the ring and the book on you any longer than you have to. Trust me, bad things may happen to you if you delay too long.

npc_lines.Agnor Crusher: Hello again! I remember you. You gave me proof that the sprites were planning something. The other guards were beginning to think I had lost my mind. You look like you have done really well for yourself as well. What can I [do for you]? I knew this day would come. You are taking the book to destroy it? I hope you are strong enough not to give into the temptation that has claimed the others. I have been wearing this cursed ring since Gudlor asked me to [protect it]. I swear, I think that some of the creatures around here know I have it. The way they look at me makes me very nervous and paranoid. The ring is not even quenched and it still bothers me. I will tell you what I have learned about [the ring]. To quench the ring you must travel into Uppland, place the ring on your finger and then slay a boreal cockatrice. The ring will only be fed if you are wearing it when the creature dies. Be very careful, the ring will make you feel much weaker while wearing it. Once you have quenched its thirst, return here and I will tell you how to destroy the book. May Odin smile upon you, my friend. Good, you have returned. I was getting worried that you may have fallen to the ring's evil powers. If you do not destroy the book soon, I fear it may destroy you. To find where the book was buried, you must first go to the ridge just west of here and follow that southwest until you are over the Blodfelag's camp. Look for [a boulder] near the top of the ridge. The book was actually found there and not in Raumarik. I think that is the best place to try destroying the book. I will know you have failed if the ring appears back on my finger. If the our plan fails, just return the book to Gudlor and we shall try again. I think he was planning on sending you after that cursed crown as well. The ring can only be used to read the book near nidnight. Just stand next to the boulder and wear the ring, then read the spell from the book. Anyway, you should be off. Time is short and you do not want to have both the ring and the book on you any longer than you have to. Trust me, bad things may happen to you if you delay too long.
npc_lines.Strykel: No! Please, I must protect my crown.

M241.accept_line: Halla is new here in town, and not really sure what the item is, but you can find Stripe in the Skona Ravine. Good luck in your travels!

Halla.sturdy sort: Yes, sturdy sort. You look to Halla like a smart, strong, warrior! Maybe Halla has a [story] for you.
Halla.story: Halla's story is scary! Maybe you should close your ears? Ha ha! No, Halla's just joking. Have you ever heard of the bear the locals call [Stripe]?
Halla.Stripe: Good, then Halla will make sure you hear about nasty old Stripe. Long ago, there was a man named Varnarn who loved Hel and [served her] for most of his life.
Halla.served her: Varnarn was a Spiritmaster for a long time, long long time, and Hel was going to reward him for his service, when he tried to [trick] Hel and take over the Underworld!
Halla.trick: Yes, But little did he know Hel turned his own trick on him, foiling his ploy and angering her at the same time. As his punishment, he was turned into a [bear].
Halla.bear: A bear the locals call Stripe. Halla doesn't know why he's called Stripe, but Halla hears tell of a [magical item] Stripe carries with him.

A244.offer: _________, it is good to see you are still alive and have come in good health. I have been asked by Sir Bors to ensure this [matter] with the renegades is finished once and for all.

Captain Rhodri.matter: Sir Bors would have the support of the locals within Barfog and this situation would be the best way to win their trust. Therefore your mission is to return the to renegade post and [dispatch] the outcasts.
Captain Rhodri.dispatch: You must ensure that justice is delivered to both Dillus and his [supporting] officers. When this is complete, visit the local outpost there and talk to one named Twr ap Alsig. We have it on good authority that if you win his support the locals will follow. Take with you the Arawnite orders as proof of Sir Dillus' betrayal.

Twr ap Alsig.certain: There roams about this land the undead cythraul. Should you destroy one of these and bring back its skull as proof, I will lend the support you seek." (Also has been known to send someone to go kill a Bwgan Hunter.) [Step#3] Slay a cyhraul within Llyn Barfog! (Cythraul can be found around loc=51921, 44182 also can be found at loc=36350, 53887) [Step#4] Speak to Twr ap Alsig at the local outpost in Llyn Barfog.
Twr ap Alsig.Step#4: I still seek proof of your deeds. Do you have something for me?

npc_lines.Twr ap Alsig: Yes Inconnu? What do you want? Support you say? Why should we? Your kind has forever forgotten its way. The light of that Camelot has blinded you. We know you have killed him! You have not won us with that! Do you have proof of anything that may keep us from killing you on the spot? Heavens! How can this be? I scarcely believe my eyes! I truly wish I could take your word on just this, yet I must be [certain] where your loyalties lay. There roams about this land the undead cythraul. Should you destroy one of these and bring back its skull as proof, I will lend the support you seek." (Also has been known to send someone to go kill a Bwgan Hunter.) [Step#3] Slay a cyhraul within Llyn Barfog! (Cythraul can be found around loc=51921, 44182 also can be found at loc=36350, 53887) [Step#4] Speak to Twr ap Alsig at the local outpost in Llyn Barfog. I still seek proof of your deeds. Do you have something for me? You have done well Inconnu! We shall support your cause and welcome you always. Please take this as a token of trust between our people.

M257.offer: Greetings friend. It's nice to see other adventurers roaming about these parts. I, too, used to [adventure].
M257.accept_line: To this day I wish we had been able to get back to Skone to teach that cat a lesson. If you're up for some excitement, you should go to Skona and find Furf. I'm sure he'll prove quite a challenge.

Dalla.adventure: I sought glory, treasure, and companionship, much like I'm sure you do. I found it, and a whole lot more. Adventuring had its ups and [downs] for me.
Dalla.downs: Aye. My group and I were traveling through Skona Ravine, a most dangerous area, dodging the werewolves that live there, when we ran into a [large cat].
Dalla.large cat: This cat hissed at us and lunged at one of my group mates. He slashed at him pretty good, all the while making a [furf noise]. With the help of our skald, we outran the thing.
Dalla.furf noise: Yes, A strange noise indeed. Over the next few hours, we spoke of the cat often, but [didn't dare return].

A258.offer: You have learned much. It would behoove you to venture further than you already have. Yet the roads are dangerous these days and to survive you will require [companions].
A258.accept_line: Seek out our local crier and he shall instruct your further.

Barnarn the crier.task: Seek out a fellow member of this realm. Fashion between you a group and return to me. I will instruct you further then.

npc_lines.Barnarn the crier: Hail! I am told you require instruction. Tis and easy [task] to learn. Seek out a fellow member of this realm. Fashion between you a group and return to me. I will instruct you further then.

H259.offer: Hail. You've come to learn about the Path of Essence. Those who follow the Path of Essence believe that magic is part of everything, and is all around us. Enchanters believe magic is a tool, and we use that tool in [everything] we do.
H259.accept_line: To learn about the Path of Harmony, speak with the Mentalist Aindreas in Ardagh, south of Mag Mell, or Ena, in Tir na Nog. They know more about that path than any other.

Adair.choose a path: If you dread traveling far, please [tell me now], or you will find yourself running quite a bit. There are three Paths to choose from: The [Path of Essence], the [Path of Harmony], and the [Path of Focus]. Not all paths may be open to you.
Adair.Path of Focus: Very well then. No need tosend you all the way to Ardagh! Speak will Cadalind, at the Guard Tower on the road North, from outside Howth. She will explain the Path of Essence.

Keriann.hamlet: Oh! Another one wanting to know about the Path of Harmony, eh? Well, I'm not a Mentalist, but I've studied their ways. Mentalists draw strength from understanding that everything works together, that the magical world and the non-magical world are really the same world. There is a balance between magic and non-magic. It's only when both are used together that there is harmony. Now, go speak with Cadalind, at the guard tower, to learn of the Path of Focus. <Player>, <Player>, I know you already spoke with her, but I've not studied the path Eldritches follow.

npc_lines.Ena: You've come to learn about the Path of Harmony. Mentalists follow this path because we draw strength from the understanding that everything works together, that the magical world and the non-magical world are really the same world. There is a balance between magic and non-magic, It's only when both are used together that there is harmony. Seek out Coman, in Ardagh, or Aodh, in the city of Tir na Nog, to learn about the Path of Focus.
npc_lines.Aodh: So, you have come to learn about the Path of Focus? Those that follow this path believe in directing the energy that permeates us into perfecting their skills. As an eldritch, I concentrate this energy into the practice of magic. Now that you understand the different paths open to you, I hope when your time comes, you will choose wisely. Choose the one you believe in, and then you will choose correctly.
npc_lines.Adair: It is my duty to train you in the Way of Magic. Soon, you must [choose a path]. I am sending you out to learn about all the different paths now, so you may consider your choice wisely. If you dread traveling far, please [tell me now], or you will find yourself running quite a bit. There are three Paths to choose from: The [Path of Essence], the [Path of Harmony], and the [Path of Focus]. Not all paths may be open to you. Very well then. No need tosend you all the way to Ardagh! Speak will Cadalind, at the Guard Tower on the road North, from outside Howth. She will explain the Path of Essence.
npc_lines.Keriann: Hello traveler, what brings you to our small [hamlet]? Oh! Another one wanting to know about the Path of Harmony, eh? Well, I'm not a Mentalist, but I've studied their ways. Mentalists draw strength from understanding that everything works together, that the magical world and the non-magical world are really the same world. There is a balance between magic and non-magic. It's only when both are used together that there is harmony. Now, go speak with Cadalind, at the guard tower, to learn of the Path of Focus. <Player>, <Player>, I know you already spoke with her, but I've not studied the path Eldritches follow.
npc_lines.Cadalind: I presume you are back to learn about the Path of Focus? I forget Cadalind knows little of this Path. Eldritches follow this Path. They believe the energy that permeates all of Hibernia, including us, its people, can be directed into a talent or ability. They focus the energy into magic, and spend all their abilities learning to control and direct that power. That is the Path they follow. Now, think well, for one day you will need to choose a Path.

A260.offer: Your service to Albion is notable! I am sure the guilds have taken notice of your [actions] this day!

A261.offer: It is time for you to make yourself known to the [guilds] in this realm.
A261.accept_line: Your service to them will dictate your fate. Are you [prepared] to [pursue] understanding at this time?
A261.finish: The Academy is Albion's tome of knowledge! From withing it's walls ushers forth untold power!
giver_turnins: Should you wish to follow its teachings, you will server as a [Paladin].
To defend the borders of this realm is no small deed! Our great army still follows the way of Arthur! In the Shadows of Camelot, all will stand equal so long as the Defenders exist!
Should you hear the calling, you shall serve as an [Armsman]!

Master Torr.pursue: Then let us begin our lesson! There are but four guild in Albion. They are the [Church of Albion], the [Defender of Albion], the [Guild of Shadows], and the [Academy].
Master Torr.Academy: Our glorious church stands eternal in the light of Camelot! Their faith strives to bring order to chaos, faith to the faithless, light where there is darkness!
Master Torr.Paladin: You wish to be a defender of the faith I take it? Many a Paladin has led our fighters into battle with victory not far behind. Their never-ending sacrifices proves that the Church of Albion will remain for many centuries! To give your life of service to the Church of Albion, seek out Lord Prydwen of Lady Triss within the city of Camelot!
Master Torr.Armsman: The Academy is Albion's tome of knowledge! From withing it's walls ushers forth untold power!

H276.offer: Oh, hello there. I don't have time to talk. I'm afraid something [bad] will happen to me.
H276.accept_line: Thank you! I will pay you whatever I can. Oh no! Here they come! Please protect me!
H276.finish: Oh, thank you for helping me. I think I should go somewhere else, until this blows over. Thank you again friend. Please, take this as a token of my appreciation. Goodbye!

Mandra.bad: I recently fell in with the [wrong crowd].
Mandra.wrong crowd: Those villainous youths out there, well, they are my friends...used to be my friends. Not really friends, though, if you ask me. We were doing some terrible things! Stealing, lying...All manner of [ill deeds]!
Mandra.ill deeds: Yes. My parents found out and I realized what I had been doing. I was so ashamed. I told the leader that I wasn't going to come back and be part of that group anymore, but she said she'd [hurt me] if I didn't stay with them.
Mandra.hurt me: I stay here because I know they won't come close to Mag Mell. They are afraid of Fagan and the guards, so I'm safe here, for the time being. But I know everyday they get [braver and braver].

M281.offer: Greetings. My name is Trustan, and I have just moved here from near Gna Faste in Myrkwood Forest. Have you been there? It is quite a pleasant place, except for [all the fighting] that goes on there.
M281.accept_line: Thank you! I will be in your debt. When I came up here, I purchased this return ticket to Gna Faste to go back and get the rest of my things. I can't use it now, but you can. Please, take it and go give it to Prulgar the Stable Master and he will give you a horse to Gna Faste. When you get there you should find Atzar at the top of the guard tower. Speak with him and tell him I sent you. Thank you! I shall await your return.
M281.finish: Ah, thank you very much! Here is a fine reward for you that I made all by myself! I'm quite a craftsman, you know. I thank you for your help with my belongings. And watch out for those svartalfs, werewolves, and arachites on your travels!
giver_turnins: I am so happy to see you. Curka sent word you were very helpful in gathering my belongings. she asked me to get a special reward for you, and I have it. But first, please, give me the pack with my belongings.
It looks like everything is here except for my helm. You don't happen to have that, do you?

Trustan.all the fighting: You haven't heard about Myrkwood? Well then listen up, friend! You must be wary of the three big groups that live there. There are the svartalfs, the arachites, and the werewolves. Each group cannot stand the others, and they have made life miserable for the folks that live in Myrkwood. They fight with each other and sometimes with us! I had enought of it and just moved here to Huginfell. I hope life here in West Svealand will be better. I just wish I had remembered to bring all [my belongings].
Trustan.my belongings: I had to leave some of my things in Gna Faste. I paid for a horse to bring me here, and since I'm not a little person, the horse couldn't carry both me and all my things. I had some friends of mine in Gna Faste hold on to the rest of the things. I would go back there and get them myslef except while I was riding up here, I kind of [fell off the horse].
Trustan.fell off the horse: I had never ridden a horse before my trip up here, and I was unsure of myself, and the horse could sense my nrevousness. I guess I should have just walked but Atzar said I'd be okay. I was almost there when something spooked the horse and it threw me to the ground. I landed on my arm and it broke. I can't ride horses until it heals, but I'd like my things. Say, you seem kind. You've listened to me tale to this point. Do you think you would help me out and [get my things] from Atzar for me? I will repay you for your kindness.

Atzar.had his belongings: There was a disagreement between the rwo werewolves, and the one left, taking some of the others with him. They came here to Myrkwood and settled into the forest, not far from here. At first, the residents if the town, <Player>, did not know of their presence. Understand that back then, the werewolves had a human form during the day. It has only been over time that they changed and assumed the form the have today. I do not know the entire story, but I know that something bad happened and it resulted in the werewolves taking over [<Player>].
Atzar.<Player>: The werewolves that live there now raise their young and let them tear up the land and terrorize the people. It was those pups that attacked me and stole Trustan's favorite sword. I know Trustan would want it back, and I'd go and get it from him, but have some other things of his to find. Trustan loaned a few of this things to another friend and I must get those things back before I can send everything up to him. Please, seek out the werewolf pups that scamper behind Gna Faste and get back Trustan's sword. Please!
Atzar.the arachites: The arachites are another group that like to cause trouble around here, but Curka can tell you more about them. Here, take this and grab a horse to Galplen. It's not far, but it can be dangerous getting there. Seek out Curka and tell her Atzar sent you for the shield. Once you have it come back to me, and then we'll send you up to Trustan!
Atzar.to recover: I'm sure Curka talked about the svartlafs when you were with her. She always talks about them and how bad they get treated. Well, I can see why they get treated that way after what they did to me! While you were away, I wanted to get a peek at what the werewolves were up to. Living so close to <Player>, it's natural to want to know what's going on. While I was out in the forest I got attacked by the svartalfs! They seemed to think I [support the werewolves].
Atzar.support the werewolves: I know where these svartalfs who attacked me like to hide. Take the road south from here until you get to the rock that directs you to Galplen. Then you need to go east into the woods. They hide way back in the woods, so be careful! Just south of there you will find a full camp of the svartalfs! If they don't like you, and they may not after you get that helm back, they will attack. Oh, before you go, give me that shield so I can pack it up.

Curka.be a problem: I don't have the shield, the arachites do. Atzar must have mentioned the arachites. They are these spidery type people that live in Myrkwood. Worst thing that ever happened to Myrkwood were those arachites. They didn't start off the way they are, you know. A very long time ago they were spiders. But Myrkwood is a dark forest, and sometimes strange things happen. The power of Myrkwood [affected those spiders].
Curka.affected those spiders: I had taken Trustan's shield over to Nalliten to show it to a friend of mine who wants to make his own shield. I went there and spent a few days helping my friend make his shield. It was on my way back that I ran into trouble. A group of arachite younglings ran out of the forest and attacked me. They screamed at me, saying those that helped the svartalfs would die. Apparently they could sense my friendship with them. I had to run or else I would have been killed. I threw Trustan's shield at them and ran for the guard tower. They picked up the shield and ran the other way. Now I fear the shield is [lost forever]
Curka.lost forever: You know, you look strong enough to handle those arachite younglings. I am not brave or strong, which is why I ran for the guards at the first sight of trouble. Please, go find these younglings and kill them for me. It is the only way to retrieve Trustan's shield, and it will set you on the raod towards building a good relationship with the svartalfs. Head out through the northeast gate and follow the road. When you reach a split in the road, keep going straight to the guard tower. At the tower, head southwest into the woods. You will find the younglings there. Return to me when you have the shield.
Curka.Atzar: Here take this ticket to Gna Faste. The horses are so much faster than walking! I shall send word to Trustan that you retrieved his shield so he can make you a nice present for your work. He's quite the craftsman! Now, hurry along to Gna Faste!

npc_lines.Atzar: You were? That's wonderful! You have solved one of the problems I was dealing with. I did not know how I was going to get his belongings to him. I heard about his adventure with the horse and do not wish to repeat it. I am not skilled at riding, and I fear I would break something too. But if you are here to collect his things, then I will not have to ride a horse. Now, if only I [had his belongings] to give to you! There was a disagreement between the rwo werewolves, and the one left, taking some of the others with him. They came here to Myrkwood and settled into the forest, not far from here. At first, the residents if the town, <Player>, did not know of their presence. Understand that back then, the werewolves had a human form during the day. It has only been over time that they changed and assumed the form the have today. I do not know the entire story, but I know that something bad happened and it resulted in the werewolves taking over [<Player>]. The werewolves that live there now raise their young and let them tear up the land and terrorize the people. It was those pups that attacked me and stole Trustan's favorite sword. I know Trustan would want it back, and I'd go and get it from him, but have some other things of his to find. Trustan loaned a few of this things to another friend and I must get those things back before I can send everything up to him. Please, seek out the werewolf pups that scamper behind Gna Faste and get back Trustan's sword. Please! It is good to see you back. Please give me Trustan's sword so I can make sure it is undamaged. Good, the sword was not damaged by those little fiends. Trustan will be happy, but he would be happier if I was able to return all his things. I received a note from Curka in Galplen. She's the one that Trustan loaned his shield to before he went to Huginfell. I need to get that shield back, but apparently Curka ran into some trouble with [the arachites] on her way here. The arachites are another group that like to cause trouble around here, but Curka can tell you more about them. Here, take this and grab a horse to Galplen. It's not far, but it can be dangerous getting there. Seek out Curka and tell her Atzar sent you for the shield. Once you have it come back to me, and then we'll send you up to Trustan! I see you have recovered the shield from Curka. Excellent. Hold on to it for now. I am almost ready to send Trustan's things to him, but there is one more thing [to recover]. I'm sure Curka talked about the svartlafs when you were with her. She always talks about them and how bad they get treated. Well, I can see why they get treated that way after what they did to me! While you were away, I wanted to get a peek at what the werewolves were up to. Living so close to <Player>, it's natural to want to know what's going on. While I was out in the forest I got attacked by the svartalfs! They seemed to think I [support the werewolves]. I know where these svartalfs who attacked me like to hide. Take the road south from here until you get to the rock that directs you to Galplen. Then you need to go east into the woods. They hide way back in the woods, so be careful! Just south of there you will find a full camp of the svartalfs! If they don't like you, and they may not after you get that helm back, they will attack. Oh, before you go, give me that shield so I can pack it up. Excellent! Now, hurry to find those svartalfs and get the helm back. I see you carry Trustan's helm. This is excellent. I have the rest of his things bundled up. Here, take them and a ticket to Huginfell and go take this stuff to him!
npc_lines.The werewolf pup: Curse all Kobold's! One day you shall feel the bite of the werewolves!
npc_lines.Curka: Hello there. Would you like to purchase something or is there something else I can do for you? The shield? What shield? OH! You mean Trustan's shield. You must have been sent by Atzar. That shield is going to [be a problem]. I don't have the shield, the arachites do. Atzar must have mentioned the arachites. They are these spidery type people that live in Myrkwood. Worst thing that ever happened to Myrkwood were those arachites. They didn't start off the way they are, you know. A very long time ago they were spiders. But Myrkwood is a dark forest, and sometimes strange things happen. The power of Myrkwood [affected those spiders]. I had taken Trustan's shield over to Nalliten to show it to a friend of mine who wants to make his own shield. I went there and spent a few days helping my friend make his shield. It was on my way back that I ran into trouble. A group of arachite younglings ran out of the forest and attacked me. They screamed at me, saying those that helped the svartalfs would die. Apparently they could sense my friendship with them. I had to run or else I would have been killed. I threw Trustan's shield at them and ran for the guard tower. They picked up the shield and ran the other way. Now I fear the shield is [lost forever] You know, you look strong enough to handle those arachite younglings. I am not brave or strong, which is why I ran for the guards at the first sight of trouble. Please, go find these younglings and kill them for me. It is the only way to retrieve Trustan's shield, and it will set you on the raod towards building a good relationship with the svartalfs. Head out through the northeast gate and follow the road. When you reach a split in the road, keep going straight to the guard tower. At the tower, head southwest into the woods. You will find the younglings there. Return to me when you have the shield. Good job! I can see that you have Trustan's shield in your pack. It's hard to hide a shield, is it not? You do not appear to have to other things that Trustan left with Atzar, so I think I better send you back to [Atzar]. Here take this ticket to Gna Faste. The horses are so much faster than walking! I shall send word to Trustan that you retrieved his shield so he can make you a nice present for your work. He's quite the craftsman! Now, hurry along to Gna Faste!
npc_lines.Aztar: Of course I don't, since they seem to want to drive everyone out of Gna Faste, but the svartalfs didn't listen when I said I didn't like werewolves. They attacked me and stole Trustan's helm from me! I swear, I'm going to pack up ,y stuff and moce to Huginfell with Trustan. I think he had the right idea. Anyway, I've for to finish packing up this stuff. You're going to have to [get the helm back] for me.
npc_lines.The svartalf: Curse you and all those that support the arachites and the werewolves!

Kyrilean.experiment: Aye, I think I have discovered a way to make comfortable and stylish armour, but I'm afraid people around here would look [down] on me if they knew what I needed to make it.
Kyrilean.down: You see those lough wolf cadgers? Their pelts make for excellent armor, if you can believe it. With this new tanning process I have been working on, it is lighter, more durable, and softer than any other [hide] I have ever worked with.
Kyrilean.hide: Therein lies my problem, <Player>. You see, there are folks here in Mag Mell that are trying to save the little beasts, if you can believe that. If they saw me kill one, they would go absolutely insane with fury. That's why I need you to [help me out].
Kyrilean.help me out: I'd like for you to get me a lough wolf cadger pelt. You are anonymous enough that no one will care. Do you think you can do that for me?
Kyrilean.item: What I need now is a rock chert from a mudman. I can use the chert to smooth out the pelt and make the leather supple. Find a mudman and get the chert for me.

npc_lines.Kyrilean: Hello, friend and welcome to my shop. You look the sturdy sort... I wonder... I don't suppose you'd be willing to help me with a little [experiment], would you? Aye, I think I have discovered a way to make comfortable and stylish armour, but I'm afraid people around here would look [down] on me if they knew what I needed to make it. You see those lough wolf cadgers? Their pelts make for excellent armor, if you can believe it. With this new tanning process I have been working on, it is lighter, more durable, and softer than any other [hide] I have ever worked with. Therein lies my problem, <Player>. You see, there are folks here in Mag Mell that are trying to save the little beasts, if you can believe that. If they saw me kill one, they would go absolutely insane with fury. That's why I need you to [help me out]. I'd like for you to get me a lough wolf cadger pelt. You are anonymous enough that no one will care. Do you think you can do that for me? Ah, my thanks to you friend. Now, hurry out there and get me that pelt. Oh, this looks like a great pelt. You've done a good job... Now I need one other [item]. What I need now is a rock chert from a mudman. I can use the chert to smooth out the pelt and make the leather supple. Find a mudman and get the chert for me. Excellent work, <Player>. You've brought me the two components I need. Here, take this coin. I hope it serves you well. Thank you again. Perhaps, once I've perfected this armor technique, I'll be able to craft some armour for you.

H283.offer: Greetings friend. I welcome you to Connla. I know this is somewhat abrupt, but I don't suppose you're looking for a little [adventure], are you?
H283.accept_line: Great! This is wonderful. I'd truly appreciate your assistance in this matter. My mother gave me a special locket with her picture inside. I have always kept it with me, until it was taken. I know one of the beach rats has it. Please find it for me.
H283.finish: Oh! My locket! How can I thank you, <Player>. I know, here are a few silver pieces for all the trouble you've gone through.
giver_turnins: Ah, you've found the necklace, but... where is the locket? Hmmm... I wonder if one of the crabs got to it... Do you think you could [check] and see if the crabs have my locket?

Tadhg.adventure: Great! I have lost something that is important to me, an item my mother gave me when I was young. It was taken from me in the middle of the night. I noticed some [footprints] outside my window the next morning.
Tadhg.footprints: Aye, they matched those of the beach rats around here, but with all that's been [happening] lately I haven't had a chance to search for it. Do you think you have the time to help me get it back?
Tadhg.check: Thanks <Player>. I know you will find the locket for me.

H289.offer: Welcome to Howth, <Player>, it's always nice to see a <Race> about. Do you [have time] to help me with a little project?
H289.accept_line: Wonderful! Here is what you must do. Out in the small grove on your way towards Ardagh live some water beetle larva. I need for you to get me the skin of one of these creatures. When you have it, return to me.
H289.finish: Oh, thank you, <Player> I know these will come in handy for my research. I hope this coin will serve you well in your coming days. Thank you again for your bravery and honesty.
giver_turnins: Ah, the skin! Thank you so much. Here is a little something for your troubles. Now, for my second item. I need the [tibia] of a skeletal pawn. It is said the magical properties of the undead have yet to be fully understood.

Troya.have time: Excellent! I have been doing some research into the local wildlife here and have come up with some rather amazing results. I have but [two more items] I need to complete my research to present to Cathbad.
Troya.two more items: Yes, are you ready to get [started]?
Troya.tibia: Yes, friend. The tibia is one of the arm bones on a person. It is thought that anything relating to the arm means strength. I would like to discern the magical properties of an undead's bone. Return to me when you have it.

M300.offer: Well, hello there. How are you enjoying Myrkwood? It's a nice place, if you can get along with the creatures that live here. Unfortunately, I can only get one group [to leave me alone] and that's the werewolves.
M300.accept_line: Excellent! I think it will really be worth your time to do what Dunfjall tell you. Now, I guess you need to know where to find him. He's been hiding out in Nalliten because he's kind of on the outs with the blodfelags right now. He's in Nalliten, hiding under the boats. When you see him, tell him that Atzar sent you and he'll be very helpful! Good luck!

Atzar.to leave me alone: I have a friend, Dunfjall, who is an expert at getting people to like him. He used to be a skald and he knows how to charm people. Well, he's spent some time studyingf the arachites, werewolves, and svartalfs and knows all their little secrets. He helped me with my werewolf problem.
