You know , he could probably [give you a hand] with one of those groups, if you're interested. The thing is, you can only improve your status with one group.
Atzar.give you a hand: It would take a little work on your part, but if you're [up to the challenge], I'm sure that Dunfjall would help you. What do you say?

Dunfjall.a problem: That happens a lot around here. People get into trouble with the svartalfs and they can't get out of it without some help. I'm that help. I know all their secrets, plus those of the arachites and werewolves. Unfortunately, if I'm popular with one group, the other two groups usually hate me until I do something for them. Then the first group hates me again. It's a never-ending cycle. One day I'll figure out how to get in good with all three groups, but until then, I'll take them one at a time. Now, it's [decision time] for you.
Dunfjall.decision time: Like I said, I don't know how to become friendly with all three groups. What you do may not make you friendly, but it will help you get close to that goal. I will also warn you now, sometimes you may need a partner to help you do the things I ask. So now, you must choose which group you want to improve your standings with. Will it be the [werewolves], the [svartalfs], or the [arachites]? Choose wisely for you may not change your mind, nor may you work with me again. I cannot reveal all my secrets to you or I would lose my place with all three groups! Now, choose.

npc_lines.Dunfjall: Yeah? What do you want? Oh, you know Atzar? He's a nice gu. He was having a problem with the werewolves and I helped him out. Is that why he sent you here? You have [a problem] with some of the creatures of the forest? That happens a lot around here. People get into trouble with the svartalfs and they can't get out of it without some help. I'm that help. I know all their secrets, plus those of the arachites and werewolves. Unfortunately, if I'm popular with one group, the other two groups usually hate me until I do something for them. Then the first group hates me again. It's a never-ending cycle. One day I'll figure out how to get in good with all three groups, but until then, I'll take them one at a time. Now, it's [decision time] for you. Like I said, I don't know how to become friendly with all three groups. What you do may not make you friendly, but it will help you get close to that goal. I will also warn you now, sometimes you may need a partner to help you do the things I ask. So now, you must choose which group you want to improve your standings with. Will it be the [werewolves], the [svartalfs], or the [arachites]? Choose wisely for you may not change your mind, nor may you work with me again. I cannot reveal all my secrets to you or I would lose my place with all three groups! Now, choose.

H304.offer: Greetings. I am Ignius, purveyor of magic and studier of magical creatures of Hibernia. I'm sure on your travels you have [seen] many of them, have you not?
H304.accept_line: Excellent! I knew you looked like the sort that could use a little coin. Here is what I need. I am currently working on a new magical item, but I am missing a few pieces. I need for you to [get the items] for me.
H304.finish: You can find the water beetle collectors near the shore by Mag Mell, to the east of here. Watch out for the water beetles, though. They may come to aid the collectors. When you have these items, return to me.

Ignius.seen: Ah, yes. There are many, aren't there? Hibernia is a realm filled with the impossible! As you age, you will see even more [fantastical] creatures, ones you never thought were possible.
Ignius.get the items: Here is what I need... First you must get a set of eirebug eyes for me. The eirebugs are on that hill, to the southeast of here. Slay one to get its eyes. Next, I will nee the carapace of a [water beetle collector].
Ignius.water beetle collector: You can find the water beetle collectors near the shore by Mag Mell, to the east of here. Watch out for the water beetles, though. They may come to aid the collectors. When you have these items, return to me.

npc_lines.Return and Ignius: Welcome back <Player>. Since you're here, I'm sure you have the items I need. Please, hand the eyes to me first.
npc_lines.Hand the eyes over and Ignius: Ah, these look exquisite! Now, hand the carapace to me please.
npc_lines.Hand the carapace over and Ignius: Wonderful! You have done a fantastic job at getting these for me. Please take this coin as a thank you for all the effor tyou went through to get me this. Maybe, in the future, we can work together again!

H305.offer: Aye, friend. Have you traveled much yet? If so, you may have encountered those strange spraggon roaming around here as of late. They are very foul tempered, not to mention they have been destroying crops and fields all around the area. Typical spraggon behavior. Right alongside assaulting travelers and stealing their goods. These three, though, they've got some [magical stuff] on them, I'd bet anything on it.

Mannix.magical stuff: Well see, these three, they aren't like the others. One's super strong, the other is said to be as quick as anything and the third is said to be quick witted. So, it's got to be magic. I bet that one of your skill could overcome these creatures. I bet you could overcome one of them in their lair, if you're [interested]. So, I'm telling you, you kill one of these spraggon, there's bound to be praise, and a prize.

Tethra.many more: Have you their heads then? I will pay you for each head, friend, if you give them to me. Or have you [no more heads]? You have done a great thing in killing these spraggon. They are horrible. They run through the land, tearing up good fields, destroying.
Tethra.no more heads: There is said to be an item of magical enchantment on the spraggon you killed, the large one. You didn't mention it. Perhaps you didn't find it? He may have hidden it somewhere. That's what they normally do. Could you please search for this enchanted item? I have a personal interest in it. I believe it would be hidden by the bridge on the road to Druim Ligen.

npc_lines.Tethra: Yes then, there are some that seem to posess (sic) this strange ability to grow in size, though I'm told not many can. I suppose it matters not. You're a brave (character class), to have defeated this infamous spraggon. Have you defeated [many more]? Have you their heads then? I will pay you for each head, friend, if you give them to me. Or have you [no more heads]? You have done a great thing in killing these spraggon. They are horrible. They run through the land, tearing up good fields, destroying. There is said to be an item of magical enchantment on the spraggon you killed, the large one. You didn't mention it. Perhaps you didn't find it? He may have hidden it somewhere. That's what they normally do. Could you please search for this enchanted item? I have a personal interest in it. I believe it would be hidden by the bridge on the road to Druim Ligen. Thank you, <Player>. The spraggon have been unusually villianous (sic), and I mean to find out why. This may help us. Good day to you, <Player>, and please, consider spraggon hunting a sport. You're quite good at it.

M307.offer: I am so glad you have come to me. You see, I hve an [amazing story] for you.
M307.accept_line: Last I heard he was studying texts found in Audliten.

Trainer.amazing story: There was once a time, long ago when this world was ruled by the hands of the gods. Oh yes, the Aesir and Jotun were very prevalent in this day in age. It was a time of myth and legend, young one. For I can see it in my visions. My visions extend long into the past, during [ancient] times, and I see into the murky future. For it is our past and our future that make us who we are.
Trainer.ancient: I see a man, wearing priestly garb, he is holding a great staff and waving it. For which direction the staff points is uncertain. If waved at the field, that field grow. If waved at an opposition there is ending. However the direction the staff points now is uncertain. It is lost to me, even though there may be great suffering or great joy this staff must be found. I do not know what it mean, [my visions] of this time are so fuzzy.
Trainer.my visions: Perhaps the scholar Gorne can make sense of these visions. Please, [find him]. He may be the only person who can unravel this mystery for me.

M308.offer: Do you know that the famous trapper [Wariel] is here in town from Fort Atla?
M308.accept_line: Find Wariel and see if she would be willing to teach you a few secrets of trapping.

Krek.Wariel: She is quite well known throughout the area and it would benefit you to [learn] the secrets of trapping.

Wariel.realm: Did you know that the [art] of trapping is very important here in Midgard, for everyone?
Wariel.art: Yes, [trapping] is an art, the skinning of an animal, preserving the pelt and tanning it for use.
Wariel.trapping: Trapping and doing these things correctly can [fetch] you a good deal of popularity to traders and bring in a nice profit.
Wariel.fetch: Go in to woods and see if yo ucan capture fice tawny lynx cubs and bring their pelts to me so that I may prepare them.
Wariel.job: I shall begin preserving and tanning these skins shortly. Once they are finished tanning I may have another job for you.

npc_lines.Wariel: Well hello young one. What is your <Player>? Well, it is a pleasure to meet you. I enjoy meeting all the young Vikings throughoout our [realm]. Did you know that the [art] of trapping is very important here in Midgard, for everyone? Yes, [trapping] is an art, the skinning of an animal, preserving the pelt and tanning it for use. Trapping and doing these things correctly can [fetch] you a good deal of popularity to traders and bring in a nice profit. Go in to woods and see if yo ucan capture fice tawny lynx cubs and bring their pelts to me so that I may prepare them. You have done a wonderful [job] and these pelts will work quite nicely. I shall begin preserving and tanning these skins shortly. Once they are finished tanning I may have another job for you.

A315.offer: Ah <Player>! You have returned and just in time as well. We have prepared our case and are prepared to leavel for Camelot. We wish your journey to Camelot and inform our Scribe Veral of our wish to lend support to Barfog. Take this as proof of our [intentions]. We will be along shortly.
A315.accept_line: <Player>! You have done us the greatest of services! These Arawnites have caused us nothing but trouble since you dispatched Sir Dillus. Sir Bors can offer nothing that would fully repay the debt you have fashioned this day. Let this (reward) be the start of what little we have to offer. In time we shall find greater reward for your deeds and when that time comes, we shall once again call upon (prof name) and thier most cunning (class name)!

Scribe Veral.local report: Yes! There is news that Bors is a target for assassination. The report does not specify who will attempt the deed, only that it will be attempted soon. I will take your case before King Constantine, but you must return with haste, and assist in thwarting this treachery!

npc_lines.Scribe Veral: Hail traveler! How may I be of service to you? You are from Sir Bors? How can it be you have not see* the [local report] yet? Yes! There is news that Bors is a target for assassination. The report does not specify who will attempt the deed, only that it will be attempted soon. I will take your case before King Constantine, but you must return with haste, and assist in thwarting this treachery!
npc_lines.The Arawnite Assassin: Fool! Did you think it was Bors I was after? He is much too hard a target for us at this time. You will prove to be a much easier catch and might I add, a most humorous trophy! I thank thee for the help into the darkness of death. My endurance of life has been paid in full! Peace beckons!

A317.offer: Good day to you. I don't really have time to tell [the tale] again. Perhaps you could return later?
A317.accept_line: There is a wizard who may be able to assist you. Master Kless has studied the druids at much length and often leads students in instruction. If you travel into Cotswold you can find his within the dye shop. I must get back to my cleaning now. We sometimes have problems with pixies and they get into everything. Best of luck to you.

Vadri Pade.the tale: You do not know of the [druid tale]?
Vadri Pade.druid tale: Ah well I suppose to could be persuaded to speak it one last time. Have a seat and let us begin.
Vadri Pade.Druids: Yes! These priests are the very same that walk our lands once again. During the time of Arillius and Uther the push to rid our land of the Celts almost succeeded. Yet tolerance became the motive of Uther during his later years and was adopted by ARthur as well. This tolerance has unfortunately led to our current [predicament].
Vadri Pade.predicament: Have you not seen the druids that are encroaching into our area? One need not walk more than half-day to encounter them. These are our lands regardless of their attachment to the [standing stones]!
Vadri Pade.standing stones: The druids have long practiced their pagan arts in and about these stones. I know not where the stones originated, but the druid fascination over them increases with each generation. I can only assume they believe the stones to contain some holy power. It must be this false belief that ties them to our lands. You seem [quite enthralled] by these druids. If you wish I could direct you to someone who would speak in more depth of this subject?

Master Kless.new and old: Yes! While both still practice the basic paths taught them generations ago, it is the newest of druids that seek to reclaim that which they lost so long ago. Their hold on Salisbury and parts of the Campacorentin Forest are proof of this. Some have actually pressed into the Black Mountains seeking to claim land closer and closer to Camelot. There are many within our realm that now fight to ensure this spread will not continue. I know three thta keeps tabs upon the very movement of these druids and research their history in depth. Though I fear this will do [little to assist] us now, I am certain it will allow us to take greater action in the future.
Master Kless.little to assist: Already we are having difficulty in stopping the druids to our north. They gain greater courage the closer they come to Camelot. Unlike the [druids of old] that held land for a generation or so before moving on, these fruids move with blazing speed. Their thirst to reclaim all that was taken from them seems never to be filled.
Master Kless.druids of old: From what I've learned, once their priest had taken Keltoi as their primary place of learning the druidic spread all but stopped. They turned their attention to developing a culture within our lands and building places of worship. Now it seems these druids press into our realm as if on act of vengeance. Their only goal is to secure all land that was once their own regardless of the [bloodshed].
Master Kless.bloodshed: You should witness this for yourself. To be told the deeds of these people is nothing compared to actually experiencing their wrath first hand. If you would be willing to travel into the black mountains and [slay a sacrificer] I will reward you.
Master Kless.slay a sacrificer: That's correct! Bring me the sacrificer's dagger as well. I believe the hill they occupy is just north of the double bridge. Best of luck to thee.

npc_lines.Master Kless: Good day to you! A question appears to hang about your lips. What can I instruct you in? Ah! The druids of [new and old] hold quite a bit of history my friend. I would be glad to detail a bit of it for you if you wish? Yes! While both still practice the basic paths taught them generations ago, it is the newest of druids that seek to reclaim that which they lost so long ago. Their hold on Salisbury and parts of the Campacorentin Forest are proof of this. Some have actually pressed into the Black Mountains seeking to claim land closer and closer to Camelot. There are many within our realm that now fight to ensure this spread will not continue. I know three thta keeps tabs upon the very movement of these druids and research their history in depth. Though I fear this will do [little to assist] us now, I am certain it will allow us to take greater action in the future. Already we are having difficulty in stopping the druids to our north. They gain greater courage the closer they come to Camelot. Unlike the [druids of old] that held land for a generation or so before moving on, these fruids move with blazing speed. Their thirst to reclaim all that was taken from them seems never to be filled. From what I've learned, once their priest had taken Keltoi as their primary place of learning the druidic spread all but stopped. They turned their attention to developing a culture within our lands and building places of worship. Now it seems these druids press into our realm as if on act of vengeance. Their only goal is to secure all land that was once their own regardless of the [bloodshed]. You should witness this for yourself. To be told the deeds of these people is nothing compared to actually experiencing their wrath first hand. If you would be willing to travel into the black mountains and [slay a sacrificer] I will reward you. That's correct! Bring me the sacrificer's dagger as well. I believe the hill they occupy is just north of the double bridge. Best of luck to thee.

M318.offer: A good hardy welcome to you. I am Eske, one of the local guards here in Audilten. It's good to see some sturdy fold come through here. Hehe. I don't suppose you've come here for a little [adventure], have you?
M318.accept_line: Well! Just my luck, and yours too, then. I am missing something very important to me. Perhaps you can [find her].
M318.finish: My thanks to you, for helping me with this. I am glad to know what has happened to my Bluebell. I will bury her behind Audliten this eve. Please take this coin as a token of my gratitude to you. Good luck in your future journeys.
giver_turnins: Oh, my beautiful Bluebell. How I will miss her! At least now I know what has happened to her. Thank you. Can you do me one last [favor]?

Dwarven Guard Eske.find her: Now, don't laugh at me when I tell you my story, alright? You see, I am a tough and rough dwarven guard. I've seen my share of trouble, made my share of trouble, and killed more Albions and Hibernians than you can count to! But I have a [pet].
Dwarven Guard Eske.pet: This is no ordinary pet, as we hardly live in an ordinary land! I have a bird, a special bird, one I rescued after a large Hibernian raid on our fair land. We managed to chase off the invaders and while I was helping to tend the wounded, I [saw her].
Dwarven Guard Eske.saw her: She had been struck down by a filthy ranger's bow. Her wing was torn in two, and she was hoping furiously on the ground. She was so sad looking that it touched my stone heart. I scooped her up and made a soft place for her in my [pack].
Dwarven Guard Eske.pack: When I returned to Jordheim and was awaiting my new orders, I nursed her back to health. She stayed with me everywhere I went. She was a beautiful color blue, like the ocean! I called her [Bluebell].
Dwarven Guard Eske.Bluebell: I tried to release Bluebell into the wild many times before my transfer was in order, but she would only look at me confused. She was my favorite thing ever! But when I came to Audliten [disaster] stuck!
Dwarven Guard Eske.disaster: I had let Bluebell out for her morning flying, and she never came back. I fear something dreadful has happened to her, and I am very upset. But I can?t leave my post to search for her. Could you please help me find my [lost Bluebell]?
Dwarven Guard Eske.lost Bluebell: Many thanks to you. To the east of here is where she flew off to. I know there is a nasty smiera-gatto that lurks around there. If she has indeed perished, please return her remains to me.
Dwarven Guard Eske.favor: Trapper Jora had been working on a special ornamental box I could keep Bluebell in when I traveled. I think I will use it now to bury her in. Could you please take this note to Jora and get the box for me? I will be here when you return.

npc_lines.Trapper Jora: Greetings, what can I do for you? I see. This is terribly sad news. I know Eske was very attached to the bird. Ah, such is the way of nature. Here, take this box back to him so he may give Bluebell the burial she deserves.

M319.offer: Tomtes, tomtes, tomtes! I'll be so glad if I never see another [tomte] in my life!
M319.accept_line: You seemed to have fared better with the tomtes than I have. Were you able to get the key from hem? My wife came by while you were gone and wanted to get something out of the chest, but I was able to distract her. Please, give me the key now.
M319.finish: This is a nice ring I have for you. I received it from a shadowblade that grew too old to use it anymore. She traded for a crop of turnips! Anyway, use it well, and come back and see me soon!
giver_turnins: Thank you. Now, this key will do me no good unless you were able to locate the chest of jewels in my house. Please give me the chest now.

I am in your debt. You have saved me from hearing my wife rant and rave about having lost both the key and the box. I would like to know who provoked the tomtes to turn on me. I am going to try to find out more as to why they changed. I may have need of your services again soon.. Until then, I have the perfect reward for you. This chest is filled with many wonderful things I've collected over the years and I am more than willing to give you one of the trinkets I have in here. I just need to know [something from you].
I received this belt from a warrior who had grown too old to use it. It's good for anyone who needs a little extra strength. Use it well, and come back and see me soon!

Thorgil.tomte: I'm sorry for the outburst, but these tomtes continue to frustrate me. At one time, the tomtes were actually friendly but now all they do is cause trouble and heartache for the races of Midgard. But you don't want to hear an old man complain about some pests, do you? No one wants to hear about the problem I must now solve because of them. I'm sure you have better things to do. One day I will find someone [willing to listen] to my story and give me a had with my tomte problem.
Thorgil.willing to listen: What? You want to hear my story? I shall be in your debt for just that small favor you grant me now. I am a farmer, or at least I was. I once worked the land not far down the road from here. My house still stands there, but it is infested by those vile creature, the tomtes. But as I said, they weren't always that way. A very long time ago, they [became friendly] with the first settlers that moved into this region.
Thorgil.became friendly: When the first settlers came to this land, the first creatures they encountered were the tomtes. No one had ever seen the strange little men before and were unsure of how they would react to the settlers. The settlers watched the tomtes from afar and observed that they were rather crafty when it came to building things. The settlers, new to the land, knew they would need the help of the tomtes if they were to survive. But the tomtes were unsure of these invaders and they [refused] to have anything to do with the settlers.
Thorgil.refused: It was completely by accident that the tomtes ended up helping the settlers. One of the settlers had left a freshly baked loaf of bread cooling beside the camp fire while she went off into the woods to collect some more firewood. While she was gone, one of the tomtes crept into the camp and tried the strange food. The bread was like nothing he had tasted before and he wanted more. He noticed the water skins of the woman were empty, and he took them and [refilled them].
Thorgil.refilled them: The woman was very surprised when she came back to find here bread gone but here water skins filled. That night, out of curiosity, she left more bread out, along with a broken cooking pan and went to sleep. In the morning she found the bread gone but the pan fixed. She told the other settlers about it, and they did the same thing, with the same results. Leaving bread would result in some chore being done, but no one was sure [who was doing] the chores.
Thorgil.who was doing: The settlers set up a watch and discovered that the tomtes were the ones helping them. The settlers continued to leave bread and other things for the tomtes as they began to farm the land and the tomtes seemed to accept that these few people would be sharing the land with them. They even began to adopt certain farms, including my ancestor's farm. But then more people starting settling in the area, and soon it became [very crowded] for the tomtes.
Thorgil.very crowded: As more people moved in and took up the land, the tomtes were pushed to smaller and smaller areas and the original settlers over time forgot about their little tomte friends. The tomtes grew angry and began to do malicious things to the people living in and around here. Some of us were lucky enough to keep the good favor of the tomtes. My ancestor was one of those people, and up until recently I had tomtes helping myself and my family with our chores but one day that [all changed].
Thorgil.all changed: The tomtes that we had been friendly with suddenly turned vicious, destroying things, hurting my family, tearing up my fields, and hurting the animals I kept. We tried to appease them with bread and other things, but they would take nothing we offered. We stayed as long as we could, but when they attacked my wife and daughter, it was enough. We gathered up everything we could and fled here to Audliten. My wife is currently in Jordheim visiting her sister, and my daughter is off playing somewhere. I remain here to keep an [eye on things].
Thorgil.eye on things: Don't tell my wife this, but when we fled, I left our chest of jewels and money there in the house. I didn't mean to, but we left in such a hurry. I'd go back and get it, but I will not leave my daughter and I cannot take her with me, because the tomtes have overrun the house. I need you to go into the house and get the chest I've hidden there. It's filled with all the treasured things I own. I also need you to do [one other thing] for me.
Thorgil.one other thing: I seem to have lost the key to the chest. As we fled the house, I slipped it into my pocket for safe keeping, but I think it fell out when a tomte grabbed my leg and made me fall. I remember hearing something metal hit the wooden floor of the porch, but I didn't have time to look. The tomte [scavengers] were hurting me, so I just got up and ran for my life. Please, go to my old house and recover my chest of jewels. Once I have it and the key, I will open the box and give you something nice from it. My farm is not far from here. Go east down the road and over the stone bridge. The house lies on the south side of the road. Please, get the key and search the house for the chest. Thank you.
Thorgil.something from you: Would you like something that would add to you [magical power], your [strength], your [dexterity] or your skill with a [sword]? I can only give you one, so think carefully before you make your choice.
Thorgil.sword: Ah, that's a very good choice. I received this bracelet from a woman of great magical power. I know it you will make good use of it. Come back to me soon!

npc_lines.The tomte scavenger: Ha-ha! You thought I had the key but I don't! I gave it to another when I saw you approach! Try again! Oh no! You found the key! A (your class here) found the key! No no no!

M320.offer: So, I walked over to Hulda the shield merchant and spoke with her. She didn't know much either, but she told me about her cousins. Ever since their sister was attacked as a child by the tomtes, they have watched them and learned everything about them. Hulda told me that they would help me learn more about why the tomtes had turned on me. But I [ran into a problem].
M320.accept_line: So, Smack is behind all this mess, is he? I hope you were able to take care of him. If he's gone, perhaps I can move back to my farm and go back to the life I enjoyed. Please, give me proof that you were able to rid this world of Smack.
M320.finish: A staff, eh? Then take this leg bone Eirik here in Audliten and he shall make it into a staff for you. Thank you, and keep an ear out for my call, I may have need of you again!
giver_turnins: I will gather a few friends and we will go out and see if we can reclaim my farm now and hopefully soon my family can move back into our home. Speaking of friends, I have a few who would be able to turn this rather nice bone into a nice weapon for you. I just need to know who to send you to. Since there's only one bone, you can only pick one. Would you like a [sword], an [axe], a [hammer], a [bow], a [spear], or a [staff] for those that use magic?

Thorgil.ran into a problem: Hulda's cousins don't live here in Audliten. They are out in the wilds of East Svealand, studying the tomtes. I can't just up and leave here to work with them especially since I just started working with Inga the arrow merchant. I needed a way to support my family, so I spoke with Inga and she agreed to teach me how to make arrows. That's why I'm glad [you've come back] to visit me.
Thorgil.you've come back: I thought perhaps you could go and speak to the brothers and learn about the tomtes. Hulda told me she would let them what has happened to me and what I wanted to know. I was hoping I could [count on you] to give me help with this problem like you did with my lost chest of jewels. If you help me, I'm sure I can find something nice for you in the chest. Well, what do you say?
Thorgil.staff: You cannot use a bow, <Player>. Perhaps a <Player> like you would prefer a nice [staff]?

Hulda.information: I thought so! I figured Thorgil would have to send someone in his place, since I've heard others say that Inga has begun teaching him the art of making and selling arrows. I was very sorry to hear that Thorgil has lost his farm to the tomtes. I was so busy selling shields that I hadn't had a chance to get over and speak with him about what happened. I was glad when he came in here the other day [to ask me] about the tomtes.
Hulda.to ask me: I don't know much, but as Thorgil probably told you, my cousins do. When Thorgil came to me, I couldn't say no to his plea for help. I went and visited each of my brothers and told them of Thorgil's situation. They were both very intrigued by the whole thing, for they have been watching the tomtes around here for many years. Both said they recently observed some changes in [the tomtes' behaviour].
Hulda.the tomtes' behaviour: They both spent a few days watching the tomtes and then trying to make sense of what they saw. I recently received word from both of them, telling me who Thorgil should speak to. But since you are helping Thorgil, I shall tell you [which of my cousins] to speak to.
Hulda.which of my cousins: Both sent me word that they think Edvard would be the best one to help Thorgil. He has noticed some happenings around the tomte camps he watches that his brother Emmerick hasn't noticed. Most people don't know where Edvard likes to hide so I shall tell you. Go across the stone bridge northeast of here to the guard tower. You will find him on the top most level. Take care in climbong the ladders, they can be tricky! Remember to tell him Thorgil sent you!

Edvard Averrson.specific attacks: I believe that the tomtes are trying to find a way to push the people of Audliten and its surrounding area off the lands that once belonged to the tomtes. As more people have moved into the area, the tomtes have been pushed to smaller and smaller areas. There are only a few camps left around here, and because of that ,the residents around here have grown to think the tomtes have moved on or disappeard from this world. But that is [far from the truth]!
Edvard Averrson.far from the truth: The tomtes needed a place that wouldn't be taken over by the residents of the area. They searched and found a cave not far from where my brother watches them. They are crafty little men, and began to carve out a home for themselves under the earth. They worked quickly, and soon their new home was ready. Led by the strongest of the tomtes, <Player>, most of them left their lands and headed deep underground. Now, some people believe that the tomtes in the camps around here don't like dank surroundings of the cave, but that isn ot true. There is [another reason] they live above ground.
Edvard Averrson.another reason: All this time the tomtes have been planning ways to remove the inhabitants of Audliten and the surrounding areas and reclaim them for their own. The tomtes that live in the camps above ground are the eyes and ears for <Player> and report back everything they see. Recently I've noticed more messengers heading down from the north, yet my brother has not noticed and unusual activity around the entrance to the tomte caves. That has led us both to believe [someone else] is behind this plot to drive Thorgil and the others from this area off their land.
Edvard Averrson.someone else: I've noticed many messengers heading in and out of the camp of Edigo. It's my guess that something is going on and he knows about it. I've watched Edigo for some time now and I know he is plotting something. Most likely he's kept the messages that have been sent to him. You must get those messages so we can figure out what is going on and who is sending them. Edigo's camp is not far off from here. Head back through Audliten and take the road east out of town. Go over the stone bridge and keep going until you see the wooden tower. It's not far from Thorgil's old house. You will find Edigo there, but do not go alone! The other tomtes will anwer Edigo's call for help. Return to me when you have any messages. [Step #4] Slay Edigo and obtain any tomte messages. Go through Audliten and head east out of town. Cross the stone bridge and continue to the wooden tower near Thorgil's farm house. (Note: Another possible path for step 4: "Slay Ocug to obtain the tomte messages. To find him, swim across the river beside the guard tower, then head east up the coast to the tomte camp. Do not face Ocug alone!
Edvard Averrson.Step #4: I am impressed. I watched over your battle with the tomtes from here and I liked what I saw. Thorgil did well in selecting you to help him. Now, let's see the messages you obtained.
Edvard Averrson.eager to succeed: A long time ago, Smack displeased <Player> and was forced to leave the tomte caves and live among the races of Midgard. Since then, he has been working to get back into <Player>'s good graces. It seems that he thinks if he can clear the land of invaders, as he sees them, then <Player> will be pleased and restore him to the position he once held. It appears that SMack has recruited Edigo to help in his plot. But now that Edigo is dead, Smack will try to recruit another of the tomtes. You must [stop Smack]!
Edvard Averrson.stop Smack: Gather your forces and lead t hem to Smack's stronghold. You must stop him from contacting any of the other camp leaders. Smack's stronghold isn't hard to find. Take the road east out of Audliten again, and cross the stone bridge. Continue down the road until you see a small stone fort to the southeast. That is where you will find Smack. While you are off dealing with Smack, I shall send word to Thorgil of what you are doing. Return to him when you are finished with Smack.

npc_lines.Hulda: Hail and well met! You look like a (your class here) with a purpose for coming here. I don't think you seek a shield, but perhaps [information]? I thought so! I figured Thorgil would have to send someone in his place, since I've heard others say that Inga has begun teaching him the art of making and selling arrows. I was very sorry to hear that Thorgil has lost his farm to the tomtes. I was so busy selling shields that I hadn't had a chance to get over and speak with him about what happened. I was glad when he came in here the other day [to ask me] about the tomtes. I don't know much, but as Thorgil probably told you, my cousins do. When Thorgil came to me, I couldn't say no to his plea for help. I went and visited each of my brothers and told them of Thorgil's situation. They were both very intrigued by the whole thing, for they have been watching the tomtes around here for many years. Both said they recently observed some changes in [the tomtes' behaviour]. They both spent a few days watching the tomtes and then trying to make sense of what they saw. I recently received word from both of them, telling me who Thorgil should speak to. But since you are helping Thorgil, I shall tell you [which of my cousins] to speak to. Both sent me word that they think Edvard would be the best one to help Thorgil. He has noticed some happenings around the tomte camps he watches that his brother Emmerick hasn't noticed. Most people don't know where Edvard likes to hide so I shall tell you. Go across the stone bridge northeast of here to the guard tower. You will find him on the top most level. Take care in climbong the ladders, they can be tricky! Remember to tell him Thorgil sent you!
npc_lines.Edvard Averrson: Yes? Is there something I can do for you? I am rather busy, and I am also waiting for someone. Oh he did? Well then, you are the one I am waiting for. My cousin Hulda said that Thorgil was having problems with the tomtes. I wasn't surprised to hear it, because I have been watching them and I have noticed a change in their behavior lately. Most of the time they just pester people traveling along the road or thos that stray too close to the camps. But as I watched, I noticed that the tomtes were organizing [specific attacks]. I believe that the tomtes are trying to find a way to push the people of Audliten and its surrounding area off the lands that once belonged to the tomtes. As more people have moved into the area, the tomtes have been pushed to smaller and smaller areas. There are only a few camps left around here, and because of that ,the residents around here have grown to think the tomtes have moved on or disappeard from this world. But that is [far from the truth]! The tomtes needed a place that wouldn't be taken over by the residents of the area. They searched and found a cave not far from where my brother watches them. They are crafty little men, and began to carve out a home for themselves under the earth. They worked quickly, and soon their new home was ready. Led by the strongest of the tomtes, <Player>, most of them left their lands and headed deep underground. Now, some people believe that the tomtes in the camps around here don't like dank surroundings of the cave, but that isn ot true. There is [another reason] they live above ground. All this time the tomtes have been planning ways to remove the inhabitants of Audliten and the surrounding areas and reclaim them for their own. The tomtes that live in the camps above ground are the eyes and ears for <Player> and report back everything they see. Recently I've noticed more messengers heading down from the north, yet my brother has not noticed and unusual activity around the entrance to the tomte caves. That has led us both to believe [someone else] is behind this plot to drive Thorgil and the others from this area off their land. I've noticed many messengers heading in and out of the camp of Edigo. It's my guess that something is going on and he knows about it. I've watched Edigo for some time now and I know he is plotting something. Most likely he's kept the messages that have been sent to him. You must get those messages so we can figure out what is going on and who is sending them. Edigo's camp is not far off from here. Head back through Audliten and take the road east out of town. Go over the stone bridge and keep going until you see the wooden tower. It's not far from Thorgil's old house. You will find Edigo there, but do not go alone! The other tomtes will anwer Edigo's call for help. Return to me when you have any messages. [Step #4] Slay Edigo and obtain any tomte messages. Go through Audliten and head east out of town. Cross the stone bridge and continue to the wooden tower near Thorgil's farm house. (Note: Another possible path for step 4: "Slay Ocug to obtain the tomte messages. To find him, swim across the river beside the guard tower, then head east up the coast to the tomte camp. Do not face Ocug alone! I am impressed. I watched over your battle with the tomtes from here and I liked what I saw. Thorgil did well in selecting you to help him. Now, let's see the messages you obtained. It's good you brought these to me. They happen to be written in the ancient language of the tomtes, and my brother and I are experts at reading and writing it. It seems that Edigo has been following orders to drive the inhabitants of Audliten and the surrounding areas away and reclaim the land. I'm not surprised to see that the orders were issued by Smack. He has always been [eager to succeed]. A long time ago, Smack displeased <Player> and was forced to leave the tomte caves and live among the races of Midgard. Since then, he has been working to get back into <Player>'s good graces. It seems that he thinks if he can clear the land of invaders, as he sees them, then <Player> will be pleased and restore him to the position he once held. It appears that SMack has recruited Edigo to help in his plot. But now that Edigo is dead, Smack will try to recruit another of the tomtes. You must [stop Smack]! Gather your forces and lead t hem to Smack's stronghold. You must stop him from contacting any of the other camp leaders. Smack's stronghold isn't hard to find. Take the road east out of Audliten again, and cross the stone bridge. Continue down the road until you see a small stone fort to the southeast. That is where you will find Smack. While you are off dealing with Smack, I shall send word to Thorgil of what you are doing. Return to him when you are finished with Smack.
npc_lines.Edigo: You so mean! You hurt Edigo and tomtes! We get you! Tomtes get you! You steal messages but you not stral our land!
npc_lines.Smack: So you figure out Smack's plot! Smack will stop you from sharing with Audliten! Die (your race here)! You may stop Smack, but tomtes will have land back one day!
npc_lines.Eirik: Here is your staff, and a fine one it is for a <Player> like you! Use it well, and smash any tomtes you may come across! Thank you!

M321.offer: My daughter is gone! I know I've spoken of her before. Thorhalla is the sweetest little girl and her mother and I love her very much. She went outside to visit the merchants yesterday like she always does, but when it began to grow dark, she didn't come home. I thought that perhaps she was staying with Hulda or Josli, so I went to visit both of them. Neither of them had seen Thorhalla since the middle of the day. That's when I [started to worry]
M321.accept_line: Thank you. Here, take the note that was left. After talking with Hulda, she said that Emmerick would be best to help with this matter. He's in a guard tower down the road. Go east out of town and across both the stone bridge and the rope bridge. He's at the top of the tower, watching the tomtes. Be careful on those ladders! Hulda says they can be tricky. Please, get my daughter back!
M321.finish: Here is your Tomte Skin Bracelet. I got this from old Dielf over there. He said he made it a long time ago from the skin of a tomte shaman. Try it on, I know it will look good on you! Thank you again. Let's hope I won't need your help again, but id I should ever call, I know you will answer!
giver_turnins: Thank you! I cannot say that enough! My daughter returned to me just as my wife arrived from Jordheim. After a brief reunion, she took Thorhalla off to Jordheim where she will be safe until the problem with the tomtes is resolved. I told my wife I would be giving you something from our [chest of jewels], and she supported the idea completely, for no price is too high for the safety of our child.

Thorgil.started to worry: Hulda and Josli helped me ask all of the others in Audliten if they has seen Thorhalla, but no one had seen her since the middle of the day. With one last hope, I headed home, thinking she was hiding somewhere in the house, playing a trick on me. I searched all around but I couldn't find her. All I found was a note written in [a strange language] hidden under the bed.
Thorgil.a strange language: No one around here could read it, but Hulda recognized it. She said that is was tomte writing and that her cousins could read it. I'd go take it to one of them, but I'm afraid to leave the house in case Thorhalla should come back. I would hate to have her find the house empty, since her mother is on her way back from Jordheim. Please, I need your help to [find my daughter]. I feel the tomtes are involved in her disappearance.
Thorgil.chest of jewels: Let's see what I have in here. I have a [bracelet] that adds to your magical power, a [ring] that adds to your general well-being, a [necklace] that adds to your devotion, a [bracer] that will make you quite nimble, and a [mirror] that will show just how attractive you are. Choose carefully!
Thorgil.mirror: Here is your Tomte Skin Bracelet. I got this from old Dielf over there. He said he made it a long time ago from the skin of a tomte shaman. Try it on, I know it will look good on you! Thank you again. Let's hope I won't need your help again, but id I should ever call, I know you will answer!

Emmerick Averrson.are saying: Some of them speak the common tongue we all speak, but most of them speak their own language. My cousin Edvard and I have enchanted different pieces of jewelry that allow the wearer to understand the language of the tomtes. Wear this at all times when you enter the [lair of Nisse]. Once you enter the lair, seek out the handler Nioll. Hopefully he will have some clue that will lead you to Thorhalla.
Emmerick Averrson.lair of Nisse: So you have returned. I'm glad to see you made it out alive. I saw Thorhalla come running out of Nisse's Lair and head back toward Aedliten. Her father will be very pleased that you were able to save the young girl. Now, I wish I could allow you to keep the tomte tooth earring I gave you, but alas, I cannot. Please give it to me now.

npc_lines.Emmerick Averrson: Hello there. My cousin Hulda said Thorgil was going to ask you for help again. I'm glad to see you agreed, for from what Hulda says, Thorgil and his daughter Thorhalla are both very nice people. Hulda sent word that Thorgil found a note written in the tomte language. Let me see it so I can read it. blah blah and they won't return her until Thorgil pays them for the loss of Smack or they may demand that the people of Audliten abandon the town in exchange for the girl. I don't want to think of the other possibility. you must find out what has become of Thorgil's daughter Thorhalla. To do that, you must be able to understand what the tomtes [are saying]. Some of them speak the common tongue we all speak, but most of them speak their own language. My cousin Edvard and I have enchanted different pieces of jewelry that allow the wearer to understand the language of the tomtes. Wear this at all times when you enter the [lair of Nisse]. Once you enter the lair, seek out the handler Nioll. Hopefully he will have some clue that will lead you to Thorhalla. So you have returned. I'm glad to see you made it out alive. I saw Thorhalla come running out of Nisse's Lair and head back toward Aedliten. Her father will be very pleased that you were able to save the young girl. Now, I wish I could allow you to keep the tomte tooth earring I gave you, but alas, I cannot. Please give it to me now. Thank you. Why, what's that you have? Is that a book you obtained in Nisse's Lair? Please, let me see it! I have been trying to obtain anything the tomtes have written. Hopefully it will be something I can use to aid in the fight against the tomtes. This is a treasure you have brought me! This is the Executioner's log and it contains a list of people he has executed and many orders from Misse himself, as well as future plans for the tomtes. Ny brother and I cannot thank you enough for bringing us this. Please, take this coin and use it to buy yourself something nice. I must go study this and you must go check on Thorhalla. Head back up to Audliten and speak with Thorgil.
npc_lines.Nioll: Invader! I know you are sent here to get the girl! You shall never get her! Too bad I don't have to girl! Captor Rygnol has her now!
npc_lines.Rygnol: Executioner! Prepare the girl while I deal with this invader! We shall show all (race here) how we deal with them! Executioner! Do not let my death pass in vain! Do your duty to Nisse and execute this invader and the girl!
npc_lines.The Executioner: No! How could you defeat me? May Nisse bring about your destruction! Flee now before he come for you!

Gral Bermorn.switch: As the last rays of light fade from Salisbury, travel to each major druid ring and make use of your crystal. The crystal will be crushed in the process and will activate the ring's well. As Morgana's power has hold of the tombs below these rings, I am unsure what the mix of necromantic power and ley energy will have upon you and the circle itself. Be prepared for anything! If you find yourself without a ley crystal return to a minor circle and use the darkenstone to gain another. If you are foolish enough to lose your darkenstone, you may return to the [ axis circle ] and kill a skeleton to obtain another.
Gral Bermorn.axis circle: All seven of the wells can only be activated using darkness. If dawn arrives and you have not visited all seven you must wait till the next night to complete the ritual. When you have established the alignment of these ley lines, travel to the heart of Stonehenge and use your darkenstone for the final time. Upon the stone's destruction the bonds that tie the portal close should ignite and allow it to be [ opened from the other side ].
Gral Bermorn.opened from the other side: You must be ready for Glasan at this point. When the arch druid arrives, you will have little time to attack him, as his power will grow quickly. If you are successful in slaying him, the staff should shatter on its own. Any shards left from the battle must be returned to me! Here, take these instructions to aid you. Good luck to thee Theurgist.

npc_lines.Gral Bermorn: Within Salisbury there exist eleven druid circles, eight major, three minor, and the axis circle where you obtained the darkenstone. Of the three minor circles, one lay in the south and two in the north. All others can be considered major including Stonehenge itself. If a darkenstone is taken into any of these circles, the holder will be made aware if it is major or minor. Each of the minor circles can be instructed to offer up a ley crystal by using the darkenstone. It will be the ley crystal that will allow you to [ switch ] the wells on. As the last rays of light fade from Salisbury, travel to each major druid ring and make use of your crystal. The crystal will be crushed in the process and will activate the ring's well. As Morgana's power has hold of the tombs below these rings, I am unsure what the mix of necromantic power and ley energy will have upon you and the circle itself. Be prepared for anything! If you find yourself without a ley crystal return to a minor circle and use the darkenstone to gain another. If you are foolish enough to lose your darkenstone, you may return to the [ axis circle ] and kill a skeleton to obtain another. All seven of the wells can only be activated using darkness. If dawn arrives and you have not visited all seven you must wait till the next night to complete the ritual. When you have established the alignment of these ley lines, travel to the heart of Stonehenge and use your darkenstone for the final time. Upon the stone's destruction the bonds that tie the portal close should ignite and allow it to be [ opened from the other side ]. You must be ready for Glasan at this point. When the arch druid arrives, you will have little time to attack him, as his power will grow quickly. If you are successful in slaying him, the staff should shatter on its own. Any shards left from the battle must be returned to me! Here, take these instructions to aid you. Good luck to thee Theurgist.

H324.offer: It is time you learned a bit about [Hibernia]. Speak with Merle. He is very old, and knows a lot about this land.

Merle the Old.will speak: Aye, more visitors than I've had in years! More than I've wanted in years, or still want.
Merle the Old.Blaieseach: Ah yes, He seeks the Moonstone, rumored to be in Lough Derg. It's a powerful item of enchantment. If ye seek it, be careful, for many seek it. If you do find it, then beware, for Blaieseach will then seek you with his trackers.

npc_lines.Merle the Old: What brings one of Macigians out here? You don't think I [will speak] with you, do you? Aye, more visitors than I've had in years! More than I've wanted in years, or still want. Well, I might. Perhaps. If you bring me back the mud from four mudmen. It has its uses, you know. Yes, that will do. Then perhaps I will speak with you. Did you get me the mud? Ah this is good. I'll need three more. Yo udo know there's silver in these mountains? That's why all these siabra miners are crawling around here. Better. I'll want two more. Oh, you'll want to be careful in the mountains. I'd avoid them if I were you. Oooh, you've done well. I only need one more. Well then. You've kept your part. I'll speak of one thing with you. Which would you have me speak of, [the Unnamed One], [Lobais], or [Blaieseach]"? According to the journal you want to click on the Unnamed One. Ah yes, He seeks the Moonstone, rumored to be in Lough Derg. It's a powerful item of enchantment. If ye seek it, be careful, for many seek it. If you do find it, then beware, for Blaieseach will then seek you with his trackers.

M325.offer: Greetings to you. I'm sure I've seen you before, but my memory isn't as great as it used to be, so you'll have to forgive me. Hehe [Mularn] sure is a nice place isn't it?
M325.accept_line: Oh wonder of wonders! I shall indeed make it worth your time and effort. Now, the first item I am missing is my [skinning knife].
M325.finish: Ah! This will do nicely! I just hope its former owner doesn't come looking for it. hehe Anyhow, I thank you for your help in this matter, and maybe, in the future, I can show you some of my wares. Good luck in your travels!
giver_turnins: My knife! Oh thank you! Now, I am in need of just one more thing, if you are [willing to get it].

Bolli.Mularn: Ah, I've lived here nearly my entire life, well, most of it anyhow. Since my accident, though, I've had to take up another hobby besides adventuring. Did you know I do [leatherworking]?
Bolli.leatherworking: Oh aye, I have become quite handy with a leather working tool. But alas, I seem to have [misplaced] it recently.
Bolli.misplaced: I know...I know...I should have put it and my leather pieces away before heading to bed, but I just plain forgot! I don't suppose you could help a crippled old man [look] for it, can you?
Bolli.skinning knife: It is a wonderful knife, give to me as a present from a very old and sweet friend. I would be very appreciative if you could find it for me. I know there are creatures aroudn that like [shiny objects].
Bolli.shiny objects: Hrm...Huldus come to mind. There are a bunch of them on a hill to the west, right outside of town. See if one of them has my knife.
Bolli.willing to get it: I knew you would. I was using the shinbone of a rattling skeleton to smooth out my skins so I could start making my leather. THat is now gone also. I think the skeleton I took if from [took it back].
Bolli.took it back: Honestly, I didn't know they would be so sensitive, but it was the perfect bone for the job. Please go out and get me another shinbone!

M326.offer: Greetings, and welcome to the dwarf town of Haggerfel. I wish I could stay and talk with you for a moment, but I am in a hurry to find my [lost keys].
M326.accept_line: Thank you! Thank you! I know there are some hobgoblins around that like to play jokes on people, viscious and mean ones. Why don't you check there while I check the merchant huts again?
M326.finish: Ah! This is great! My key! You have done a fabulous job in helping me. Please accept this coin in return for your time and effort. Thank you so much! Now, I can safely lock up the town's money. Thank you!
giver_turnins: I couldn't find them again in the village. Did you have better luck?
Oh my keychain. Well, this is a good start. But you didn't happen to find my key, did you?

Dwarven Guard Rinda.lost keys: Oh yes. It is dreadful that I was so careless as to lost them like this! You see, I am responsible for helping to lock the money the merchants bring in during the day into a large chest. I am the only one with the keys, and I have [misplaced them].
Dwarven Guard Rinda.misplaced them: Oh, this makes me so angry! I have searched all around Haggerfel for them, but they are no where to be found. I don't suppose you would have a [little time] to help me out, would you?

npc_lines.The hobgoblin snake-finder: Ha ha! Me no have keys! Feed to hungry bear! haha! You no help Rinda...Gold be ours!

H330.offer: Hello. I imagine by now you've run into several dergans while exploring the area. They can be dangerous, so be careful with your dealings with them. They are of the unseelie court, you know. They are part of the siabra, and they are everywhere. why, I don't think there's one place not touched by these malevolent dark [elven beings].
H330.accept_line: You've made a wise choice. No matter what your dealings with the siabra may be, they are as much of an enemy as the Midgard barbarians and Albion invaders. Talk to Lavena, in town, she has had some recent experience with the unseelie court.

Raine.elven beings: Aye. They are evil. Many in Hibernia have had unpleasant dealings with them. Even more have been killed by them. It would be worth your time to learn as much about them as you can. I know a bit about them, but the locals, they would know more. See, I am new to this area, and my knowledge of the unseelie court is more historical impartial observance than anything else. I am not an [adventurer], though. You, however, are, and I think you'll discover how important it is to know as much as you can about the unseelie court. Beware though, the locals may demand you show your loyalty to Hibernia with the blood of these evil creatures.

Lavena.unseelie court: Well, I may know why they occupy some of Lough Derg. But I won't be sharing that knowledge with those that aren't willing to take up the fight against the unseelie court. I know they're powerful, I know some feel it pays more to stay on their good side. But I'll not talk with those not willing to fight the evil of the unseelie court. If you wish this knowledge, you must return to me with some of the uncut stones the dergan furys occasionally pick up. You can find dergan furys in the woods northeast of the farm building by the parthanan field.
Lavena.occupy: Most of Lough Derg was once Tir na mBeo. There are the ruins of a tower here in Lough Derg, they are the ruins of the Tower of Tir na mBeo. I won't tell the story of that tower, for it is common in Hibernia. When the unseelie court flooded Hibernia, some of them overran Lough Derg and began to occupy some areas. They have been here so long, that even though they are members of the unseelie court, the natives of Hibernia began to call them dergans. It's a way to [distinguish] the unseelie court.
Lavena.distinguish: The dergans sole interest seems to bein retrieving the lost treasures of the Tower of Tir na mBeo. You could imagine the unseelie court's surprise when they reached the Tower of Tir na mBeo, to find that the once great Elven construct had fallen, and worse, that most of the treasures of the Tower were gone! So they stay here, to seek the treasures, and to search for clues that could lead them to the whereabouts of the treasures. Understand, now, that some of these treasures are items of magic more powerful than anything the unseelie court or the elves now have! As for the rest of the unseelie court, well, they spread our throughout the land. If you travel to Howth, I'm sure you can learn about the unseelie court that has settled in that area. Just talk to the locals.

npc_lines.Lavena: Dergans? You want to know about dergans? They are part of the unseelie court. They are defined by their region. Here, in Lough Derg, they go by the name dergans. They have a reason for being here. They all have a unified mission. I'm sure of that. Why, it's common knowledge that when the Lurikeens and Elves decided to come through the Veil to help the land of Hibernia, the [unseelie court] came rushing out as well. It seemed, to some, they had found their own way out, but I know little of that. Well, I may know why they occupy some of Lough Derg. But I won't be sharing that knowledge with those that aren't willing to take up the fight against the unseelie court. I know they're powerful, I know some feel it pays more to stay on their good side. But I'll not talk with those not willing to fight the evil of the unseelie court. If you wish this knowledge, you must return to me with some of the uncut stones the dergan furys occasionally pick up. You can find dergan furys in the woods northeast of the farm building by the parthanan field. You are back. Have you retrieved an uncut stone for me? Ah. Yes, this is what I meant. You see, the dergans [occupy] our land for a reason. Most of Lough Derg was once Tir na mBeo. There are the ruins of a tower here in Lough Derg, they are the ruins of the Tower of Tir na mBeo. I won't tell the story of that tower, for it is common in Hibernia. When the unseelie court flooded Hibernia, some of them overran Lough Derg and began to occupy some areas. They have been here so long, that even though they are members of the unseelie court, the natives of Hibernia began to call them dergans. It's a way to [distinguish] the unseelie court. The dergans sole interest seems to bein retrieving the lost treasures of the Tower of Tir na mBeo. You could imagine the unseelie court's surprise when they reached the Tower of Tir na mBeo, to find that the once great Elven construct had fallen, and worse, that most of the treasures of the Tower were gone! So they stay here, to seek the treasures, and to search for clues that could lead them to the whereabouts of the treasures. Understand, now, that some of these treasures are items of magic more powerful than anything the unseelie court or the elves now have! As for the rest of the unseelie court, well, they spread our throughout the land. If you travel to Howth, I'm sure you can learn about the unseelie court that has settled in that area. Just talk to the locals.
npc_lines.The dergan fury: The unseelie court will remember this deed. You will live to regret it!

H331.offer: Yes. My [particular] interest right now is the gurites. They are in Lough Gur, but to my knowledge, there's not really much value in that area. Why would they stay there? What keeps them? They don't attack Innis Carthaig, which is unlike them. I'm just curious as to why they stay there. Perhaps you could figure it out for me?
H331.accept_line: Oh great! I appreciate your [willingness] to help me!
H331.finish: Great. Go talk to Chief Bran Llyr. I think he knows quite a bit about the gurites and siabra. He lives in Culraid, in Lough Gur, with Kimba. He may know why the gurites stick around that area.

Aziliz.willingness: Great. Go talk to Chief Bran Llyr. I think he knows quite a bit about the gurites and siabra. He lives in Culraid, in Lough Gur, with Kimba. He may know why the gurites stick around that area.

H333.offer: I can teach you the Way of Stealth. Beyond the way lie two paths that you must choose from. I suggest you speak with a Ranger and a [Nightshade] now, to give you more time to consider your path.
H333.accept_line: Well, there are two paths you may choose from: The [Path of Essence] and the [Path of Focus].
H333.finish: Speak with either Blathnaid in Tir na Nog, or Leachlainn, in Ardagh, south on the road outside of Ardee, North from Howth, to learn about the Path of Essence.

Ula.Path of Focus: Speak with either Blathnaid in Tir na Nog, or Leachlainn, in Ardagh, south on the road outside of Ardee, North from Howth, to learn about the Path of Essence.

npc_lines.Blathnaid: Yes, Nightshades do follow the Path of Essence. Is that so odd? Those who follow the Path of Essence believe that magic is a part of everything and everyone. We use that essence to achieve our own means. What else would we do? Speak with a Ranger, either Mavelle in Tir na Nog, outside Magmell, or Teague, further south, in Ardagh. From Howth, head North to Ardagh, and Northwest past Tir na mBeo.
npc_lines.Mavelle: Hail. It should come as no surprise to you that Rangers follow the Path of Focus. We believe in directing the energy that permeates us into perfection of our skills. In our field, concentration is essential, and distraction can be deadly. Now that you understand the different paths open to you, I hope when your time comes, you will choose wisely. Choose the one you believe in, and then you will choose correctly.

H334.offer: Greetings. Do you [have time] to do me a favor?
H334.accept_line: I appreciate [the favor]. I would deliver it myself, but it would look a bit suspicious if it came from me. It involves some information I've acquired.
H334.finish: Deliver this letter to Dirmyg. He's usually found at the merchant shops across from the guard tower on the road south toward Tir na mBeo. If he's feeling talkative, he might even tell you about the Caoranoch.

Ula.have time: I realize you are recent to this area, and may not know the locals or the land, but I [appreciate] it. Could you deliver a letter to a merchant for me? Dialog box: Will you deliver this letter for me?
Ula.the favor: Deliver this letter to Dirmyg. He's usually found at the merchant shops across from the guard tower on the road south toward Tir na mBeo. If he's feeling talkative, he might even tell you about the Caoranoch.

Dirmyg.other business: Ah you are here to deliver a letter? I am expecting one from Tir na mBeo. May I have the letter?

npc_lines.Dirmyg: Are you interested in purchasing something? Or do you have [other business] with me? Ah you are here to deliver a letter? I am expecting one from Tir na mBeo. May I have the letter? Thank you. Wait a moment please. I hope you don't mind if I read this out loud: Cyana is training hard to be a Stalker. Please, if it's not too much trouble, help acquaint Cyana to the area by sharing some local tales. Well, I suppose no harm could come from telling you of the Lough Derg Lake monsters, eh? We call it Caoranoch. Not sure if there's more than one, but let me tell you, the creature is huge! A giant worm! The say they're all female. Say that the Caoranoch will devour a man whole! And keep it in its belly for weeks! Why, that fool Conan Mac Morna is now called Conan Muil! After being swallowed by that beast and suffering a lot of misfortune in her belly, he came out bald! Aye, I bet if you ever found him, he'd have a tale to tell, and a favor to ask, if that same demon still hunts the lake! Though I hear some tell the beast was throuwn in a lake in Lough Gur by an angry giant!

M337.offer: Ah greetings fellow Adventurer! I am Bolli, former Skald now retired. Have you time for a [tale] of love, adventure and loss?
M337.accept_line: Aye. I tried to use my traveling sone, but the rest of my group couldn't keep up. He [slaughtered] them, along with my beloved Gunnhildr.
M337.finish: I don't know you too well, traveler, but if you're brave of heart and stout of spirit, then perhaps you'd like to visit the creature and slay him. I wish you luck on your journeys, friend. Be wary of the evils in Muspelheim.

Bolli.tale: With my addition, her group was complete. We ran all over Midgard, slaying beasts, helping villagers... We had a splendid time. We had gained enough wisdom and insight that we went to Muspelheim in search of new adventure, [new opponents], and new riches.
Bolli.new opponents: Aye, and new opponents were to be found everywhere in Muspelheim. At first, we were giddy and excited. We had found a nest of lava lizards and enjoyed ridding the world of them. Little did we know they had a [keeper].
Bolli.keeper: Lava lizards are related to a family of drakes called Fire Drakes. These Fire Drakes have higher ranking members amongst them. One of these was a [Young Fire Wyrm Lord].
Bolli.Young Fire Wyrm Lord: And a dreadful site he was too. Larger than other beast I've seen, he roams around Muspelheim, like the Lord of the manor! He didn't take too [kindly] to us beatin' on his kinfolk.
Bolli.slaughtered: I don't know you too well, traveler, but if you're brave of heart and stout of spirit, then perhaps you'd like to visit the creature and slay him. I wish you luck on your journeys, friend. Be wary of the evils in Muspelheim.

M338.offer: What? You haven't heard? There is trouble in the Grenlock Clan. Shortly after you brought the sword back to me, a dark cloud settled around both the crest and the sword. I thought it was part of the protection spell but then Arnfinn started sending me messages that things were happening to people of the Clan. Harmless creatures attacking people, strange illnesses overtaking others. All signs point to [a problem] with the crest and the sword, but alas, I do not know what it may be.
M338.accept_line: Thank you. I knew the Grenlock Clan could trust in your abilities and your dedication. Now, as I've said, I do not know exactly what has befallen the crest and sword, but I know of one who might. She is ancient, and has learned all the legends and tales of the Grenlock Clan for as far back as they go. You must go and [see her].
M338.finish: Her name is Danica, and she lives in Mularn. Go to her now, and tell her that Anrid sent you. I wish you luck in your endeavor.

Anrid.a problem: I know you have helped before, both with obtaining the crest and the sword. Now the very people of the Grenlock Clan call upon you to help solve the mystery of what is befalling them. Someone or something is trying to remove them from this world, and I can only beg that you will help them in these troubled times. Can I send word that you [are here for them]?
Anrid.see her: Her name is Danica, and she lives in Mularn. Go to her now, and tell her that Anrid sent you. I wish you luck in your endeavor.

Danica.solve the mystery: Since Anrid came to me, I have been going through all the stories I know related to the Clan but I've reference to visitors from a far off land that resulted in the death of a girl of the clan named Freyana. Freyana was the most beloved daughter of the clan at the time these visitors came to Midgard. It was said she was so beautiful when she was born that she was named after the goddess of beauty, <Player>. But [something happened] to her while she was still young.
Danica.something happened: Unfortunately I do not know what caused it, but somehow Freyana died saving her childhood friend; a troll named Ljagnid. Healers of the Clan worked desperately to save Freyana's life, but their magics failed and her spirit was held here instead of travelling on to Valhalla. Legends say that Freyana's spirit grew bitter and ugly with her resentment towards the clan but especially to Ljagnid. She haunted him, sending horrible things [to torment him] day and night.
Danica.to torment him: The torment became too much for him and he died from a mixture of fear and grief. Freyana watched this with joy, for she felt she was avenged. But her joy quickly turned to anger when she saw that Ljagnid was being taken to Valhalla, a place she had long been denied. She shrieked a curse at Ljagnid, and bound him to her, keeping him trapped here in the same tortured existance she suffers. It is rumored that Freyana and [Ljagnid] now roam around Vanern Swamp together, for that is where both their bodies where laid to rest, with the great kings and queens of Midgard.
Danica.Ljagnid: In the stories I have found, it was speculated that Ljagnid wrote down his story and what brought about Freyana's death. If we only had that book! Some say it was lost forever while others say Ljagnid took the book with him when he died. Only you can [discover the truth] now, child.
Danica.discover the truth: You must travel to the sweltering depths of Vanern Swamp and seek out Freyana and Ljagnid at night and see if Ljagnid has this book. Freyana is evil, and cannot stand having Ljagnid around but she cannot let him go, they say. So she forces him into hiding most of the time, but when something tries to harm her, and try things do, for she is a most evil creature now, Ljagnid springs from hiding to help her. I fear you will not be able to face Freyana and Ljagnid alone, for they have both grown very strong. Gather your forces and take them with you for protection. Remember, Freyana only roams at night. If you are able to obtain the book, bring it back to me here.
Danica.continues: The visitors have begun to learn the language of the clan, and we theirs. Freyana continues to hide me and the other trolls from Kelic, the leader of the magic users. She is too protective of me. I told her I wish to learn their language too, and she promised me she would teach me. I think tomorrow I will sneak close to their encampment and see them for myself. I am curious to see if they look like the Clan or like me. Freyana has come back to my hidings place to bring me food. I must go eat now and finish this later. Ljagnid stops writing there and did not finish on that day. [His next entry] is about Freyana's death. Perhaps this will help us.
Danica.His next entry: 'Ingvarr and his friends have been searching for a week now, but have not found the visitors. Everyone thought they had made it to their own lands until <Player> showed up. He said that the deserters of the Clan had taken in the visitors and were making a deal with them. <Player> feared the deal and left them, returning to the Clan. He begged to be accepted back into the Clan, but no one trusts him. The Alfevsons took him back in, but they secretly set someone to watch him at all times. I think <Player> is [up to no good].'
Danica.up to no good: A few days later Ljagnid writes, 'I was right. <Player> left us again today, but he said he wasn't returning to the deserters. He still feared the visitors. He told us he was going north, because he thought the visitors were going to do something bad to the Clan and to the deserters. Some people went with him, but we never saw any of them again. When he left, I saw him carrying a bunch of scrolls. I checked with everyone, but no one was missing any, so they must have belonged to <Player> after all. Something strange is happening to me. I have started seeing strange creatures no one else sees. I am scared.' That is where the book ends. [Interesting], is it not?
Danica.Interesting: Now, before you start wondering, I know of these rengades Ljagnid wrote of in his journal. They were once Clansmen and women. When the Clan moved into the area, they had two choices - live in peace with the trolls, kobolds, and dwarves, or conquer them. The Alfvesons, chose to live in peace, and this made some of the Clan members [angry].
Danica.angry: These members did not like the non-human races. They felt that co-existing with them rather than ruling them showed weakness. Rather than live in that situation, they packed up and left, following the loudest of them, <Player>. I guess you could say they are the forerunners to the Blodfelags that roam the lands now. He led them out into the wilderness, where they roamed for a short time until they mysteriously died out. They had no name for themselves, but in the Clan they were referred to as the deserters. I also know of this man, [<Player>].
Danica.<Player>: I have a few notes about him in different books. He and his followers moved around quite a bit, but finally settled in Raumarik. It is said his spirit still haunts the land, although now he fears everyone, thinking they have been sent by either the deserters or the visitors. I believe the scrolls he took will contain the answer to what the visitors planned to do to the Clan. I need you to travel now to Raumarik and find <Player>. His followers are always with him, hoping for his protection, so take many with you to defeat them. When you reach Raumarik, head to the river. Cross the river and head north until you find <Player>. Return to me when you have the scrolls of <Player>.

npc_lines.Danica: Well hello there, child. Oh, do not look at me so for calling you that. When you have lived as long as I have, everyone is a child. Now usually children don't come to me unless they were sent to me. Who sent you here to me? So Anrid sent you? I am not surprised. She came to me recently to tell her the legends of the Grenlock Clan. Now, I know many stories and legends, and perhaps one day I will be able to share them with you and others, but for now we must focus on the task that Anrid has sent you on. She told me that trouble has befallen the Grenlock Clan, and she was going to send one who would [solve the mystery]. Some say it was lost forever while others say Ljagnid took the book with him when he died. Only you can [discover the truth] now, child. You must travel to the sweltering depths of Vanern Swamp and seek out Freyana and Ljagnid at night and see if Ljagnid has this book. Freyana is evil, and cannot stand having Ljagnid around but she cannot let him go, they say. So she forces him into hiding most of the time, but when something tries to harm her, and try things do, for she is a most evil creature now, Ljagnid springs from hiding to help her. I fear you will not be able to face Freyana and Ljagnid alone, for they have both grown very strong. Gather your forces and take them with you for protection. Remember, Freyana only roams at night. If you are able to obtain the book, bring it back to me here. Visitors have come to the encampment today. They are from anotherland, I think, for they look different then the Grenlock Clan. Freyana was all excited about the visitors coming, but then she dreams of going to far off places. Me, I'm happier here with the Clan. Freyana was worried about me, because she thinks the visitors have never seen a troll before and would be scared of me. I went off into the woods for a while and talked with the other trolls in the area. Freyana came to me after sunset and told me about the visitors. They don't know our language, but drew pictures in the dirt to make themselves understood. Freyana says they are nice, but she wants me to stay away a while longer. He [continues] the story a week later. The visitors have begun to learn the language of the clan, and we theirs. Freyana continues to hide me and the other trolls from Kelic, the leader of the magic users. She is too protective of me. I told her I wish to learn their language too, and she promised me she would teach me. I think tomorrow I will sneak close to their encampment and see them for myself. I am curious to see if they look like the Clan or like me. Freyana has come back to my hidings place to bring me food. I must go eat now and finish this later.
