Now, before you start wondering, I know of these rengades Ljagnid wrote of in his journal. They were once Clansmen and women. When the Clan moved into the area, they had two choices - live in peace with the trolls, kobolds, and dwarves, or conquer them. The Alfvesons, chose to live in peace, and this made some of the Clan members [angry]. These members did not like the non-human races. They felt that co-existing with them rather than ruling them showed weakness. Rather than live in that situation, they packed up and left, following the loudest of them, <Player>. I guess you could say they are the forerunners to the Blodfelags that roam the lands now. He led them out into the wilderness, where they roamed for a short time until they mysteriously died out. They had no name for themselves, but in the Clan they were referred to as the deserters. I also know of this man, [<Player>]. I have a few notes about him in different books. He and his followers moved around quite a bit, but finally settled in Raumarik. It is said his spirit still haunts the land, although now he fears everyone, thinking they have been sent by either the deserters or the visitors. I believe the scrolls he took will contain the answer to what the visitors planned to do to the Clan. I need you to travel now to Raumarik and find <Player>. His followers are always with him, hoping for his protection, so take many with you to defeat them. When you reach Raumarik, head to the river. Cross the river and head north until you find <Player>. Return to me when you have the scrolls of <Player>. So you have returned from Raumarik, child. What do you bring me from the deserter, <Player>? Ah, I am glad you were able to get these. They will [solve the mystery] of the Clan's problems, I am sure. I shall need a minute or two to scan over <Player>'s scrolls to see if I can learn anything [about the visitors]. While I do that, why don't you take a look at what Anrid sent over for you.

H339.offer: Greetings, I am Aziliz, Prophetess to the people of Hibernia. I specialize in many things, but my main focus is the Siabra. For you see, they [threaten] our very way of life.
H339.accept_line: Excellent. I am glad to know you are with me. Here is what we must do. There is a Siabra chief by the name of Nasco. He wanders around Shannon Estuary, and is guarded by his Ambushers and Waylayers. He is sneaky and crafty. You will need all the help you can get. Hurry to Howth and speak with my sister, <Player>. She will be able to assist you further in this endeavor for Hibernia.

Aziliz.threaten: Yes, threaten. They are outspoken revolutionsists who desire to see the Elves and Lurikeen shoved from the Veil, to be forever lost from the world of Magic... We must [fight] against this. Are you with me?

Elizabeth.she desires: She desires the heart of a battle-scarred mauler. It is the final component Tyria needs for a charm she wished to make. Travel to Skona Ravine and get the heart. Take it to Tyria in Vindsaul Faste. She will then give you what I seek, along with the location of the second half.
Elizabeth.three basic things: It's almost humorous, to think that three simple things, when combined in the right amounts, will create such a powerful enchantment. The gods do have a sense of humor after all, it appears. When you hear what the three things are, you would never think to put them together. Well, let me send you out for [one thing] first. According to the book, it will take the longest to prepare. Then I shall have you get the other two.
Elizabeth.one thing: You must travel into Varulvhamn in Skona Ravine. Seek out a werewolf noble and acquire its pelt. Once you have it, return to me.
Elizabeth.other items: You must travel to Uppland. There hunt for the wyvern and the taiga cat. From the wyvern, get a scale. The scale contains many magical properties of the gods and is essential to the enchantment. From the taiga cat, bring me a claw. The claw will add sharpness to the weapons I enchant. Return to me when you have both.
Elizabeth.shield: An axe, eh? Give me but a minute and I shall have it.

Tyria.the item: It is but a trifle really, a small token from [a creature] of the ice and snow.
Tyria.a creature: There are creatures in Yggdra's Forest known simply as blocks of ice. You must seek out one and retrieve its icy heart. Once you have it, return to me and I shall give you the tome.

npc_lines.Elizabeth: You will not regret the decision to help me, although at times the way will be hard. The tome I spoke of is in two pieces. I only know the location of the first half of the tome. A shaman named Tyia holds the first half. She has sent word to me that she will give me the half she possesses if I will brind her something [she desires]. She desires the heart of a battle-scarred mauler. It is the final component Tyria needs for a charm she wished to make. Travel to Skona Ravine and get the heart. Take it to Tyria in Vindsaul Faste. She will then give you what I seek, along with the location of the second half. This is the entire tome! This is beyond my expectations! Now, let me see what is involved in enchanting weapons. Someone in Tyria's family must have been an enchanter in ancient times, or else they copied this book from another. It is written in ancient Kobold, which I happen to know. Part of my training to become an enchanter was to learn all the ancient languages, for many enchantments are in ancient tongues. I bet Tyia did not think I could do so much with this, for that very reason, or else she wouldn't have let it go for such a low price. With this tome, I can enchant many weapons for the brave inhabitants of this land, such as those of the House of Bragi. Now, in the tome, it says there are [three basic things] needed for the enchantment. It's almost humorous, to think that three simple things, when combined in the right amounts, will create such a powerful enchantment. The gods do have a sense of humor after all, it appears. When you hear what the three things are, you would never think to put them together. Well, let me send you out for [one thing] first. According to the book, it will take the longest to prepare. Then I shall have you get the other two. You must travel into Varulvhamn in Skona Ravine. Seek out a werewolf noble and acquire its pelt. Once you have it, return to me. Good, you have returned. I must take the pelt and burn it. Give me the pelt please. The ashes contain the magical property that allows a werewolf to transform himself into a beast or a man. It is that property that will help transform everyday weapons into magical ones. Now, are you ready for the [other items]? You must travel to Uppland. There hunt for the wyvern and the taiga cat. From the wyvern, get a scale. The scale contains many magical properties of the gods and is essential to the enchantment. From the taiga cat, bring me a claw. The claw will add sharpness to the weapons I enchant. Return to me when you have both. Ah, the legendary scale of the wyvern. This is perfect. Now, the taiga claw please. I cannot use the new enchantments without it. Thank you for the claw. The enchantment is complete. Now you must pick your reward. Which do you desire - [one handed] or [two handed] or a [shield]. Choose carefully, for once your choice is made; you cannot change your mind. After turning in both items to Elizabeth, gain 62,914,560 experience as well Two Handed Conclusion: An axe, eh? Give me but a minute and I shall have it.
npc_lines.Tyria: So, you've come to me from Elizabeth, have you? I told her what I wanted in exchange for the tome. Do you have the mauler heart? Ah, this is a wonderful mauler heart. I will finally be able to complete that charm I was asked to make. I've been asked to make another charm and I do not have all the things I need for it. Get me [the item] I need, and I will give you both halves of the tome Elizabeth wants. It is but a trifle really, a small token from [a creature] of the ice and snow. There are creatures in Yggdra's Forest known simply as blocks of ice. You must seek out one and retrieve its icy heart. Once you have it, return to me and I shall give you the tome. Ah, you have returned. My patrons have been waiting for their protection charms to take with them into the frontier. Please, give me that icy heart. Here is your tome; although I do not know what good it will do Elizabeth. It is written in ancient Kobold and worth nothing to me anymore, since I cannot read that language. Perhaps she will be able to decipher it. I wish both of you luck.
npc_lines.Elizabeth then: Now chooose your weapon - [sword], [axe], or [hammer]. Again, choose carefully for you cannot change once you voice your selection.

M352.accept_line: Seek out Kran, for he is a good source of information in these parts, and a wonderful teacher.

Kran.learn: Knowledge is the key that will unlock many doors for you. Understanding and knowing your surroundings is your ally and [teamwork] your backbone.
Kran.teamwork: These are difficult times for our people and therefore you must understand that [camaraderie] between your fellows is very important.
Kran.camaraderie: Reach out to others. Form a grouping with one or more fellows and return to me once you have accomplished this.
Kran.task: Take your new found group into the countryside and look for the hobgoblin fish catchers and return to me with a token of the task set before you.

npc_lines.Kran: Good day my friend, can I help you? I see you have been sent here to [learn] my young friend. Knowledge is the key that will unlock many doors for you. Understanding and knowing your surroundings is your ally and [teamwork] your backbone. These are difficult times for our people and therefore you must understand that [camaraderie] between your fellows is very important. Reach out to others. Form a grouping with one or more fellows and return to me once you have accomplished this. Welcome back, I see you have accomplished the [task] of forming a group. Take your new found group into the countryside and look for the hobgoblin fish catchers and return to me with a token of the task set before you. You and your partner have done well and hopefully learned an important lesson. You must always remember that it is a party of like minds and goals that will accomplish much. Teamwork is our peoples best guarantee to a victory!

M353.offer: The girl Magnild is still very ill. Hopefully the healer [Kari] has had time to turn the snake venom onto a usable remedy.

Trainer.Kari: Go to Kari and see if she has [completed] the remedy to cure the girl.

Kari.right time: I have been working with the snake venom now for several days, it was not easy to [brew] down.
Kari.brew: However, I think I have finished the [remedy] for Magnild's bite.
Kari.remedy: Take it and deliver it to the girl quickly. The longer we wait the worse her condition becomes I'm afraid.

Magnild.grateful: I have not felt myslef in so long time. Oh I hope this [asists me].
Magnild.asists me: I must say that I am feeling a tad better already. I do not know how I can thank you, but I shall never forget your aid to me.

npc_lines.Kari: Hello again. You have come at exactly the [right time]. I have been working with the snake venom now for several days, it was not easy to [brew] down. However, I think I have finished the [remedy] for Magnild's bite. Take it and deliver it to the girl quickly. The longer we wait the worse her condition becomes I'm afraid.
npc_lines.Magnild: Oh I have not been so [grateful] for a potion in all my days! I have not felt myslef in so long time. Oh I hope this [asists me]. I must say that I am feeling a tad better already. I do not know how I can thank you, but I shall never forget your aid to me.

M355.offer: As a Rogue there are [two houses] from which you can choose on your path, the gods to choose from are Loki and Skadi.
M355.accept_line: The gods to [choose] from are Loki and Skadi and the Great House of the Jotun.
M355.finish: If you wish to learn of Loki seek out Boidoc here in Fort Atla.

Jucla.choose: If you wish to learn of Loki seek out Boidoc here in Fort Atla.

Boidoc.Loki: You can join the House of Loki. He is the giant of fire and the great trickster. If you choose to follow Loki you will become a shadowblade. You will follow his example and become a member of the [Great House of Jotun].
Boidoc.Great House of Jotun: The Great House of Jotun is made up of the gods living in Jotunheim, home of the Giants. If ever you wre to go to Jotunheim, you would find [Skadi] dwelling there.
Boidoc.Skadi: To learn more about Skadi seek out Budo here in Fort Atla.

Budo.Skadi: Skadi is the giantess of the hunt. She was greatly beloved by both Aesir and Jotun. She is of the [Great House of the Jotun].
Budo.Great House of the Jotun: The Great House of Jotun is made up of the gods living in Jotunheim, home of the Giants. Once you have grown stronger, and a bit wiser, return to your trainer. You must then choose which of the gods to follow.

npc_lines.Boidoc: Greetings, I see Jucla has sent you to me to learn of [Loki]. You can join the House of Loki. He is the giant of fire and the great trickster. If you choose to follow Loki you will become a shadowblade. You will follow his example and become a member of the [Great House of Jotun]. The Great House of Jotun is made up of the gods living in Jotunheim, home of the Giants. If ever you wre to go to Jotunheim, you would find [Skadi] dwelling there. To learn more about Skadi seek out Budo here in Fort Atla.
npc_lines.Budo: Greetings, I see Jucla has sent you to me to learn of [Skadi]. Skadi is the giantess of the hunt. She was greatly beloved by both Aesir and Jotun. She is of the [Great House of the Jotun]. The Great House of Jotun is made up of the gods living in Jotunheim, home of the Giants. Once you have grown stronger, and a bit wiser, return to your trainer. You must then choose which of the gods to follow.

A361.offer: I have requested The Academy send someone who would be able to help. I am far to weak to travel and fear my powers would fail in battle. You don't need to assist this old man, but if you will [take up the cause] to defend this realm from Morgana's evil ways then your help would be welcome.
A361.accept_line: Your choice is a wise one! I will not waste anymore time with banter. There is a rumor of an Arawnite shaman by the name of Saelonna who has seen into the future. The rumors say the shaman has been driven insane by her visions. It is my hope that Saelonna has seen Morgana's evil and perhaps inscribed it in her [Book of Arawn].
A361.finish: Seek out this Saelonna within the borders of Snowdonia and retrieve this book at whatever the cost. Return to me when you have completed this task. May your travel be swift and uneventful!

Master Ferowl.Book of Arawn: Seek out this Saelonna within the borders of Snowdonia and retrieve this book at whatever the cost. Return to me when you have completed this task. May your travel be swift and uneventful!
Master Ferowl.<Player>: There have been sightings of this beast in the southern portions of the Pennine Mountains. You would be wise to start your search there. Should you encounter this <Player>, slay it and return its remains to Caelin Finan of Castle Sauvage. I believe with the right combination of spells he may be able to delve the location of this tower. Now be on your way! Time is short!

npc_lines.Caelin Finan: Interesting, I have never heard of that name. I will attempt to determine what use this wood may have. One moment please! Quite interesting indeed! This wood has only been used for one purpose, to build a necromantic altar! This is very bad. If this altar exists, it could be used to summon up demons from places best not spoken about. I assume The Academy has sent you on this mission? It may be wise to inform them of this evil wood and the power it commands!
npc_lines.Master Berwick: Oh my! This is indeed troubling. I will ask Master Ferowl to consult with us immediately. We must determine if this is truly Morgana's goal. If her chosen path is to summon these demons then we must act at once. Locating and destroying this altar before she has a chance to use it is our only hope. Take this ring as a reward for your trouble. Return to me later and I will inform you of our decision.

A363.offer: Hail! I trust you are well? I have a mission for you should you be [interested].

Magus Agyfen.interested: Many in our order have begun to speak at length if your missions for Sir Bors. It seems you have succeeded where many of them have failed. I would watch my back when around the likes of them. It is because of this that I hesitate to deliver this message from Captain Rhodri. I do not know that it contains, but I was informed it would be very [profitable]! May whatever god you worship watch over you. I shall only wish thee luck! Safe travels!

Captain Rhodri.assist us: This is good! I am relieved this matter will be resolved quickly in your hands. I shall not waste any more of your time than is necessary. As you are aware, the Twp ap Alsig believe it is the dwarves who have been assisting Tepok with funds and supplies. I truly doubt that dwarves would stomach working with such creatures. Yet, we cannot turn a blind eye to our newest of allies and the mine has proven a burden for too long. Therefore Sir Bors has decided that you must descend into Tepok mines, locate and slay Tepok himself. I am sure this deed should pose no problems for one of your skill. It is said Tepok carries with him a sack containing all this precious items. Return this to us as it may contain clues to location these dwarves. Best of luck to thee.
Captain Rhodri.Twr ap Alsig: Were you able to deliver the dispatch to Twr ap Alsig?
Captain Rhodri.scouts were spotted: Aye! We are unsure if there are other such passages but if there are, we shall find them. We still need to search Pennine and locate the source of these supplies! Unfortunately we cannot afford to use any of our own scouts. I have been asked to task you with this delicate mission. We can no longer limit our source of information to observation alone. Someone must [venture into the camps] of each race within the Pennine and return solid reports.
Captain Rhodri.venture into the camps: Not to worry Cabalist! We will not send you into these camps blindly. We have been observing the inhabitants of Pennine for quite some time. Are you still [willing to assist] us in this matter?
Captain Rhodri.willing to assist: Then let us begin! Your first task will be to infiltrate a camp of Tylwyth Teg elves. There is one among them named Delfina. She carries the reports of their people to and from the Tylwyth Teg homelands. Our time is short Cabalist. Do not toy with the targets! Simply locate this Delfina, slay her, and return her reports. I await your return. May your blade be swift and quite!

npc_lines.Captain Rhodri: I had not expected you to arrive so soon. Give me a moment to gather my thoughts. It is good to see you in excellent health. Sir Bors will be most pleased it is you who answered his call for help. We are in need of your skill and the insight you have into the locals of Barfog. As I indicated in your message, you will be rewarded well for your efforts. Are you still willing to [assist us]? This is good! I am relieved this matter will be resolved quickly in your hands. I shall not waste any more of your time than is necessary. As you are aware, the Twp ap Alsig believe it is the dwarves who have been assisting Tepok with funds and supplies. I truly doubt that dwarves would stomach working with such creatures. Yet, we cannot turn a blind eye to our newest of allies and the mine has proven a burden for too long. Therefore Sir Bors has decided that you must descend into Tepok mines, locate and slay Tepok himself. I am sure this deed should pose no problems for one of your skill. It is said Tepok carries with him a sack containing all this precious items. Return this to us as it may contain clues to location these dwarves. Best of luck to thee. Ah! Were you able to retrieve Tepok's precious bag? Give him the bag. This is what we have been looking for! [Twr ap Alsig] has been deceived. I knew the dwarves have nothing to do with this plot. This dispatch proves as much! The person who write this speaks of supplies. Supplies that originated within Pennine and from a group that makes their home there. While I do not fully rule out the dwarves, we would be wise to turn our attention north and into the mountains. Were you able to deliver the dispatch to Twr ap Alsig? Very well then! We can now move forward with our plans. While you were away Sir Bors instructed his scouts to scour the borderlands. What they found was quite alarming. It seems the goblins had tunnelled under the pass wall and were using this passage as a means to receive supplies from the north. Before we were able to follow the goblins to the source of their supplies our [scouts were spotted] and the tunnel destroyed. Aye! We are unsure if there are other such passages but if there are, we shall find them. We still need to search Pennine and locate the source of these supplies! Unfortunately we cannot afford to use any of our own scouts. I have been asked to task you with this delicate mission. We can no longer limit our source of information to observation alone. Someone must [venture into the camps] of each race within the Pennine and return solid reports. Not to worry Cabalist! We will not send you into these camps blindly. We have been observing the inhabitants of Pennine for quite some time. Are you still [willing to assist] us in this matter? Then let us begin! Your first task will be to infiltrate a camp of Tylwyth Teg elves. There is one among them named Delfina. She carries the reports of their people to and from the Tylwyth Teg homelands. Our time is short Cabalist. Do not toy with the targets! Simply locate this Delfina, slay her, and return her reports. I await your return. May your blade be swift and quite! Once again your swiftness is most impressive! Do you have Delfina's reports? This done not bode well. I didn't review the documents in depth, but I don't see any mention of goblins here. Our scribes will have to go over them more closely. You have done well Cabalist! We will require your assistance once we have had more time to review Delfina's reports. Return to me later and perhaps I will have news. Good day to you!

H368.offer: Hmph, another noisy [creature]. And what is it you want?
H368.accept_line: Well, <Player>, I see you are here. Unfortunately I cannot trade this necklace I have for you belt. The necklace would do nothing for a strong <Player> like you. Run along now!
H368.finish: Make good use of this cloth Celt, I shall not be so generous in the future.
giver_turnins: Oh really? Do you actually think you'll get it for nothing Celt? You must truly live in a fantasy land of your own makings. I'll tell you what, since I am a fair woman, I will let you have the cloth, for a [price].
Yes, this is it alright. Finally, now the gentle creatures can rest easier. And, as for you, well, since you did help me with that problem, I am honorable enough to hold up my end of the bargain.

Tressa Gorrym'jiarg.price: There is a creature, one who annoys me greatly, of decent power and mind boggling insanity. He fancies himself a great paladin for Albion, and does much damage to the harmless creatures of Bri Leith. The Empyreans being ill-equiped to deal with such a monster, have done nothing to aid me in my efforts to finally rid Hibernia of this nuisance once and for all. If you [agree to help] me, I shall give the cloth to you willingly.
Tressa Gorrym'jiarg.agree to help: Excellent! I knew you'd be the sporting type. Here is what you must do. Near to where Watcher Rylie keeps his post at the standing stones in Moon Lake, is a mad changling called LUSMOREBANE (/loc 58K, 60K). As I said before, he thinks himself a paladin. He has slaughtered many harmless creatures within Bri Leith, and he needs to be dealt with. You may need to kill his fellow 'paladins' to coax him out of his 'stable'. When you are done, bring me his head that I may know the deed is done. From Caille, head SE over a few hills then cross Moon Lake until you reach tall standing stones surrounded by Empyrean Watchers and Watcher Rylie at night and trackers by day. Just behind then, at the foot of the hills are the mad changlings. Start killing them, and soon Lusmorebane will pop. He conned yellow to my Level 34 <Player>. After dispatching him, I had his head in my backpack, and returned to Tressa. I gave her the head, and received the Elven Gossimer after hearing this...

M414.accept_line: Carr has read Smyga's orders. Very bad news friend, very, very bad.
M414.finish: Hurry! Hurry and find Smyga, so he can't take Jordheim. If he is defeated, hobgoblins have no leader and will not attack. Is only way to save city.
giver_turnins: Smyga has grown upset, [very upset] at all the humans. Smyga doesn't like humans.

Carr.very upset: Smyga thinks humans stupid and [mean], attacking all hobgoblins home and camps humans are.
Carr.mean: Smyga's Orders read that Anklebiter must gather all hobgoblin forces. [Gather forces] to attack the humans.
Carr.Gather forces: Carr doesn't like Smyga. Carr likes humans better so Carr will [tell you].
Carr.tell you: Smyga plan a raid on human city of [Jordheim]. You must help.
Carr.Jordheim: Hurry! Hurry and find Smyga, so he can't take Jordheim. If he is defeated, hobgoblins have no leader and will not attack. Is only way to save city.

M456.offer: Hello, if you have a moment, I could use your [assistance].

Jolgeir.assistance: I'm running low on lifebane, but don't have time to gather one of the components I need to make a new batch. The lifebane has to be kept extremely cold, so I use the cold blood of frost giants. I can't pay you, but if you would get some for me, I'm sure it would be a good [experience] for you. Frost giants put up quite a fight, and you can hone your skills against them. I suggest you seek them in Yggdra Forest.

A471.offer: Greetings, noble one. I was wondering if you would care to do a [certain] task for me.

Samwell Hornly.certain: I seek unused arrowheads from the tylwyth teg rovers. I think that I can add them to my arrow shafts and make some new arrows. Have you ever noticed how the arrows from those hunters seem to slice right through platemail? I think I could make similar arrows and sell them to the border guards. Bring me as many unused [arrowheads] as you can.

A508.offer: Aye! The catacombs have stood for hundreds of years, weathering those who crawl about within and the attempts to steal what riches still remain. Vagabonds I tell you! The tomb is a place of the dead and should not be disturbed by those whose hearts still beat! While I too yearn to know what lay deep within its [hidden depths], I will not desecrate the emperor's tomb.

Grindan Halig.hidden depths: I am unsure if you know of Iohannes Aldar? He is a respectable arrow merchant up at the Cornwall station. Iohannes is known for his love of adventure. Unfortunately a [grievous injury] forced him to settle and take up fletching.
Grindan Halig.grievous injury: Very serious indeed! Though killed, the greater boogey Iohannes was fighthing took his left foot. Since this time, he has asked to hear the tales of any who pass through Cornwall station. Iohannes has not only become quite the arrow merchant, but also a wealth of knowledge to anyone who would listen to [his story].
Grindan Halig.his story: I recently visited Iohannes and heard a tale that has whet my appetite ever since. It seems some adventurer stumbled upon a new room within the Catacombs of Cardova. The undead that now inhabit the tomb were different than what she had encountered before. These new legions of the emperor [could speak]!
Grindan Halig.could speak: After hearing this, I researched a bit on my own within Camelot. Just two days ago I came to the realization that it may be possible to learn the true identity of the emperor that was buried within the catacombs! Alas, I do not know what effect this may have upon the tomb as a whole, as putting name to the forgotten emperor could lead to greater tomb raiding. Yet, if I could find someone who would be [willing to bear the weight] of this task and do so quietly then perhaps the tomb will remain unchanged.
Grindan Halig.willing to bear the weight: Ah! Very good (class name)! I think you will do nicely. I do not know how best to proceed I suggest that you speak with Iohannes Aldar at Cornwall station. Perhaps if you listen to his story and study the tomb well, you will find the key to [learning] the name of the emperor. Best of luck <Player>!

Iohannes Aldar.lower levels: Not many have returned from this new area, but those who have carry with them fabulous stories. Thier stories speak of a long hall, a hall with a light at the end. Within that light exists a great and powerful undead roman general. I can only imagine what else may lay within this [new found chamber]!
Iohannes Aldar.new found chamber: Yes! I almost forgot to mention the voices! Some spirit that inhabits the passageways about the main chamber speaks continually. This is quite odd as from what I have heard, most spirits and undead are unwilling to speak openly. I would be willing to [pay generously] to have on hand the words that are spoken of this spirit.
Iohannes Aldar.pay generously: Oh! You are offering your services then? This is great (class name)! You must depart immediately then. Travel into the deepest parts of the Catacombs of Cardova. Travel into these newly found chambers and locate the talkative spirit. I will await you here when you have found the words it speaks. Good luck (class name)!

The Spirit of the Emperor.waiting many generations: Long ago I ruled all that you see both here and above! The people worshiped me and even Emperor Nero accepted my counsel from time to time. The fools within Rome knew nothing of the land here. If not for thier meddling, my name might be spoken by all even to this day! Now it seems some fool witch has begun to raise my fellow generals and soldiers from thier graves. I have no interest in the events that now transpire above and seek only to [end the torment] she has placed upon me.
The Spirit of the Emperor.end the torment: Yes! To exist as an undead is to know pain, a pain so horrible it can only be silenced through a second death. Do you not realize that this is the sole reason why my men continually attack all who trespass within this tomb? Thier only hope is for a swift end to thier awakened state and a return to the [sweet darkness].
The Spirit of the Emperor.sweet darkness: This is why you have come to me <Player>! I seek to once more join my brethren in the after-life. Unfortunately the curse that keeps me in this state is intertwined with my generals. Each one must be silenced in turn and thier [focus item] offered up to me within the chamber of cleansing.
The Spirit of the Emperor.focus item: From Olivarius will come a scepter, from Taras a sword, from Crotus a seal, and from Amminus an amulet. Each of these focus items with the exception of the last must first be used at this spot before the next one can be obtained. When you have acquired Amminus' amulet, proceed into the crypt of the displaced soul. If the amulet is used at this location my body will be summoned from beneath the crypt. This will be your chance to bestow your gift of silence upon me. Perhaps in my death, the [curse will be broken] and all who still walk within this tomb will be put to rest.

npc_lines.Iohannes Aldar: Ah! You must speak of the Catacombs of Cordova! What a wonderful place of adventure this is. Lately the catacombs have become of greater interest to the adventures you see about you. It seems one foolhardy wizard was casting a spell within the depths of the catacombs and destroyed a wall. This wall appears to have been built to seal up the [lower levels] of the tomb. Not many have returned from this new area, but those who have carry with them fabulous stories. Thier stories speak of a long hall, a hall with a light at the end. Within that light exists a great and powerful undead roman general. I can only imagine what else may lay within this [new found chamber]! Yes! I almost forgot to mention the voices! Some spirit that inhabits the passageways about the main chamber speaks continually. This is quite odd as from what I have heard, most spirits and undead are unwilling to speak openly. I would be willing to [pay generously] to have on hand the words that are spoken of this spirit. Oh! You are offering your services then? This is great (class name)! You must depart immediately then. Travel into the deepest parts of the Catacombs of Cardova. Travel into these newly found chambers and locate the talkative spirit. I will await you here when you have found the words it speaks. Good luck (class name)! I welcome your return (class name). How goes the search for that spirit? Oh my! This is most remarkable! I can barely believe what it is I hold here! I do hope it wasn't too much trouble to obtain this. I have little to repay you with save my thanks and the promise that I shall tell your entire story. I think I will close my shop early today. I have much to read now. Thank you once again <Player>!
npc_lines.The Spirit of the Emperor: Welcome traveler! I have been [waiting many generations] for you to finally come to this place. Long ago I ruled all that you see both here and above! The people worshiped me and even Emperor Nero accepted my counsel from time to time. The fools within Rome knew nothing of the land here. If not for thier meddling, my name might be spoken by all even to this day! Now it seems some fool witch has begun to raise my fellow generals and soldiers from thier graves. I have no interest in the events that now transpire above and seek only to [end the torment] she has placed upon me. Yes! To exist as an undead is to know pain, a pain so horrible it can only be silenced through a second death. Do you not realize that this is the sole reason why my men continually attack all who trespass within this tomb? Thier only hope is for a swift end to thier awakened state and a return to the [sweet darkness]. This is why you have come to me <Player>! I seek to once more join my brethren in the after-life. Unfortunately the curse that keeps me in this state is intertwined with my generals. Each one must be silenced in turn and thier [focus item] offered up to me within the chamber of cleansing. From Olivarius will come a scepter, from Taras a sword, from Crotus a seal, and from Amminus an amulet. Each of these focus items with the exception of the last must first be used at this spot before the next one can be obtained. When you have acquired Amminus' amulet, proceed into the crypt of the displaced soul. If the amulet is used at this location my body will be summoned from beneath the crypt. This will be your chance to bestow your gift of silence upon me. Perhaps in my death, the [curse will be broken] and all who still walk within this tomb will be put to rest.

A514.offer: The hour is upon us. We have chosen our [final target] for your spell. It is our hope that in its undoing shall come the knowledge we have sought for so long. We shall soon know who raises the dead within our realm and what must be done to stop the evil necromancy.

Master Vismer.final target: There exists one know as Lunaris Primus Pilus. On his last command he lead a force against Barfog and perished on the battlefield. Entombed in a monastery, the commander has lain peacefully for over a hundred years. With the rise of the dead, the roman commander's sleep was broken and he now haunts the crumbled monastery. You must [put to rest] Lunaris primus pilus, but must do so within the walls of the monastery. Should he fall outside its walls, he will rise once again.
Master Vismer.put to rest: Use your spell as instructed. This is no different from the last. Here are your components, hopefully they are strong enough for the deed that lay before you. Good luck! Do not hesitate to join forces with others to [accomplish] this task.

npc_lines.Morgana: FOOL! You have meddled in my affairs for too long! Even now, as I take your only source of information, those idiots within your order learn of their failure. They watch even now! Let them now realize that trust should not have been put into one so weak. Prepare yourself, thy end is at hand. Flee while you still have breath! My children await on your voyage home!

A542.offer: I'm here to train you, to prepare you as best I can, for the day when you will choose your future path, as a necromancer or reaver, to do Arawn;s bidding, and [defeat Morgana].
A542.accept_line: Go speak to Trynt Madoc. He'll tell you what needs to be done.

Narah.defeat Morgana: Morgana has raised many of Arawn's souls, and she has also summoned to her side the Drakoran armies! These Drakoran are as much an enemy to Arawn as Morgana, for those that serve Morgana work against Arawn. The Drakoran invaded Avalon, and all that is here, in the Isle of Glass, that is all that is left of the people of Avalon. The others are dead. The cannot [fight the battle] alone.
Narah.fight the battle: But while they can no longer fight the battle against the Drakoran without our aid, many still mistrust us. Trynt Madoc has decided the best way to earn the trust and loyalty of the people of the Isle of Glass is to prove our value and dedication to the battle against Morgana. It is not required of you, but helping Trynt may be an [opportunutiy] to practice your skills.

Trynt Madoc.prove differently: I told Burton that the Inconnu brought a poison with them that is very effective against Drakoran. He said he would believe that there Inconnu are here to help if he could get a sample of the poison and the list of components to make it himself. Lirele, an Inconnu who is working with us, has agreed to help but she needs [a certain component] to finish the poison.
Trynt Madoc.a certain component: Lirele told me she needed the fin (of) a sea pup to complete the poison. They live in the waters around Gothwaite Harbor. Get one and take it to Lirele. [Step #2] Get the fin of a sea pup from the waters outside Gothwaite Harbor. Sea pups are located just to the end of town near the water's edge. Get a fin and take it to Lirele.

npc_lines.Trynt Madoc: Greetings young Disciple. What be thy name? Well, <Player>, I see that Magess Gwenllian has been doing her part to help improve the relations around her. You may not have noticed, but many people around here do not like Inconnu. I am not one of those people, but there is a man, a poison merchant just came to this land, Burton MacDougal, who believes that every last Inconnu us out to steal his soul. I have told him that I can [prove differently]. I told Burton that the Inconnu brought a poison with them that is very effective against Drakoran. He said he would believe that there Inconnu are here to help if he could get a sample of the poison and the list of components to make it himself. Lirele, an Inconnu who is working with us, has agreed to help but she needs [a certain component] to finish the poison. Lirele told me she needed the fin (of) a sea pup to complete the poison. They live in the waters around Gothwaite Harbor. Get one and take it to Lirele. [Step #2] Get the fin of a sea pup from the waters outside Gothwaite Harbor. Sea pups are located just to the end of town near the water's edge. Get a fin and take it to Lirele.
npc_lines.Lirele: Thank you. This should only take a minute. Here, take the poison and this scroll to Burton MacDougal. Tell him it is from Lirele the Inconnu.
npc_lines.Burton MacDougal: What do you want? I don't like your kind, so state your business quickly and get gone! Oh, you're from Lirele, eh? That doesn't change anything. That nasty Trynt told me the pale witch would be getting me some poison, but I haven't seen it yet. Did she send you over here with it? Let me have it. Hrmph, haven't seen something like this before. but this won't last me very long. Trynt said she'd tell me how to make it. I see the wench hasn't lived up to that promise. You just can't trust you Inconnu! Oh, hrmph, well, um, this is how to make it. Um, well, I guess that wench, er, Lirele, wasn't lying to me after all. Maybe she's not so bad after all, or you either, but I still don't trust the rest of 'em! Well, here, since you did some work, you can have this. But t his doesn't mean that I like you! Now, buy some poison or get out of here!

A543.offer: Trynt Madoc has said you did well. Now, he'd like you to help out again. It seems Sister Genette Ashlan has some problems with the Inconnu in general. It makes sense, as she is of the Church of Albion. We have always been rivals with the one god of that church. They are not known for their tolerance. But, Trynt Madoc believes it is important to have her stop [speaking out] against us in the town.
A543.accept_line: Right then. Speak to Genette. Tell her Tryby sent you.

Narah.speaking out: Yes, she believes it would be better to die at the hands of Morgana and her Drakoran minions than to consort with those of the realm of the dead. I do not believe many in the town share the same [sentiment], but it would be nice to not hear her cackling tongue for a change.

Sister Genette Ashlan.the storm hit: Aye, the storm that brought the likes of you to these shores. It has been a beautiful day that day. The evening started out beautiful too, clear and calm. A group of soldiers had left as the sun was just dipping below the horizon to go on patrol. With not a cloud in the sky, the group didn't take torches but relied upon the light of the stars to guide them. Out in the middle of nowhere, a group of those nasty Drakorans ambushed a group of soldiers. There was a violent fight with many dead on both sides. A few of the soldiers survived and managed to crawl back towards Caer Gothwaite. When they were spotted, the watchers [sent for me].
Sister Genette Ashlan.sent for me: I gathered my things and hurried outside to meet those poor men and women. They were seriously hurt, but I thought I could save them. I began to treat using a magical healing potion given to me but another healer. It cleans the wound and makes it heal much faster and also counteracts the evil poison of the Drakorans. As I moved along treating each wound, a breeze began to blow gently. It took a few hours for me to treat each of them. As I reached the last one, the wind began to blow harder. One of my assistants suddenly gasped as dark clouds rolled in, blocking out the light of the stars. As the rain began to fall, [we gathered up] the wounded and hurried into the shelter of the Caer. Before we had even crossed the courtyard the lightning was blinding and the thunder deafening, and we wondered if we would be drown by the rain.
Sister Genette Ashlan.we gathered up: In the chaos of the storm and protecting the soldiers, I dropped my healing potion. No one was brave enough to go back out and look for it. I tried to search for it, but the storm was too violent and I could not even make it out the door. I did my best to treat the last soldier, but [without the potion] I could not cure him of the poison and he died. All because of the likes of you! You caused the storm and make that soldier die! That is why I don't like your kind!
Sister Genette Ashlan.without the potion: Trynt said that Inconnu witch Lirele would replace my potion if I told her. The potion requires two bones from damp skeletons. Get them and take them to Lirele if you want to prove the Inconnu are not the evil creatures I believe they are!

npc_lines.Sister Genette Ashlan: What do you want? I make no secret that I dislike your kind. If you have some business with me, speak up, otherwise go away! Trynt, eh? He's a troublemaker, trying to make people think you Inconnu are worth having around. He wasn't here when [the storm hit]! Aye, the storm that brought the likes of you to these shores. It has been a beautiful day that day. The evening started out beautiful too, clear and calm. A group of soldiers had left as the sun was just dipping below the horizon to go on patrol. With not a cloud in the sky, the group didn't take torches but relied upon the light of the stars to guide them. Out in the middle of nowhere, a group of those nasty Drakorans ambushed a group of soldiers. There was a violent fight with many dead on both sides. A few of the soldiers survived and managed to crawl back towards Caer Gothwaite. When they were spotted, the watchers [sent for me]. I gathered my things and hurried outside to meet those poor men and women. They were seriously hurt, but I thought I could save them. I began to treat using a magical healing potion given to me but another healer. It cleans the wound and makes it heal much faster and also counteracts the evil poison of the Drakorans. As I moved along treating each wound, a breeze began to blow gently. It took a few hours for me to treat each of them. As I reached the last one, the wind began to blow harder. One of my assistants suddenly gasped as dark clouds rolled in, blocking out the light of the stars. As the rain began to fall, [we gathered up] the wounded and hurried into the shelter of the Caer. Before we had even crossed the courtyard the lightning was blinding and the thunder deafening, and we wondered if we would be drown by the rain. In the chaos of the storm and protecting the soldiers, I dropped my healing potion. No one was brave enough to go back out and look for it. I tried to search for it, but the storm was too violent and I could not even make it out the door. I did my best to treat the last soldier, but [without the potion] I could not cure him of the poison and he died. All because of the likes of you! You caused the storm and make that soldier die! That is why I don't like your kind! Trynt said that Inconnu witch Lirele would replace my potion if I told her. The potion requires two bones from damp skeletons. Get them and take them to Lirele if you want to prove the Inconnu are not the evil creatures I believe they are! Oh, so your're back. Did she make my potion? I'm guessing she didn't! Hhmm, this looks like my potion, but I'm going to have to test it out. I cut myself earlier. I shall try it on that cut. Well, apparently that Lirele knows her stuff. This is the same as my potion. When this runs out maybe I'll ask her to make me some more. Egad, did I jsut say that? Ask an Inconnu for something? Well, maybe the Inconnu aren't so bad if they can keep making my potion. Ack, what is wrong with me, saying things like that? Anyway, take this and go away before I say something good about the Inconnu!
npc_lines.Lirele: I see you have returned, <Player>. Trynt Madoc said you would. Genette Ashlan needs her potion replaced. Please give me the first damp skeleton bone so I may begin the potion. I have been sent by the great Arawn to help the people of Avalon. I am to assist Trynt Madoc and any others who will help us. I am to retrieve sould and aid in the fight against the Drakoran. All are to help defeat the Drakoran! Thank you, <Player>. Now please give me the second one. Well done. Now the potion is complete. Please take it to Genette Ashlan and give her our most humble apologies for causing the loss of the first potion. I shall speak with her later about the soul of the soldier that died.

M544.offer: Oh, I am not feeling very well at all. I don't think there's one member of this town that hasn't felt a little queasy at least (once?) from all the bad fish we've [eaten].
M544.accept_line: Oh good! Talk to Kedra about [bad fish]. She'll tell you what needs to be done.

Pedra.eaten: Aye, and now Kedra, the healer, is busy sorting out the worst! It turns out we are ate some bad fish. Now, Kedra says she is running our of her cure, and doesn't have time to get any more of the [ingredients]! Do you think you could help?

Kedra.sick: Yes. Sick. Why are you here? Are you sick? You don't look sick to me. You can help me. I am running out of my cure! I don't have time to go get the [marine fungus] I need!
Kedra.marine fungus: Aye. I mash it up and add herbs to it. It's a great cure! I need more though! Go get me a marine fungus. I will pay you for it! And the whole town will thank you, when they are through wretching up the illness, that is.

npc_lines.Kedra: Fish! The entire town has eaten bad fish! It is crazy! I told them not to! I told them the moon's position in the sky indicated a bad harvest of fish, but did anyone listen? And now, everyone is [sick]. Yes. Sick. Why are you here? Are you sick? You don't look sick to me. You can help me. I am running out of my cure! I don't have time to go get the [marine fungus] I need! Aye. I mash it up and add herbs to it. It's a great cure! I need more though! Go get me a marine fungus. I will pay you for it! And the whole town will thank you, when they are through wretching up the illness, that is. Oh thank you! The stench of the ill is getting to me! I can make a few more batches of my cure after this, and then be done with it all! This will teach everyone to ignore me! Let's see if they eat the fish the next time I say the moon isn't right! Here, I hope this is enough. Thank you for your aid!

M545.offer: <Player>, good to see you. Are you looking for something to pass your time with? Perhaps you would be [interested] in aiding a friend of mine, then?
M545.accept_line: Great! Go speak to Bernt. He'll set you up.

Pedra.interested: Aye. Bernt's his name, He's a bit of an explorer. He's got wind of some mineral [deposits] he would like to take a look at. He's always got a job for those looking to explore a bit.

Bernt.exploring: Aye, I could use your aid, if you don't mind a bit of danger. You see, there's some minerals embedded in some rocks not too far from here. Now it's not a whole mine or anything, but I want to know what sort of mineral it is. There's one [problem].
Bernt.problem: Aye, there's some creatures about that make it hard to get to. Now, I'd go and fight off the creatures myself, but you know, I've got some work to do here, and really can't be bothered. That's why I'm [willing to pay] you.
Bernt.willing to pay: Ha! Of course I'm going to pay! I've been here long enough to know nobody's here for the pleasure of being here! Everyone wants something! Land! Treasure! Fame! Whatever it is. Well, are you [satisfied] I'll pay you?
Bernt.satisfied: There are some stray scimitar cubs near the mineral deposit. Remove the cubs to find the deposit. Many cuvs are found bsouthwest, just past the bridge.

npc_lines.Bernt: Mystic, here to do some [exploring]? Aye, I could use your aid, if you don't mind a bit of danger. You see, there's some minerals embedded in some rocks not too far from here. Now it's not a whole mine or anything, but I want to know what sort of mineral it is. There's one [problem]. Aye, there's some creatures about that make it hard to get to. Now, I'd go and fight off the creatures myself, but you know, I've got some work to do here, and really can't be bothered. That's why I'm [willing to pay] you. Ha! Of course I'm going to pay! I've been here long enough to know nobody's here for the pleasure of being here! Everyone wants something! Land! Treasure! Fame! Whatever it is. Well, are you [satisfied] I'll pay you? There are some stray scimitar cubs near the mineral deposit. Remove the cubs to find the deposit. Many cuvs are found bsouthwest, just past the bridge. Ah, then did you find the thing I was looking for? Any of those rocks with those mineral bits on 'em? Great! I'm sure we can sort out what this is, and where we might find some more, if it proves to be any use! I've got a whole bunch of dwarven clans just eeking for a reason to come out here! If I can sell them on this area, I'll get a nice fee! Ah, but I promised you a fee as well, didn't I? Well then, I'll keep my word friend. Here you are! Good working with your Mystic.

H546.offer: There was once a time when all of Hy Brasil was tame. There was once a time when nature's beasts were tame. Now, though, the creatures we once had no reason to fear, have become aggressive. They kill not just for food, but for pleasure. They no longer only kill their normal prey. Now, the [hunt] us.
H546.accept_line: Great! While you are at it, bring one of the lunger tails to Resalg. He will pay you well for it. He is trying to create some potion. I told him I'd acquire a tail for him.

Miach.hunt: Aye. It is not their normal way. I believe it is the evil touch of the Fomorians! They have ruined the homes of many of these creatures, they have destroyed their hunting grounds, and now, some of the creatures have become twisted and [abhorrent]! The beasts I speak of, close to our town, the lungers, we must get ird of them! Dialog box: Will you help rid the area of young lungers?

Resalg.formula: Aye. It will calm down the maddened animals, I think. I can't truly be sure, but I'm hoping so! Some of the animals have even been mutated, since the Fomorian's arrival, you know. I blame the foulness of that maleficent race! I would like to aid the Sylvan, I would like to see this ravaged land restored, and the peaceful balance that has taken generations upon generations to develop, once again restored. Aye, and I'll not lie, but I'm willing to bet I'd have a name, if I were to aid the process in some way! Maybe some prestige! Ah, but to work, yes, to work now. Here, I shall pay you for this tail! Good day, friend!

npc_lines.Resalg: What can I do for you, fine Forester? Ah! You've brought me a lunger tail! Now, I'm not sure if this is going to work, but I think it just might, yes, it just might. You see, I'm working on a special [formula]. Aye. It will calm down the maddened animals, I think. I can't truly be sure, but I'm hoping so! Some of the animals have even been mutated, since the Fomorian's arrival, you know. I blame the foulness of that maleficent race! I would like to aid the Sylvan, I would like to see this ravaged land restored, and the peaceful balance that has taken generations upon generations to develop, once again restored. Aye, and I'll not lie, but I'm willing to bet I'd have a name, if I were to aid the process in some way! Maybe some prestige! Ah, but to work, yes, to work now. Here, I shall pay you for this tail! Good day, friend!

H547.offer: <Player>, I've spoken with Liisu. Do you know, she wants us to go after the [sylvanshades]!

Miach.sylvanshades: The [sylvanshades] are strange creatures of darkness. They exist opposite the Sylvan, but where the Sylvan are nurturing, they are destructive. Liisu wants help protecting the groves.

npc_lines.Liisu: Ah, <Player>, what would your name be? Ah. I did not expect anyone so soon. But I'm glad you are here. You are here to help me, right? I would like you to save a grove that the lesser sylvanshades are doing quite a destructive number on. These groves have been with us for so long, and we've lost so many already. Please, help us save this one! I need yo uto go find two of the lesser sylvanshades that are wrecking this grove! Rrturn them to me when you have them. Please find them before there is no chance for me to heal the grove! Bring me anything you find on them please! I've lost so many seeds! Oh, <Player>, have you found two of my seed pouches? I think there are more, but so many have offered to aid me that I've gottem most of them back, and haven't had time to count it! I'm going to plant these in the groves that were damages. Maybe the new growth will stimulate the groves! I am horrified that the sylvanshades even exist! It does make sense, though, with all the Fomorian evil corrupting the land. Well then, give it here! Oh great! This one is still full, too! The horrid beasts didn't eat many of the seeds from this pouch! You should have seen some of the ones I've gotten returned to me! Thank you, <Player>!

H548.offer: We could use your help again, with the young grove trees we are growing. We cultivate the grove trees, and grow them as our homes, naturally, without hurting them. It seems the growth is being [disturbed].
H548.accept_line: Great! Speak to Liisu then. She's very disturbed about this whole thing!

Miach.disturbed: I'm not sure what it is, but Liisu would like our help [again].

Liisu.disturbing: Yes. The grove trees just aren't growing right! Some of them seem to be growing toward a malformed state! I'm not sure what it is! We don't think it's another form of magic interfering with it, since we can't detect any. We don't even know if it's intentional! But it's hurting the groves, and interfering with our magic! We've got to stop it! I've gone to [Aapo], for his help!
Liisu.Aapo: Yes, Aapo is the Druid envoy, sent to help us from the Druid Court. He's worked on a way to help us locate the source of all the disruption. He said I should send you to him. He will tell you how you can help.

Aapo.Liisu: Ah, is it wonderful to be here, <Player>, amongst the [Sylvan]?
Aapo.Sylvan: Right. The groves are being disturbed somehow, and nobody knows how. I've seen this sort of thing before, though, and may have an idea of what's going on. You see, a long time ago, nature in Hibernia got twisted. All things were affected; plantsm animals, and even us, the Celts! Sometimes, the land reacts to evil. It senses evil, and occasionally, the result is an [abomination] of what is normal.
Aapo.abomination: Nature became twisted. Creatures turned malevolent. The very trees turned horrific creatures of destruction. This was a very long time ago, and even still, some of these creatures remain! I believe the evil of the fomorian has done this to the creatures of Hy Brasil. I believe that one of these [twisted] creatures may be somehow disturbing the balance between the natural magic of the groves and the natural magic of the Sylvan.
Aapo.twisted: I've fashioned this item for you. Wear it, and seek out any of the creatures of the area. When the necklace starts glowing, you will know you are near. I would like to give you a greater idea of what you seek, but I can't. Wear the necklace. It will [guide] you.
Aapo.guide: I do believe the tangleweeds may be disturbing the groves. Perhaps they are digging into the roots of the grove trees. If I am correct, I will need two of the tangle weeds, to study.
Aapo.instructions: Ah. Well, I've learned that not only tangleweeds, but lost shrillers, have been affecting the groves! Well, others have helped me with the lost shrillers. Did you spread the [magical seeds]?
Aapo.magical seeds: Great! I heartily thank you. It's been a rough time, what with the tangleweeds spreading! Here, take this coin, it should aid you. Again, I thank you. Now the grove trees will have a better chance of growing!

npc_lines.Liisu: Have you decided to help me? I figured I could count on you. You see, there is a natural balance we maintain with nature. We use our magic to form the grove trees. We were trying to grow a grove of young trees into a new residence. It was working fine. Now, though, something is [disturbing] this magic! Yes. The grove trees just aren't growing right! Some of them seem to be growing toward a malformed state! I'm not sure what it is! We don't think it's another form of magic interfering with it, since we can't detect any. We don't even know if it's intentional! But it's hurting the groves, and interfering with our magic! We've got to stop it! I've gone to [Aapo], for his help! Yes, Aapo is the Druid envoy, sent to help us from the Druid Court. He's worked on a way to help us locate the source of all the disruption. He said I should send you to him. He will tell you how you can help.

I've seen this sort of thing before, though, and may have an idea of what's going on. You see, a long time ago, nature in Hibernia got twisted. I believe the evil of the fomorian has done this to the creatures of Hy Brasil. I believe that one of these [twisted] creatures may be somehow disturbing the balance between the natural magic of the groves and the natural magic of the Sylvan. I've fashioned this item for you. Wear it, and seek out any of the creatures of the area. When the necklace starts glowing, you will know you are near. I would like to give you a greater idea of what you seek, but I can't. Wear the necklace. It will [guide] you. I do believe the tangleweeds may be disturbing the groves. Perhaps they are digging into the roots of the grove trees. If I am correct, I will need two of the tangle weeds, to study. Ah. Good to see you! Did you get the tangleweeds? They are strangling the roots of the new grove trees. It's a sad state Hy Brasil is in. Well, then, give me the first tangleweed. Great. Now, here. I need you to go to the grove trees that these tangleweeds fed off of, and spread this mixture of leaves and seeds. It will help heal some of the roots, and also plant new grove trees. If you don't know how to use the seeds, speak to Mirari. Tell her you need [instructions]. Ah. Well, I've learned that not only tangleweeds, but lost shrillers, have been affecting the groves! Well, others have helped me with the lost shrillers. Did you spread the [magical seeds]? Great! I heartily thank you. It's been a rough time, what with the tangleweeds spreading! Here, take this coin, it should aid you. Again, I thank you. Now the grove trees will have a better chance of growing!
npc_lines.Aaop: Ah. Hand me the second tangleweed.

H549.offer: Soon will come the time when you must choose between life as an animist, and life as a valwalker. It is already your destiny to walk the [Path of Affinity].
H549.accept_line: Ah, then talk with Faolan, first, to learn about life as an Animist.

Miach.Path of Affinity: Yes, it has always been our way, to start out as the Way of the Grove, and then follow the Path of [Affinity], when we are ready. You do have a choice in your path, however.

Faolan.Animist: Animists have an affinity with plants. We can animate plants, and use the magic of nature and the plant life nature produces when needed. There was a time when most of the magic we used was for simply shaping our homes and becoming closer to nature. Now, though, it seems we use our magic and our affinity with plants to defend. I know that the Druids and Wardens and Bards feel a desire to protect nature. As animists, we believe we should be nature. It is a hard thing to achieve, but it is what we believe. Now, speak to Oriara. She can tell you about life as a valewalker.

npc_lines.Faolan: Ah, I imagine you're here to learn about the Path of Affinity and life as an [Animist]. Animists have an affinity with plants. We can animate plants, and use the magic of nature and the plant life nature produces when needed. There was a time when most of the magic we used was for simply shaping our homes and becoming closer to nature. Now, though, it seems we use our magic and our affinity with plants to defend. I know that the Druids and Wardens and Bards feel a desire to protect nature. As animists, we believe we should be nature. It is a hard thing to achieve, but it is what we believe. Now, speak to Oriara. She can tell you about life as a valewalker.
npc_lines.Oriara: Ah, you are here to learn about life as a [Valewalker] are you not?
npc_lines.Oriana: Valewalkers follow the Path of Affinity. The Path of Affinity is dear to Sylvan, though Firbolgs and Celts are more than welcome to follow it. The Path of Affinity believes that nature is perfection, and balance, and correct. The closer one is to nature, the closer one us to the way things should be. To become nature, that is our goal, for once we are a part of nature, then we have achieved true meaning. As Valewalkers, we use the magic of nature and our strength to fight for our land. Think of your choices, and choose wisely.

H550.offer: Hail, <Player>. I am Fylara MacKieran, armor-maker for Comor Mac Gwion and my father, Lughaidh MacKieran. I've been making armor since I was a child. My mother taught me how to sew and my uncle Monaghan taught me how to forge armor. When I was old enough, I learned old secrets to make armor that is better than what you can buy from the merchants. My father was most pleased with my skills and [intriduced me] to Conor Mac Gwion.
H550.accept_line: You want to help? That is wonderful! In exchange for helping me, I will give you this piece of armor I'm finishing up. But I need you to replace the items I'm using right nowso that Conor will not become angry at me for giving away a piece of his army's armor. [One of the pieces] is fairly easy to get, but the other is more difficult.
H550.finish: Heed my words, <Player>! I would not try this alone! Ixthiar doomcallers and reapers guard the nests. Pick one nest and exterminate all the creatures close to it. When all are dead, the broodmother will sense this and will come to the surface. You must defeat her to obtain the carapace. It will not be easy, but with a few associates you should be able to win. Once you have the pelt and the carapace, come back to me and speak with me.

Fylara MacKieran.intriduced me: Conor was impressed with my skills and immediately put me to work making armor for his army. When Conor led his forces here to Hy Brasil to aid the Sylvan, I made sure I was one of the first here. I have always made my armor from natural things, and I knew I would [find new things] here to use in my armor.
Fylara MacKieran.find new things: The bars of the trees, the hides of animals, and various parts of the wild creatures that roam the land - all these things became potential parts of armor. I studied things and tried out different combinations until I was happy. I took my creations to my father and asked him to pass them on to Conor for his opinion. Conor was most pleased and charged me with [making enough] for the entire army!
Fylara MacKieran.making enough: That wouldn't be such a problem except that Conor's army us huge! I have been trying my best to collect the items I need to make this armor, but I've been having trouble. They are fairly rare items and it takes a long time to make even one piece of armor. I could use someone to gather the items while I finish up the pieces I'm working on. Do you [know of anyone] that could help me?
Fylara MacKieran.One of the pieces: The first thing you need to get is the tongue of a gorge shriller. Their tongues are tough and hold well in battle. I have begun using them to reinforce the hinges of scale armor. You will find these creatures if you cross the wooden bridge near here and head north. I will not lie to you; getting the tongue will be the easy part. Have you heard of [the ixthiar]?
Fylara MacKieran.the ixthiar: They are vile creatures, bent on destroying anything that gets in their path. They hate all Sylvan and their allies but I've found that [a certain kind] of ixthiar has a carapace that makes very good reinforcements for armor.
Fylara MacKieran.a certain kind: I speak of the ixthiar broodmothers. They are elusive creatures, but I have discovered the secret to draw them out of their homes. Across the river and northwest of here there are five huge trees that were once in habited by Sylvan. But with the coming of the Fomorian, the Sylvan fled their homes, abandoning them to any and all creatures. The ixthiar broodmothers took up residence in these trees, producing their young to fill the land with evil. Most of the time the broodmothers live deep within the roots of the trees, but when their young are exterminated, they wil come to the surface to begin producing more. That is how you [will lure] a ixthiar broodmother out.
Fylara MacKieran.will lure: Heed my words, <Player>! I would not try this alone! Ixthiar doomcallers and reapers guard the nests. Pick one nest and exterminate all the creatures close to it. When all are dead, the broodmother will sense this and will come to the surface. You must defeat her to obtain the carapace. It will not be easy, but with a few associates you should be able to win. Once you have the pelt and the carapace, come back to me and speak with me.

Sarah.brave adventurer: Please pardon my sarcasm, but I have seen more than a healthy handful of brave adventurers come around here, only to be killed by the [undead].
Sarah.undead: I don't know who's doing it, but I've seen dead men and women brought back here with gouges so large in their chests, you'd think a small tree has been shoved through them! I think I know [what creature] is doing this though.
Sarah.what creature: I think it's the skeletal elk. They have antlers large enough to gouge a man nearly in half! If you find one, bring its antlers to me so I may study them and compare them to the bodies that have just arrived.

npc_lines.Sarah: Oh, you scared me. What are you doing around these parts? You must be another [brave adventurer]. Please pardon my sarcasm, but I have seen more than a healthy handful of brave adventurers come around here, only to be killed by the [undead]. I don't know who's doing it, but I've seen dead men and women brought back here with gouges so large in their chests, you'd think a small tree has been shoved through them! I think I know [what creature] is doing this though. I think it's the skeletal elk. They have antlers large enough to gouge a man nearly in half! If you find one, bring its antlers to me so I may study them and compare them to the bodies that have just arrived.

M552.offer: Well, you have done well. You passed the trial of strength without difficulty, and Idena spoke of your intelligence in dealing with those riddles. I myself have solved them, so I know what they are like. I'm glad you did well, for now it is time to face the [third and final trial].
M552.accept_line: Then you must go speak to Rania. She is one of the Valkyn that has been involved in training many young Vikings since she came to Aegirhamn. She is expecting you.

Torold Sterkkriger.third and final trial: The kast trial you will face will prove your bravery. If you pass this trial, you will have shown that you have the potential to survive in the wilds of Aegir. Are [you ready] to face this third trial?

Rania.a hundred men: Oh fear not, we shall not send you against a hundred men! You only need to face two. There are creatures called naive sjora. They can be fierce when engaged in combat. I want you to face two naive sjora. I will need proof that you defeated them and didn't run from combat. Naive sjora wear shell necklaces. I want you to get one of those. Also. when naive sjora die, they will often utter some words. You must listen to them and remember that word. Once you have both, return to me here. I wish you luck!

npc_lines.Rania: Hello. I have been expecting you. You have passed teh first two trials, but strength and brains mean nothing if you flee at the first sign of danger. The Morvaltar are not a group to run. They will fight to the death. I have seen a single Morvalt face [a hundred men] and not flee. Now, I'm not saying that Morvalt wasn't scared, but he was able to stand his ground. Oh fear not, we shall not send you against a hundred men! You only need to face two. There are creatures called naive sjora. They can be fierce when engaged in combat. I want you to face two naive sjora. I will need proof that you defeated them and didn't run from combat. Naive sjora wear shell necklaces. I want you to get one of those. Also. when naive sjora die, they will often utter some words. You must listen to them and remember that word. Once you have both, return to me here. I wish you luck! Welcome back. Please give me the sjora shell necklace. Now for the tricky part of the trial. You can obtain the necklace from others, but the words are for your ears alone. Tell me what they are. Very good! You have passed all three trials! Here, take this to help you prepare to meet the trainers who will continue to guide you towards your destiny. I shall let Torold know you passed the final trial. Well done!

H554.offer: Well then, you've definately come to the right place! For I, Letselina, have something new, just for [you]!

Letselina.you: Yes! You see, we've been having a little bit of trouble with the bugbear nuisances lately, and we're trying to find someone to help us with the problem. Maybe you would [care to help] us?
Letselina.care to help: Excellent! Ok, we're trying to thin the bugbear herds that migrate around here, and we're having very poor luck in doing that. If you were to thin the herds for us, and bring us back their snouts as proof, I'm sure we'd [reward] you.
Letselina.reward: I'm sure we can dig up something for you. So, hurry off! There are bugbear [nuisances] to deal with!

A555.offer: There's some group that is trying to have those of the Temple of Awarn leave. They feel as Sister Genette Ashlan did, that the town is better off [falling to the Drakoran] than working with us.
A555.accept_line: Speak to Trynt Madoc about the group of people speaking out against the Inconnu.

Narah.falling to the Drakoran: Well, that is the [alternative] to accepting our aid, since they obviously can't defeat Morgana without our help. Trynt recognizes this, and would like your help again.

Trynt Madoc.servants of Morgana: Yes, I cannot believe it either, for I have seen the Inconnu out on the field of battle, sacrificing themselves in the fight against the Drakoran and Morgana's undead. They won't stop fighting until the last breath has passed through their lips. Yet still people do not believe they are here to help but will [be our downfall].
Trynt Madoc.be our downfall: Now, not everyone believes this, but there is a core group that does. The group's second in command is a woman named Tessa Ohrman. She is always saying the Inconnu are here to stir up the undead, not gather up the souls ripped from their peaceful slumber by Morgana. We need you to prove to Tessa that she is wrong about the Inconnu. If we win Tessa to our side, she will convince the leader, Calder to change his mind. Go to Tessa now, and speak with her. I told her you would be coming to speak with her.

Tessa Ohrman.causing trouble: The undead have been attacking people, especially the headless dead. They are the remains of people who have had terrible accidents upon the shores of this land. They never bothered us until the Inconnu came! Everyone said it was Morgana's doing, but I know the truth! If you think you can prove that the Inconnu are not here to cause trouble, [retrieve the souls] of three headless dead.
Tessa Ohrman.retrieve the souls: When you have them, take them to that Inconnu Lirele over there. She claims she can send them away, but I don't believe her. You get them, take them to her, and I'll watch to see if she does it or if she turns them loosee on us here in Caer Gothwaite! Now go!
Tessa Ohrman.can admit: It's not easy, and I don't trust the Inconnu, but I will stop saying that they are here to cause trouble, and I will work on changing Calder's mind too. I don't know if he will listen, but I will try. To show I am not such a bad person as some think, please [sic]take this.

npc_lines.Trynt Madoc: Greetings again. I am so glad you've been able to help improve the relations between some of the people here in Caer Gothwaite and the Inconnu. Sadly, there are still some who speak badly of the Inconnu. They have been going around telling everyone that the Inconnu are the [servants of Morgana]! Yes, I cannot believe it either, for I have seen the Inconnu out on the field of battle, sacrificing themselves in the fight against the Drakoran and Morgana's undead. They won't stop fighting until the last breath has passed through their lips. Yet still people do not believe they are here to help but will [be our downfall]. Now, not everyone believes this, but there is a core group that does. The group's second in command is a woman named Tessa Ohrman. She is always saying the Inconnu are here to stir up the undead, not gather up the souls ripped from their peaceful slumber by Morgana. We need you to prove to Tessa that she is wrong about the Inconnu. If we win Tessa to our side, she will convince the leader, Calder to change his mind. Go to Tessa now, and speak with her. I told her you would be coming to speak with her.
npc_lines.Tessa Ohrman: So, you're the one Trynt said he'd send to me. What's your name? Well, I'll be honest with you. I don't like Incommu and I only agreed to speak with you because Trynt wouldn't go away until I did. If you want to know what the cause of all the problems around here is, look no farther than the Inconnu! The got all these undead riled up, [causing trouble] with the people around here. The undead have been attacking people, especially the headless dead. They are the remains of people who have had terrible accidents upon the shores of this land. They never bothered us until the Inconnu came! Everyone said it was Morgana's doing, but I know the truth! If you think you can prove that the Inconnu are not here to cause trouble, [retrieve the souls] of three headless dead. When you have them, take them to that Inconnu Lirele over there. She claims she can send them away, but I don't believe her. You get them, take them to her, and I'll watch to see if she does it or if she turns them loosee on us here in Caer Gothwaite! Now go! I saw you over there with that Inconnu Lirele. I saw what she did with those spirits. She didn't make them come attack me! I thought she would, but she didn't. I'd have to see her do it more, but maybe I was wrong. Yes, even I [can admit] I am wrong! It's not easy, and I don't trust the Inconnu, but I will stop saying that they are here to cause trouble, and I will work on changing Calder's mind too. I don't know if he will listen, but I will try. To show I am not such a bad person as some think, please [sic]take this.
npc_lines.The headless dead: Thank you for freeing me... Thank you for freeing me... Thank you for freeing me...
npc_lines.Lirele: It is good to see you again. I overheard your conversation with Tessa. She fears us, and together you and I shall show her she has no reason to fear the Inconnu. Please give me the first soul. Good, now the second. Thank you. Now the third please.

M558.offer: You are looking well. Have you been out [exploring]?
M558.accept_line: It's known as <Player>. When you kill it, bring me it's carcass, and you will be well rewarded.
M558.finish: Ah! I must tell you, Longbeard and Ota have been crawling all over each other and everyone else in the town to get this beast! They both want to claim it as their prize! Ha! Well, not that I want to get involved in the in-fighting on the dwarven kobold expedition, but really, somebody had to end this <Player> obsession once and for all. I figured it'd be a better thing for me to have <Player>. That way, Longbeard and Ota can't spend precious time trying to outdo each other. Oh! But imagine the looks they will have when they see <Player>! Just a small benefit from all this! Here, I promised you a reward, though. Thanks. You've be a great help!
giver_turnins: <Player>? I see you have <Player>! I recognize that foul carcass anywhere! Did you know, he ate Gworf, a long time companion or Longbeard's He hasn't taken that very well!

Karle Alfevson.exploring: Have you seen the giant sea beast that has been [ravaging the town] when it can't feed off anything else?
Karle Alfevson.ravaging the town: Well, not the whole town. Just the people in it. The beast belongs out to sea, but somehow, it got stuck here, in the inlet of water and the harbor. [Occasionally], when it runs out of fresh fish and can't find any animals roaming the shores, it comes to town. We need to kill this beast.
