Nibalk.<Player>: Yes, that large sea beast that's been devouring people everywhere. I understand that Ota, Karle, and Longbeard are all offering rewards for the carcass, to hang as trophies. I don't think that's what should be done! What a waste! No no no no listen to me. Take the carcass to the [Mussalkan].
Nibalk.Mussalkan: A creature like <Player> is a gift to them! Althought they know him as Molvor. They can do so much with it! They will give you tokens, talismans, and trinkets of all sorts if you give them the carcass of a beast such as <Player>! These trinkets and tokens, and the talismans, if you bring them to me, I will pay you not only for killing <Player>, bu also for the trinkets they give you in exchange for the carcass! Think of it. It's worth more to ya!

Gazsi.nonsense: The sea beast, <Player>. There are a few who have expressed interest in having the beast killed and returned to the town, to be displayed as a trophy! Rewards were promised, but still the <Player> it is more valuable to the Musslaklan than it is to the leaders. It would also please me, more, to see the beast everyone around here is calling <Player> give to the Musslaklan. They will use the remains to feed themselves, create items from the bones, and will find some uses for the [carcass], I imagine. They generally do.
Gazsi.carcass: Yes. Kill <Player>, I agree. But don't take the carcass to those expeditionaries who want to display it on their walls or huts as trophies. They will pay you some money, but the musslaklan will pay you in tokens and trinkets. Turn the carcass of <Player> in to a Musslaklan Trader and bring me the trinkets and tokens. The musslaklan know <Player> as Movlor. Remember that. I will pay you a reward for the carcass, and I will pay you for the trinkets. It's your choice.

npc_lines.Nibalk: Hey! Hey! Come here! Are you hunting [<Player>]? Yes, that large sea beast that's been devouring people everywhere. I understand that Ota, Karle, and Longbeard are all offering rewards for the carcass, to hang as trophies. I don't think that's what should be done! What a waste! No no no no listen to me. Take the carcass to the [Mussalkan]. A creature like <Player> is a gift to them! Althought they know him as Molvor. They can do so much with it! They will give you tokens, talismans, and trinkets of all sorts if you give them the carcass of a beast such as <Player>! These trinkets and tokens, and the talismans, if you bring them to me, I will pay you not only for killing <Player>, bu also for the trinkets they give you in exchange for the carcass! Think of it. It's worth more to ya!
npc_lines.Gazsi: Come speak to me! Are you part of the [nonsense]? The sea beast, <Player>. There are a few who have expressed interest in having the beast killed and returned to the town, to be displayed as a trophy! Rewards were promised, but still the <Player> it is more valuable to the Musslaklan than it is to the leaders. It would also please me, more, to see the beast everyone around here is calling <Player> give to the Musslaklan. They will use the remains to feed themselves, create items from the bones, and will find some uses for the [carcass], I imagine. They generally do. Yes. Kill <Player>, I agree. But don't take the carcass to those expeditionaries who want to display it on their walls or huts as trophies. They will pay you some money, but the musslaklan will pay you in tokens and trinkets. Turn the carcass of <Player> in to a Musslaklan Trader and bring me the trinkets and tokens. The musslaklan know <Player> as Movlor. Remember that. I will pay you a reward for the carcass, and I will pay you for the trinkets. It's your choice. Miep, ah, I am thinking you are coming to me because you did the right thing and turned Movlor in to the Musslakam? Did they give you any gifts? I shall pay you for what they have given you. Ah! Talisman! I value these! They are often times objects of great power! I've always been interested in the primitive cultures of this land. They often can tap into magics we are unaware of! Well, but these are of no interest to you. Here, I promised you I'd pay you. I hope this is sufficient. Oh, and here, a reward, for ridding the town of one of its biggest threats, the sea beast known as <Player>. I do hope there aren't many others!
npc_lines.Ota Yrling: Ah. Do you have a carcass? The carcass of <Player>? Did you defeat him? Tell me you did! I will pay you a handsome price for that carcass! Yes! Ha! Longbeard can eat it! I've got <Player>! I've got <Player>! Longbeard is going to have to eat his words now! Telling me I haven't the sense of a huldu! Huh! Well! Here, I've promised you a reward, you shall have it!
npc_lines.Longbeard: Aye! <Player>! Did you get me <Player>? The beast? That vile, ugly, malicious smelling stinking rotten beast that?s eaten my friend Gworf? Argh. Thank you! Here, as payment for your great deeds! Gwarf, ahh, my friend Gworf, justice has been done in your name.
npc_lines.Musslaklan Trader: I see you have Movlor. You give him to me, I will give you gifts! Gazsi likes our gifts. I'll give you gifts for Movlor, you take to trade with Gazsi. Movlor is large. Has eaten many the musslaklan youth. But we could not hunt him!

M561.offer: Hail. I am Torold, and I shall be your trainer in this wild land. King Goran Stonefist and his brother Stonelock have charged me with training all young Vikings to prepare them to join the ranks of King Goran's army to aid in the exploration of Aegir. Aegir is a wild, untamed place, and it's made even more dangerous for a your Viking like you by the presence of [Morvaltar].

Torold Sterkkriger.Morvaltar: As you may know, the Morvaltar are your wild cousins. We of Midgard do not fear Valkyn like you, for as a group you have more than proven your loyalty to King Goran. Many Valkyn have also proven that they are strong, intelligent, and brave. These are [the qualities] that all Vikings must possess before they can choose where their destiny lies.
Torold Sterkkriger.the qualities: Now, young one, prepare yourself. You have three trials to face before I can allow you to make your destiny. These trials are designed to separate the true Vikings from the everyday Valkyn. So, prepare yourself now, for you trial is waiting for you. It is a test to [prove your strength]. Only the strongest will survive in this land.

Jorund Bruttstein.one of the creatures: You must seek out a marine fungus. They may be found in the waters south and southwest of here. Find one and defeat it. Once you have, obtain proof that you have accomplished this test. Return to me here.

npc_lines.Jorund Bruttstein: Lo, I see a young Viking before me. What is your name? Speak up! You are here to prove that you have the strength in you to endure in this land. The trial is simple in nature, but unless you are strong, may prove difficult to execute. You must venture out and face [one of the creatures] that roam this land. You must seek out a marine fungus. They may be found in the waters south and southwest of here. Find one and defeat it. Once you have, obtain proof that you have accomplished this test. Return to me here. So, you managed to survive, but anyone can run away. Show me the proof you defeated the marine fungus. Well done. I do not like to be so rough with young Vikings, but I must be. I do not want to see anyone die because I failed to do my job. But you have proven that you have the potential for great strength. I shall let your trainer know of your success.

H562.offer: Hello there, I am Orlaith, a potter in these part. I was wondering if, perhaps, you'd like to help me with a little [quest]?

Orlaith.quest: It's a simple one, really. I need some magical sand from a creature called a [sanidon].
Orlaith.sanidon: They camoflague themselves in the sand around here, but I know their sand can help me make the most beautiful glass vases of all time! Do you think you could [get me some] sand?
Orlaith.get me some: Oh thank you, thank you! Like I said, the sanidon roam the sandy beaches of this area. Be careful, though. They are fierce [hunters] as well. Good luck!

M563.accept_line: Ah a brave Mystic you are! Great! Go speak to Nibalk. He will tell you more.

Pedra.Nibalk: Yes. He's a troll. He's also a bit of a spiritual leader in this area. He's working on the Valkyn [problem].
Pedra.problem: It seems the Mother, that old, vile diety that are [worshipped] by the more primitive of the Valkyn have begun to haunt them. The ones that have been here a while have been suffering terribly from lack of sleep. Perhaps you could help?

Nibalk.meditate: Aye. It is not my nature to do so, but it had to be done. I finally had to beg for help from the [gods].
Nibalk.gods: Well, I certainly can't defeat a deity. Gazsi himself can't, though he is just as afflicted as the rest! He can't do the simplest tasks. The nightmares of the Mother has inflicted upon them all has made them [weak].
Nibalk.weak: Yes. Weak. But I have appealed to the gods, and as you are here, I can only think I have been answered. They have promised me their aid in defeating the Mother. But they have asked a small [price].
Nibalk.price: They fell it is weakness that has allowed the Mother to enter the minds of the followers of the Norse gods, so we must prove our strength. If we prove our strength, than they will lend us theirs. So, I've a [challenge] for you.
Nibalk.challenge: This is not about brains, but strength. I need you defeat three naive sjoras. Bring me their ears, as proof. This will prove some strength, I think, to the gods that have answered me. Remember, return with three ears!

npc_lines.Nibalk: Oh. I have been greatly disturbed by the problems of the Valkyn. Now mind you, none of the recent explorers or adventures have suffered like the older Valkyn, but still. It has been rough. I have had to [meditate] for days. Aye. It is not my nature to do so, but it had to be done. I finally had to beg for help from the [gods]. Well, I certainly can't defeat a deity. Gazsi himself can't, though he is just as afflicted as the rest! He can't do the simplest tasks. The nightmares of the Mother has inflicted upon them all has made them [weak]. Yes. Weak. But I have appealed to the gods, and as you are here, I can only think I have been answered. They have promised me their aid in defeating the Mother. But they have asked a small [price]. They fell it is weakness that has allowed the Mother to enter the minds of the followers of the Norse gods, so we must prove our strength. If we prove our strength, than they will lend us theirs. So, I've a [challenge] for you. This is not about brains, but strength. I need you defeat three naive sjoras. Bring me their ears, as proof. This will prove some strength, I think, to the gods that have answered me. Remember, return with three ears! Well then, did you get the ears? Ah good deal then. Hand them in. One at a time. Ah good. Two more then. Well, one more, friend. Great! The gods should be pleased! Now, if you'll excuse me, I must place these in an area blessed by the gods. Tonight, well, tonight all should get a good night's rest! Ah, but here, let me give you some coin for your troubles.

M566.offer: Good day to you Agrissi. I am in need of some [assistance] if you could help.
M566.accept_line: Ah, some bones, thank you friend. If you happen to get anymore, I would gladly take them from you.

Anakoll.assistance: Yes. There have been some undead around here lately that are causing problems. Specifically, the [yellowed skeletons].
Anakoll.yellowed skeletons: I have been studying them for some time now, but I have yet to be able to get my hands on a sample of their bones. If you can, please get me some bones so I might be able to complete my [research].

M567.offer: Welcome friend, welcome. Take a look at my wares, but don't touch unles you want to buy. haha! No, seriously, my stuff is the best. Except, lately, I've been losing money because of those [sioalf cultists].

Birgir.sioalf cultists: Yeah! They've been coming around here and stealing my stuff! It's hard for a man to make a profit if people are always snatching your things and not paying for them! I've got four hungry mouths to feed, you know? Oh, how I'd like to get back at those cultists... Say... are you looking for a [job]?
Birgir.job: Great! Look, all you have to do is get my supplies back for me. They took a bunch, so I'm sure you'll have to go back to their camps a few times to get it all. I'll be sure to reward you somehow. Thanks a lot friend, and [remember], be careful!

A571.offer: While others have a choice in their future, you are destined for service as a necromancer in the Temple of Arawn, and you would be wise to [speak] to a trainer, to show intiative.
A571.accept_line: Good. Speak to Carys to learn about the role of Necromancers.

Narah.speak: It is time for you to move forward in your training. Talk to Carys, the necromancer trainer. You have learned all you can from me.

npc_lines.Carys: If you are strong enough to handle the power, Lord Arawn will give you control over the dead. You will be able to manipulate the spirits of the dead. This will scare many who do not understand our power, and they will fear and shun you. But you will h ave the power of Lord Arawn at your command. As a disciple, this is your only choice. You are designed by Arawn to be a necromancer.

A573.offer: You have barely begun training; yet already there is a need for you to lend your strength for the protection of this town. I know some of the locals are suspicious of the Inconnu, well, that is not to be helped. They are a mysterious people, and their sudden appearance one stormy night, well, that causes a large amount of [suspicion], as you can imagine, They are here to help us, I do believe that, and so must you. But some of the locals, they are not so sure.
A573.accept_line: Right, I expected you would do so. Now, go talk to Ylaine Barrett.

Mistress Laws.suspicion: They have seen the Drakoran ruin their lands, they have witnessed Morgana's terrible magic first hand, so they cannot be expected to trust these new, powerful allies. I expect you to treat the Inconnu as allies, and to try and avoid the idle gossip of the local townsfolk. Saying that, I must send you to one of the loudest of the rabble. Ylaine Barrett. The food cellar has been swarming with swamp goo, and she wants someone to go out and clear the [immediate] area of swamp goo. Don't worry, I don't expect you to kill them all, just do what you can.

Ylaine Barrett.before: Yes, well, before, well, before they came. Don't you remember? That night? All day long, everything's fine. Set itself uop for a fine next day, as well! The night, it was clear. Not a sign of a storm in sight! Why, no one prepared for it! Then, in the darkest part, suddenly, the storm starts! We were woken from the noise of it! It was awful, but we didn't dare go outside! Some of the men, they did, but they came back pale as a corpse! Were shaken to their core! And some of these being the fightin' men! Best of the town! Aye, but the [swamp goo].
Ylaine Barrett.swamp goo: They've gotten into the food cellar! The slimy things were creeping all over that place! I've gotten rid of most of the swamp goo, but I know there's more just outside town working their way to my food stores. I think you could do a small favor for us all and get rid of some. Oh and while you are at it, the skin of the swamp goo, I've some uses for it. I'll pay you for a swamp goo skin. Just go and get me one of their skins, and I'll be satisfied with ya.

npc_lines.Ylaine Barrett: Ah. G'day. And who might you be? I see, you're a fighter. Has Mistress Laws, Master Reginald, or Delore sent you here to help me out? Why don't they just send you out after the goo? That's all I really want. You know, I don't remember that there were that many of these strange creatures crawling around the village [before]. Yes, well, before, well, before they came. Don't you remember? That night? All day long, everything's fine. Set itself uop for a fine next day, as well! The night, it was clear. Not a sign of a storm in sight! Why, no one prepared for it! Then, in the darkest part, suddenly, the storm starts! We were woken from the noise of it! It was awful, but we didn't dare go outside! Some of the men, they did, but they came back pale as a corpse! Were shaken to their core! And some of these being the fightin' men! Best of the town! Aye, but the [swamp goo]. They've gotten into the food cellar! The slimy things were creeping all over that place! I've gotten rid of most of the swamp goo, but I know there's more just outside town working their way to my food stores. I think you could do a small favor for us all and get rid of some. Oh and while you are at it, the skin of the swamp goo, I've some uses for it. I'll pay you for a swamp goo skin. Just go and get me one of their skins, and I'll be satisfied with ya. Oh, you're back! Did you see how many there were? They are a nuisance, aren't they! Well, have you got me the skin? Ah, a good and slimy one! It's odd, these creatures, they've got some strangeness about them, but they've got their uses, as well. Thank you, then. Here, I promised I'd pay ya, and I will!

M594.offer: Hello there Shaman. MightI interest you in a bit of [information] this day?

Frakki.information: Excelent! There's a lot of talk going around that the local magistrate is going to start cracking down on the [redcap skulkers].
Frakki.redcap skulkers: The little buggers are everywhere it seems, always getting into our supplies. grrr... Anyhow, if you come across any, bring their [red caps] back to me and I'll pass them on to the authorities.
Frakki.red caps: Ok, listen, they are easy to get, just off one of the little buggers and bring me the cap. Now be off. Time's [wasting]!

M600.offer: Hello there. What in the wide wide world of Midgard are you doing here? This place is dangerous friend. Nasty dangerous! We've got more foes than Albion has rats. hehe! Well, since you're here, maybe you'd like to [do some good].
M600.accept_line: Well, you made it back, and with a scalp no less. Interesting. Alright, well, if you're still brave, go get somemore scalps.

Topi.do some good: I know, I know? Everyone wants to get something out of everything. Greedy bastards and sons of? well, nevermind that. Anyhow, I'll make sure it's worth your time. Now here's what I need you [to do].
Topi.to do: Well, yeah, of course you'll have to work for it. Nothing's free, you know. hehe Anyhow, there are they morvalt strebers around here that have been causing some [problems] with the locals.
Topi.problems: If you can defeat one in battle and bring me it's scalp, I'll reward you for it. But be warned. They are nasty creatures and will eat you up if you aren't ready for the [challenge]. Good luck.

H609.offer: Would you like a staff for an [Eldritch], an [Enchanter], a [Mentalist],an [Animist], or a [Bainshee]? Twisted Vine Staff -- Animist Ivy Woven Staff -- Enchanter Braided Ivy and Vine Staff -- Mentalist A lvl 33 received 36,330,877 experience and 1 gold and some silver. A lvl 31 received 22,887,018 experience. A lvl 50 received 96,000,000 experience. Champion Level experience gained: 49 Rewards: Ivy Trimmed Rapier Ivy Engraved Falcata Woven Ivy Short Bow Vine Engraved Shillelagh Ivy Woven Staff Deadly Vine Scythe Ivy Wrapped Broadsword Ivy Stiletto Spiked Ivy Club Vine Wrapped Mace Twisted Vine Staff Barbed Ivy Spear Braided Ivy and Vine Staff Twisted Vine Fist Wrap Twisted Vine Mauler Staff

M617.offer: Hello. I could really use your [assistance].

Maerta.assistance: I am in short supply of my [ice water]. I use it while making my asterite bars.
Maerta.ice water: I know, everyone else things I'm a bit dense. I can't just use any ice water. I must use the ice water from a snow giant. It has a magical [property] that allows me to craft my bars in half the normal time. If someone were able to slay a few of these snow giants and gather its water in a vial I could get back on track.

M620.offer: Hello there stranger. I'll bet you're wondering what a strapping lad such as myself is doing here in Munin Sound, aren't you? Well, truth be told, I'm here at the behest of [Tyr].

Nyvad.Tyr: Oh, so you think I'm lying, is that it? Well, I can tell you I most certainly am not! I am a mighty thane! Nyvad the Great! Perhaps you have heard of me, yes? Well, no matter, I am here to [right the wrongs].
Nyvad.right the wrongs: Oh yes, I'm here to help get rid of the cultist threat! You see, they are very bad people, very bad. I'm here to help, well, eliminate the threat! Yes, but you see, I am rather erm? busy, fighting off [other threats].
Nyvad.other threats: I don't have time to devote to strictly the cultists. There is other evil afoot here in Munin Sound. Tricky enemies sneak up always! We are constantly alert! Say, we could use someone like you. Why not [join the fray] and help all of Munin Sound?!
Nyvad.join the fray: Excellent! I knew you'd be a great [candidate] for this job. It's simple, really. All you have to do is return some cultist staves to me and I will reward you richly! Yes, that I sill. Now, be off, friend of Munin Sound! Return to me safely!

H627.offer: Now, this is not the only reward you shall receive. I have a variety of belts crafted by the finest Sylvan. You may choose one for your own. Shall I [tell you] about them?

Carylina.tell you: I have one that will make you more skilled in [celtic duel], one that will make you more [musical], and one that makes you better at [parrying] as well as using your shield. There is also one that makes you quite skilled with [large weapons], one that improves your skills with [scythes], and one that is good for those that use [blades]. I have a belt this is good for those that cast [regrowth] spells, and another for those that use the [Way of the Sun]. There is also one for those that walk the [Verdant Path].
Carylina.Verdant Path: I hope that as you wear this belt you will remember [Rhoiwyn's] terrible fate and it will inspire you to remove the evil Balor from this land! May the strength of the trees always keep you safe.

M629.offer: Hail Mavador! Kelgor grants skill in battle to those who train as hard as you. Now it's time to put that skill to another use. Kelgor wishes you to go [on the hunt] for some exclusive creature.
M629.accept_line: I have given you a task! Prove yourself worthy or be gone from the house of Kelgor! Go get five hill cat teeth!
M629.finish: Viking Karl sent word you have killed the mighty Hrrgyf. Kelgor is pleased that you have proved yourself in battle. Be ready, for Kelgor shall call upon you again!
giver_turnins: I asked for five teeth to prove yourself to Kelgor. I hope you have more!
This would be enough, if you were a puny child, but you are a follower of Kelgor! Go now and get more!
This is good, but Kelgor still wants more!
This is good, but Kelgor still wants more!
Kelgor is pleased, but he [wants more proof] that you have earned your place in the house of Kelgor.

Jaakko.on the hunt: Kelgor wishes you to go hunt for hill cats! Prove your skill in battle. Get me five teeth from the hill cats to prove you are a member of the house of [Kelgor]!
Jaakko.wants more proof: The Viking Karl cannot deal with a problem he is having. Go speak to him and show him that Savages are strong!

Viking Karl.with hunting: The vile beast Hrrgyf has feasted on many of my men. Jaakko claims that this hill cat will not feast upon a Savage. Kill Hrrgyf and bring me her tooth, as proof of your deed. She roams the mountains near here.

npc_lines.Viking Karl: You are from Jaakko, are you not? He said he would send one to help me [with hunting] an evil creature. The vile beast Hrrgyf has feasted on many of my men. Jaakko claims that this hill cat will not feast upon a Savage. Kill Hrrgyf and bring me her tooth, as proof of your deed. She roams the mountains near here. Take this small reward with my thanks. I must now see to training my men better and you must return to Jaakko. He wishes to speak to you.

M636.offer: Can you feel it? Can you feel the magic that flows through this land from the great mother of Morvaltar? At time I think I can fell it, but it still eludes me. If only I could touch that power for just an instant, I know I could [harness it and use it]! Then my enemies, ah, the enemies of Midgard would cower in the fear before me, er, the armies of King Goran!
M636.accept_line: Kyllikki has the scrolls hidden in the house she lives in. It is up to you to figure out a way to get them. I've asked her for them before but she refused, but again, I think it is because she does not like me. You could try that if you wanted, or you could try [getting them out] of her house yourself.
M636.finish: You destroyed them? How? The only way to destroy them is to use them! By Hel and all the other gods of Midgard, I told you not to use them! Do you not listen? And now I bet you expect me to give you a reward? Hah! You?re lucky, because I have found a Valkyn who will tell me more about the mother. Here take this; I don?t want it. Do not let it be said that Catla doesn't fulfill her promises.
giver_turnins: It is about time you have returned. Time has grown short while I have been awaiting the scrolls. Give them to me now.

What? How could you fail! Argh, I should have gone myself. I have learned the lesson that I'm sure Kyllikki wanted me to learn. Ah well, I only needed the scrolls to confirm what I overheard Kyllikki [once telling someone].
Could you be any slower? Give me the totem from the fast-walker. I have been practicing the spell and I know how to use them. Quickly now!

Catla Gardasdottir.harness it and use it: The Valkyn do not realize what a gift they have been granted, by being able to call upon the power of the mother. Some of the Valkyn have actually turned away from that power to worship the weak gods of Midgard. I've tried to convince some of them to teach me their ways, but they refuse, providing pathetic excuses? 'It's too dangerous, you'll get hurt, Norse men and women were never meant to wield that power'! How dare they lie to me like that? And [that Kyllikki] is the worst of them!? Catla looks you up and down.
Catla Gardasdottir.that Kyllikki: Kyllikki promised to teach me how to tap into the power of the mother and use the magic granted to the Morvaltar, but she dose nothing but lecture me on the dangers of this spell or that one, and then scribble more things on those scrolls of hers! If I wanted lectures I would have stayed in Jordheim with Gothi of Hel. The time has come for me to do more than just listen! If only I [had her knowledge].
Catla Gardasdottir.had her knowledge: A thought just came to me. I know that Kyllikki will only tell me selected things from the scrolls but never let me actually read them. I really think she just doesn't like me! But she just might give them so someone else. I will reward you well if you were to [obtain the scrolls] for me.
Catla Gardasdottir.getting them out: I know Kyllikki likes to take walks, so when she's out you could search the house. Just don?t let her catch you; get out of the house before she returns! She will be angry over someone trying to steal from her. I wouldn?t ask you to do this but I must have that magic if I am to defeat my enemies! Um, I mean, ah, if Midgard wishes to defeat it's enemies! You will find Kyllikki?s house south of Aegirhamn.
Catla Gardasdottir.once telling someone: She said that each morvalt carries a totem that helps them draw upon the power of the mother. By gathering three of these totems I shall be able to draw upon that power myself. Since you failed to get the scrolls, you must now go and get these totems for me. Morvalt fast-walkers, morvalt spotters, and morvalt jakthasts carry the totems. You must get a totem from each one and return to me. Do not try to use the totems yourself, for you do not know the ritual!!

npc_lines.Kyllikki: Hello there. Is there something I can do for you? You want my scrolls do you? Well, they are not for just anyone! They contain information about powerful magic that has been used by my people since the dawn of time. It is not for the weak or fearful! I'm guessing someone told you I had these scrolls and sent you to get them. What I wonder is who sent you. I have a guess, but I wonder, whom are you getting them for? Perhaps you should tell me before we go any farther. Why don't I believe you? Foolish being, return to Catla! She will have to continue her study of Morvaltar magic on her own. I will not help her anymore. Go back to her now and tell her I would not give you the scrolls. If she wishes to have them, she should have come herself!

M638.offer: What do you want? I've got [no more maps] to steal, so you can just keep on walking before I call the guards to come get you out of here!
M638.accept_line: Go then to Keirstyn Alfevson. She is much more reasonable person to deal with then that Karle. All he can think about is claiming land for his precious clan. Tell her Sinna Redtoes sent you and see what she has to say. I will reward you well if you can retrieve both maps.
M638.finish: Here is your Potent Amethyst gem. I shall sing your praises tonight as I raise a horn of ale with Longbeard. May the House of Eir always watch over you.
giver_turnins: You've been gone a while. What news do you have for me? Any maps?

It looks almost as if it was torn at some point, but I can see it is whole, and that is all that matters. I am just thankful to have these maps back. I will keep them in a safer place this time. I know many seek the same lost treasures we do, and Longbeard would not be happy if someone else found them! Now since you served the dwarves so well, I shall dig into my own store of treasures and [offer you a prize].? [Step #15] Choose your reward from Sinna Redtoes.

Sinna Redtoes.no more maps: Hrmph, no more maps in there and that's lucky for you! Someone crept in here while I was sleeping and stole two maps that belong to Longbeard. He put them in my care until he our forces came back from helping Stonelock fight the Morvltar. They are due back any day and the maps I had the Valkyn draw me are gone. I think I know [who did it] but I'm not completely sure.
Sinna Redtoes.who did it: I caught a glimpse of their clothes as they ran our with the maps. I believe they were members of the Grenlock Clan. I would go talk to the Grenlock Clan about it but I must try to recreate both those maps. The Valkyn who drew them went out with Stonelock and won't return until the rest of our group comes back. I need someone who will [track down these thieves] and retrieve my maps.
Sinna Redtoes.Step #15: I have a Fiery Garnet [belt], a Spirited Amber [necklace], a Luminous Citrine [pin], a Terrence Adventureine [choker], a Chilly Sodalite [earring], and a Potent Amethyst [gem]. I can tell you about each one if you wish, of you may [choose now].
Sinna Redtoes.choose now: The Firey Garnet belt was made by my grandfather and will aid in resisting fire as well as add to you strength and dexterity. Would you like the [Fiery Garnet] belt or would you like to hear [about the others]?
Sinna Redtoes.about the others: The Spirited Amber necklace is very nice. Wearing it will make you dexterous and quick, as well as help you resist those that attack your mind. Do you choose the [Spirited Amber] necklace or would you like to hear [about the others]?
Sinna Redtoes.Potent Amethyst: Here is your Potent Amethyst gem. I shall sing your praises tonight as I raise a horn of ale with Longbeard. May the House of Eir always watch over you.

Keirstyn Alfevson.she is correct: A few days ago I awoke to find that four members of the Clan had disappeared. At first I figured that my brother Karle had sent them into the wild lands, since their packs were gone. When I heard later that day that Sinna Redtoes had seen Grenlock Clan members around her packs, I began to wonder. I went to Karle and he denied sending the four on any kind of mission. It was then that I [remembered something].
Keirstyn Alfevson.remembered something: That evening at dinner, before the four disappeared, I heard one of the men, Modolf, mention the town of Knarr in Munin Sound. I think I heard one of the missing women mention the word 'treasure' but I cannot be sure. Ever since I learned of the theft, I have been trying to track down the four without luck. I know Sinna sent you here to get the maps back. I cannot give you maps I do not have, but I can give you this. Use it to get to Knarr quickly and ask around the town to see if anyone has seen or heard of Modolf. I wish you luck.

Heikki.my little boat: As he got into the boat I wondered if I had done the right thing selling him the boat. He had no clue what he was doing. Can you believe a Norseman who doesn't know how to handle a boat? I showed him how to row it properly and then he headed out northeast across the water and followed the coastline until I lost sight of him. I figured that was the last I'd see of him or my little boat but [I was wrong].
Heikki.I was wrong: I wasn't on watch the next night, so I decided to do a little hunting before sunset. I went up the coast past the Shalklan camp and what did I find on shore? Modolf's pack, soaked with water and my little boat, upside down, with a big hole in it! I know I had sold the boat, but I was still upset. I began to drag the boat back to here when I realized that I hadn't seen Modolf anywhere, just his pack. I went back and search for him but I couldn?t find him anywhere. But that time the sun had set and that is [not a good time] to be far from home.
Heikki.not a good time: Many people have drowned out in that part of the land. I think the mist menaces that roam around there confuse people and they end up capsizing their boats. At night the spirits of those drowning victims come out and haunt the land. If Modolf did drown, that's where you'll find his spirit. That's all the help I can give you. I wish you luck in finding him.

Merja.pay the price: Then you must find Loden and Idette. I would go seek them myself, but I still have a shred of hope that they will return here. If they do I will get the maps from them and hold them until your return. The people here say they saw Loden and Idette heading kind of east from here, through a valley and then they turned north. How far they got, I don't know, but that's where you should start searching. I'm sure they won't give up the map halves easily, so be careful. You may even want to take some friends with you. Come back to me when you have both halves and I will reassemble the map for you.

npc_lines.Keirstyn Alfevson: Yes, what might I do for you? Oh dear, I feared it would come to this. I have heard that Sinna Redtoes had some maps stolen and that she thinks some of the Grenlock Clan was responsible. I'm not surprised that she sent someone here to speak with me. I'm sad to say I think [she is correct]. A few days ago I awoke to find that four members of the Clan had disappeared. At first I figured that my brother Karle had sent them into the wild lands, since their packs were gone. When I heard later that day that Sinna Redtoes had seen Grenlock Clan members around her packs, I began to wonder. I went to Karle and he denied sending the four on any kind of mission. It was then that I [remembered something]. That evening at dinner, before the four disappeared, I heard one of the men, Modolf, mention the town of Knarr in Munin Sound. I think I heard one of the missing women mention the word 'treasure' but I cannot be sure. Ever since I learned of the theft, I have been trying to track down the four without luck. I know Sinna sent you here to get the maps back. I cannot give you maps I do not have, but I can give you this. Use it to get to Knarr quickly and ask around the town to see if anyone has seen or heard of Modolf. I wish you luck.
npc_lines.Heikki: Hail. Might I do something for you? Modolf? If you're looking for him, I'm sorry to say you won't have much luck. He's gone. I was on watch the night he came through here so I remember him. A few nights ago he came into Knarr all in a big rush, demanding I give him a boat. Well, I told him I wouldn't give him one but that I would sell him one. He argued and stomped around telling me that no one said no to Modolf, but I stood my ground. I paid good gold for that boat and wasn't going to just give it away! He finally relented and handed over a pouch of gold. I took him to [my little boat]. As he got into the boat I wondered if I had done the right thing selling him the boat. He had no clue what he was doing. Can you believe a Norseman who doesn't know how to handle a boat? I showed him how to row it properly and then he headed out northeast across the water and followed the coastline until I lost sight of him. I figured that was the last I'd see of him or my little boat but [I was wrong]. I wasn't on watch the next night, so I decided to do a little hunting before sunset. I went up the coast past the Shalklan camp and what did I find on shore? Modolf's pack, soaked with water and my little boat, upside down, with a big hole in it! I know I had sold the boat, but I was still upset. I began to drag the boat back to here when I realized that I hadn't seen Modolf anywhere, just his pack. I went back and search for him but I couldn?t find him anywhere. But that time the sun had set and that is [not a good time] to be far from home. Many people have drowned out in that part of the land. I think the mist menaces that roam around there confuse people and they end up capsizing their boats. At night the spirits of those drowning victims come out and haunt the land. If Modolf did drown, that's where you'll find his spirit. That's all the help I can give you. I wish you luck in finding him.
npc_lines.Modolf: You will not get my map! Never!
npc_lines.Merja: Yes, what might I? where did you get that map you carry? I know that map! It is not yours and I know because I helped to steal it? I know where it came from. How did you come to have it? Did you steal it like a thief in the night? Tell me! I knew something like this would happen. It was such a bad idea to steal those maps. Yes, we stole them! I knew it was wrong but Modolf, Loden, and Idette convinced me to go along with them. I tried to talk Modolf into letting me go with him to Knarr and helping with the boat, but he insisted he could handle it himself. He sent me here to wait while he, Idette, and Loden all went off in search of the treasure. I think we will all [pay the price] for stealing from the dwarves. Then you must find Loden and Idette. I would go seek them myself, but I still have a shred of hope that they will return here. If they do I will get the maps from them and hold them until your return. The people here say they saw Loden and Idette heading kind of east from here, through a valley and then they turned north. How far they got, I don't know, but that's where you should start searching. I'm sure they won't give up the map halves easily, so be careful. You may even want to take some friends with you. Come back to me when you have both halves and I will reassemble the map for you. You have just confirmed my fears. Loden and Idette died in the avalanche, didn't they? It saddens me to hear that. When I have the courage I will return to the Clan and let them know of my wrongdoing and the deaths of the other clan members. But for now, give me a piece of the map so that I can put it back together and begin to make it up to the dwarves of Longbeard's group. Now the other piece please. There it is done. Please return this map to Sinna Redtoes, for we should have never stolen it from her. I will come in time to make my apologies to her and accept any punishment she may have for me. Please, take this to help you get back to her quickly. The quicker the maps are returned to her, the sooner I can begin to face what lies ahead of me. Go now and be well.
npc_lines.Idette: Loden! We are under attack! Flee if you can!
npc_lines.Loden: No! Now I shall never find the treasure before the dwarves!

A639.offer: Ylaine tells me she hasn't spotted any swamp goo in the cellars since you and some other young adventurers took a part in clearing them out. This is really good to hear. Of course, now we've new [troubles].
A639.accept_line: Aye, speak to the healer, Genette, she is treating new illness that seems to be affecting only the Inconnu. She's worked with Dalvay, Arawn's priest, and together they've come up with some sort of cure.

Master Reginald.troubles: Aye, the never go away. I'd like you to lend a hand. I'll [understand] if you don't, but I thikn you could benefit a little from it.

Sister Genette Ashlan.strange priest: Aye, I'll not understand the workings of your folk, <Player>, truly I shan't. But he is a strange fellow. Came to me at the oddest times to tell me your folk were getting sick, and needed tending, and about threatened me with Arawn's wrath when I said then Arawn should have thought of tending the Inconnu's illness' himslef before he threw that temple in the middle of our town. Aye, but I'm a healer, and heal I will, but you're a strange folk, and need a different sort of tending. I've got everything I need, but one thing. I need one more [ingredient] to this concoction I'm cooking up.
Sister Genette Ashlan.ingredient: Off the coast, near the water, you can usually see the sea pups out there. The skin of the sea pup has an oily feel to it. I need to scrape off the oils from the skin and boil it. Aye, it's my problem how, I'll manage that. You just go get me the skin.

Tage.collect: Bring me a swamp goo. Dead, preferably. The roam just outside of town.

npc_lines.Sister Genette Ashlan: <Player>, are you the one that's here to help me? Aye, I've got to treat this illness afflicting the Inconnu. I've not seen anything like it. I've had to talk to that [strange priest]. Aye, I'll not understand the workings of your folk, <Player>, truly I shan't. But he is a strange fellow. Came to me at the oddest times to tell me your folk were getting sick, and needed tending, and about threatened me with Arawn's wrath when I said then Arawn should have thought of tending the Inconnu's illness' himslef before he threw that temple in the middle of our town. Aye, but I'm a healer, and heal I will, but you're a strange folk, and need a different sort of tending. I've got everything I need, but one thing. I need one more [ingredient] to this concoction I'm cooking up. Off the coast, near the water, you can usually see the sea pups out there. The skin of the sea pup has an oily feel to it. I need to scrape off the oils from the skin and boil it. Aye, it's my problem how, I'll manage that. You just go get me the skin. Ah, you've come back. Have you the item? Now then, give it here, and I will begin the prepartations. Great! Alright, now you need to speak to Tage. Dalvay's acolyte. Tell him I'm ready for the next portion of the remedy. Here, take this coin. I don't think he's any concept of payment for work rendered. Ah, you're back. Did that acolyte creep you out, as well? I still shiver just thinking about him and that priest! Well, did he have anything for me? I was told that only a mixture blessed by Arawn would work! The nerve! Thank you, <Player>. I'm sure I'll be able to heal your people, though you know, the blessings of our church should be more than enough. Really, Arawn's blessing is not needed in all things.
npc_lines.Tage: I did not expect her to be ready so soon. You will have to [collect] the next ingredient she will need. I've too many sick to tend. Bring me a swamp goo. Dead, preferably. The roam just outside of town. Have you the second component I need, <Player>? This will do. You have done well. Wait a moment, while I prepare the pulpy mixture the healer woman will need. There. It is done, and has been blessed by Arawn. Tell the healer woman to add her potion to this pulp.

A640.offer: Remember the swamp goo in the cellar? And the sickness that affected the Inconnu only? It seems that there is an undead that has been hiding from Arawn for years, <Player>, with the Inconnu walking the land, he's feeling [threatened].
A640.accept_line: Aye. Speak to Tage, he'll fill you in on the what Arawn has told him.

Master Reginald.threatened: Aye. It seems he's instigated the whole swamp goo cellar [infestation] and began the sickness with the Inconnu. As long as the Inconnu are here, he will be a threat. I think we should aid Tage.

npc_lines.Tage: <Player>, one of our sould has disguised himself as a damp skeleton amongst the dead Morgana has raised. He thinks to distract us by infesting the town with the swamp goo, and creating an illness for the Inconnu. He must be returned to Arawn, before he does more harm. Everry night that he lives as one of the undead, he gains in power. If he is not returned soon, he will grow strong, and become a great threat to this fortress town. He must be returned. He roams with the rest of the undead. Go, return his essence to me. Have you Jocias' soul, <Player>? Ah. He shall be returned to Arawn. His place is the underworld. He must make retribution to Arawn. I thank you, <Player>. You have done well.
npc_lines.Jocias: Ha! My soul is still free! Amongst the damp skeletons Morgana has raised! You'll never find me!
npc_lines.The damp skeleton: Noo! Don't return me to Arawn! He will torment me!

A641.offer: Ah, <Player>, soon you must choose which [professioin] to follow. There are a couple of choices, but not all are open to you. I suggest you speak to the trainers that will accept you, before you make your decison.
A641.accept_line: Smart choice! Speak to Lietenant Newster. The professoin of Scout, in the Defenders of Albion, is open to you.

Lieutenant Newster.first line: Certainly. It is not only here in the Isle of Glass that your skills as a Scout will be sought after. Back in Albion, in the frontier lands, our enemies seek to overtake the realm. It is something you should [consider].
Lieutenant Newster.consider: Yes, but don't make any hasty decisions. You should speak to Elaru, with the Guild of Shadows, to learn of life as an Infiltrator.

Elaru.Stealth: Yes, and twilight your sawn, for the work of an infiltrator is best accomplished when the sky is darkened and the land asleep. You will be sent to the enemy's arms. and expected to return successfully. [Death] is the only excuse for failing.
Elaru.Death: Consider your choices when the time comes. Think well what Arawn would wish for you.

npc_lines.Lieutenant Newster: So you wish to learn about life as a Scout, eh? Well, we are part of the Defenders of Albion. Your bow, that should be your main choice for weapons. You do your best work at a distance, as a Scout, and should be the [first line] of offense. Certainly. It is not only here in the Isle of Glass that your skills as a Scout will be sought after. Back in Albion, in the frontier lands, our enemies seek to overtake the realm. It is something you should [consider]. Yes, but don't make any hasty decisions. You should speak to Elaru, with the Guild of Shadows, to learn of life as an Infiltrator.
npc_lines.Elaru: Ah, you wish to learn of life as an Infiltrator in the Guild of Shadows. Yes. The Guild of Shadows also has welcomed the Temple of Arawn into it's halls. As an Infiltrator, you will serve the Guild of Shadows. [Stealth] will be your greatest friend. Yes, and twilight your sawn, for the work of an infiltrator is best accomplished when the sky is darkened and the land asleep. You will be sent to the enemy's arms. and expected to return successfully. [Death] is the only excuse for failing. Consider your choices when the time comes. Think well what Arawn would wish for you.

H646.offer: Hello there. You'd best be on your toes around these parts. [Spiteful Sylvanshades] are all about.
H646.accept_line: Wow, you've actually done the deed and killed a sylvanshade eh? Well, good job! The bounty's still open, if you happen to get more heads.

Jack.Spiteful Sylvanshades: Oh aye friend. Sylvanshades are the evil counterparts to our beloved Sylvan friends. They are twisted and warped. They enjoy bringing [harm] to others.
Jack.harm: Oh yes. You'd best be careful out there. The local officials have offered a bounty to all who bring back the head of a Spiteful Sylvanshade. If you do battle with one and retrieve the head, [bring it back] to me, ok?
Jack.bring it back: Yes. I'll be sure to give you the reward for such a feat. Good luck, and don't get caught [unaware]!

M651.accept_line: Ah, well, let me take a look at it. Oh this will do. It is a simple, primitive style. It will certainly stand out amongst the crowd. Oh! Especially when it's made of griffon fur! I can't wait! Alright, now, go find a griffon. You can find some griffon loners in the Gripklosa Mountains. That's the griffon pelt I want. When you kill the griffon, take the pelt to the pelterer. When the pelterer is finished, bring it to me, and I will reward you. Here, take part of the reward now, as a sign of good faith.
M651.finish: You are insufferable! Reward? You wish a reward? For this betrayal? How dare you! I will have my griffon pelt! I will! As for you! Out of my sight!

npc_lines.The griffon loner: What are you doing? Who sent you out here? Why do you hunt me? I hate hrimthusas. They bother me. I will forgive this act, if you kill a hrimthusa brute for me. Bring me the nose of a brute as proof, and I will reward you. You can find them in northwest part of the place you call Delling Crater. You killed a giant. Here. It is the skin of a kobold hunter. Take this to Ota. Tell her I've many like it, and do not need more. But if she sends me hunters, I will gladly oblige her. You may keep the trinket taken from this fool, as a reward.

M657.offer: Please tell me that you are here to help me! I have gotten myself in a bind and I'm not sure how to get out of it alone. If only I hadn't agreed to help [that crazy woman] I wouldn't be in this situation, but she scares me!
M657.accept_line: Do you have the fluid from Edrigu? Catla has been by three times asking for the potion! I fear if she has too wait to long Bogdar will not be able to save me. I gave my promise that I would deliver the potion. Now please, give me the fluid.
M657.finish: Take these vials and return them filled with the blood of the Morvalt vandarare and the Morvalt streber. Their blood, when mixed with the fluid from Edrigu and the fur, is what allows the communication with the mother. It will not work for Catla but she must learn that for herself. She will not listen to reason! Once you have filled both vials return to me so that I may complete the potion and save us both from Catla's wrath!
giver_turnins: This helps a great deal, but we are not done yet! All will be well when you get the rest of the ingredients! This fluid is only one part of the potion. You must now travel to Gripklosa Mountains and see out [three creatures] that dwell there.

Juuso.that crazy woman: I think you know whom I speak on! None other than Catla! You must have realized that she is very unstable. If she continues with her plan it won't be long for her to be completely insane. I'm sure she has told you she wants to tap into the power of the mother of the Morvaltar. She refused to accept the fact that humans cannot wield that power! You know she has been asking ever Valkyn in Aegir's Landing to help her out, right? There was [only one] who was brave enough to take on working with Catla.
Juuso.only one: I'm sure Catla mentioned Kyllikki to you. Anyone who has talked with Catla has heard of Kyllikki and how she has refused to teach Catla anything else. You are not the only one who was asked to get those scrolls. Catla wanted them more than anything and she asked everyone she ran into to get them. I know you helped her because she came to me and [ordered me] to help her when the scrolls didn't give the information she wanted.
Juuso.ordered me: Yes, she ordered me to help her! She said she heard that I knew of a potion that would let her use the power of the mother and I was to make it for her so that she could use that power. It is true that I have learned some ways to draw upon that power, but most of my strength come from Bogdar and the potion is very dangerous. I tried to tell her that but she would hear none of it! All she wants to hear is that she can use the power of the mother to [destroy her enemies].
Juuso.destroy her enemies: She longs to destroy Albion and Hibernia for what happened to her family and I swear she'll destroy anyone who gets in her way of doing that. I've even heard her make remarks about taking control of Midgard! She scares me! She threatened to have my spirit sucked into the depths of Hel's domain if I didn?t do as she ordered. What was I to do? I must make the potion but I must also go to Catla and tell her everything I know about Morvaltar. She doesn't understand I can't do both at once and that I [need someone] to collect the ingredients for the potion.
Juuso.need someone: Thank you! You may have save both of our lives if you are able to get the things that we need for the potion. It will not be an easy task, but I have many friends that will help me reward you well for this. And it is to [one of these friends] that you must go first.
Juuso.one of these friends: Before I came here to Aegir's Landing I spent some time with the Skalklan in Munin Sound. An oyster-gathering Skalklan named Edrigu taught me many secrets of the Skalklan. One of those secrets was the potion Catla spoke of. Edrigu had enough purpose for it, but it had an interesting side effect on many. It allowed the drinker to speak directly to the spirit of the mother, who would then grant more of her power to use. One of the ingredients can [only be obtained] from Edrigu.
Juuso.only be obtained: That is a problem for you. The Skalklan are not very welcoming to outsiders and will not talk to you if you approached them. But fear not! Edrigu and the other Skalklan know me and will speak to one who carries a sign from me. I have an amulet that Edrigu would recognize but it's missing [one piece].
Juuso.one piece: The Skalklan do not like the creatures called [ingesters] that live in Munin Sound. Getting a wiggly tentacle from one would help prove that you want to be a friend to the Skalklan. Once you get a wiggly tentacle, you will need to set it in the middle of this amulet. The Skalklan will leave you alone as long as you wear it, but if you should harm a single Skalklan while you wear it, it will destroy the amulet and they could possibly hate you! Seek out Edrigu and tell him Juuso sent you. He will know what I seek. I wish you luck!
Juuso.three creatures: First you must find a woolly mammoth and obtain some of its fur. The fur will tether Catla in this world so that she will not become lost in the spirit world while she searches for the mother. After you have the fur, you will need the blood of [two Morvaltar].
Juuso.two Morvaltar: Take these vials and return them filled with the blood of the Morvalt vandarare and the Morvalt streber. Their blood, when mixed with the fluid from Edrigu and the fur, is what allows the communication with the mother. It will not work for Catla but she must learn that for herself. She will not listen to reason! Once you have filled both vials return to me so that I may complete the potion and save us both from Catla's wrath!
Juuso.what you want: My friends have given me [swords], [hammers], [axes], [staves], a [spear], a [bow], and axe for your [left hand] and [hand to hand], weapons. Which would you prefer? Once you choose you cannot change your mind!
Juuso.hand to hand: Would you like a [one-handed] or a [two-handed] hammer?
Juuso.two-handed: Here is your Beinbrottsjo war hammer. I hope it will help to defend you against Catla if she should ever completely lose her grip on sanity. I must go to her now and deliver this potion that will not work for her. Wish me luck!

npc_lines.Edrigu: You wear an amulet I know. Who sent you to me? Juuso. He wishes to make the potion again? I wish he would not do that. It is not good for him. Too much power makes goo people bad. I see it many times. I will give you what Juuso needs. I know I cannot change Juuso?s mind, but I ask you not to drink the potoin he makes. It is bad and you seem good. Take it and go from here. No good will come from this potion. I know it!

A670.offer: Another spelled failed. That has been happening more and more lately. I do not feel that my power has faded, nor do I detect it fading in Lurlei, yet together we only successfully cast half our spells, if even that many. And when we do cast protection spells around the armies, the Drakoran magic cuts right through them! Its like we have no resistance to their magic anymore! Lurlei and I fear that someone is [increasing their power] or weakening ours.
A670.accept_line: Thank you, <Player>! I shall not forget this. When you meet with Dory, tell him I sent you. In the meantime I will arrange for you to be properly rewarded for helping me out this way. I am counting on you to act in my name, <Player>. Make Avalon proud of you!

Lady Eilwen.increasing their power: It would not surprise me if either were the case, but who is behind it? Lurlei and I have been struggling with our spells since the arrival of the Inconnu. Oh I have heard the rumors that the Inconnu are not only here to steal our souls but our magic too. I have never heard anything more ridiculous in my life! The Inconnu are here to help us defeat with Drakoran. Why would they help us face our enemies if they only wished to destroy us? No, I believe there is [another force] at work.
Lady Eilwen.another force: Morgana, <Player>. Plain and simple. She has found some way to boost the Drakoran's magical skills. Unless we can find a way to counter their magic and boost our own I fear that the spells that Lurlei and I cast to aid the armies in their fight will be no better than a child's first attempt at spell casting. But I believe there is [hope for us yet].
Lady Eilwen.hope for us yet: I have been working with that Infiltrator, Dory. I know General Wystan thinks poorly of him, but Lady Lile has taken a liking to him. Of course, that may be just to annoy General Wystan, but who knows? Anyway, Dory learned of our magical problems and came to me to discuss the problem. He's been hunting for possible solutions and now it appears that [he has found one].
Lady Eilwen.he has found one: He has sent a note requesting that I come speak to him immediately, but I cannot answer his summons. Lurlei and I have a meeting with General Wystan and Mistress Etheldreda to discuss the progress of our fight. Dory only attends these meetings sporadically, so if he is not there he will not be missed. I, on the other hand, will most definitely be missed, but the note said to come immediately. I am in a bit of a dilemma for the information is too important for me to miss. If only I had someone to [go meet with Dory].

Dory.her little problem: I've been working on solving that problem for her. See, I can do good things, contrary to what Wystan believes! In my, um, profession, I have quite a few contacts. When I heard the rumors that the Inconnu were responsible for Eilwen's failing spells, I asked around and got an answer from a fine Cabalist. She assured me that the Inconnu were not responsible for Eilwen's problems. I bet you think I'm lying, but I'm not! Brishene is an Inconnu and I think she knows what she's talking about. Brishene is not one to lie, even if she is a member of the Guild of Shadows! She identified the cause as Morgana and has begun to [search for a solution].
Dory.search for a solution: Since Eilwen is not here, I guess I'll have to tell you of what Brishene has found so far to help with the solution. She spent good gold getting this information, so keep your mouth closed and your ears open! Long ago, before the coming of the Drakoran, a cabalist named Meical became fed up with the war raging between the three lands. He had seen too many friends and enemies die and it pushed him over the edge of sanity. He became obsessed with creating life, not destroying it. Meical fled the mainland for the Dales of Devwy and built a hall to lock himself away [from the world].
Dory.from the world: Yes, Meical did not want to have any dealings with the people of this world. Instead he set about fulfilling his obsession. Using his magical skills, he began to create new creatures out of rope and wood and metal. But Meical's insanity warped his magic and over time the creatures developed the same insanity that possessed Meical. The creatures rose up and killed Meical, then spread into the surrounding area where they still roam today. But [Brishene discovered] something about those creatures.
Dory.Brishene discovered: The magic that animates them seems to be undimished, unlike the magic of the Avalonians. Brishene doesn't know why, but she's trying her best to find out what's going on. Since you ratted me out to Wystan before, you're going to make up for it now! Brishene thinks there's a sphere of metal [in the creatures] that contains a bit of their magic and she wants to study it.
Dory.in the creatures: Brishene asked me to get the spheres from the forged servants that roam around outside Meical's Hall. She wants two so she can conduct her experiments on them. I need you to go out and get the spheres for Brishene. Wystan is watching me closely so I can't leave the Caer to go do it myself. When you have the spheres, go to Brishene at Wearyall Village. She will be waiting for you there.
Dory.choose one: Now listen closely, for you can only choose one and once you make your choice you can't change your mind. You may choose from one handed [slashing], two handed [crushing], or a [thrusting] polearm a slashing [flexible] weapon, a [long bow], a [quarterstaff], or a [caster staff]?
Dory.caster staff: Here is your Gem Flecked Quarterstaff. Use it well, <Player>.

Brishene.my pendant: It is a pendant that allows me to focus my magic so that I may use it better. Dory wanted to borrow it to show it to Eilwen but some petty thief stole it from him before he could return it to me. I have [tracked its location] but I must begin working right away or I would go retrieve it myself. Every minute I delay hurts Eilwen and the Avalonian armies.
Brishene.tracked its location: Apparently the thief either traded it or lost it to the hands of a Drakoran because I've tracked it to one of their camps. There is a Drakoran there named Barak. My sources tell me that you will find Barak in the camp that lies east from the great tree of Wearyall Hill. I must have that pendant if I am to do my research correctly. I can start without it, but it will be better with it. Return to me when you have my pendant.

npc_lines.Dory: You've got some nerve, <Player>? Speaking to me after what you did? Don't try to look innocent! You got me in trouble with General Wystan and if wasn't for the intervention of Eilwen and Lurlei he'd have shipped me back to Camelot by now. You had better have a bloody good reason for bothering me. Oh, so she did? She must not have realized that you were the one who got me in trouble with Wystan because I doubt she would have sent you otherwise. Let's see if you can keep your mouth shut this time if you're asked to. Now, since Eilwen sent you, I'm sure you know about [her little problem]. I've been working on solving that problem for her. See, I can do good things, contrary to what Wystan believes! In my, um, profession, I have quite a few contacts. When I heard the rumors that the Inconnu were responsible for Eilwen's failing spells, I asked around and got an answer from a fine Cabalist. She assured me that the Inconnu were not responsible for Eilwen's problems. I bet you think I'm lying, but I'm not! Brishene is an Inconnu and I think she knows what she's talking about. Brishene is not one to lie, even if she is a member of the Guild of Shadows! She identified the cause as Morgana and has begun to [search for a solution]. Since Eilwen is not here, I guess I'll have to tell you of what Brishene has found so far to help with the solution. She spent good gold getting this information, so keep your mouth closed and your ears open! Long ago, before the coming of the Drakoran, a cabalist named Meical became fed up with the war raging between the three lands. He had seen too many friends and enemies die and it pushed him over the edge of sanity. He became obsessed with creating life, not destroying it. Meical fled the mainland for the Dales of Devwy and built a hall to lock himself away [from the world]. Yes, Meical did not want to have any dealings with the people of this world. Instead he set about fulfilling his obsession. Using his magical skills, he began to create new creatures out of rope and wood and metal. But Meical's insanity warped his magic and over time the creatures developed the same insanity that possessed Meical. The creatures rose up and killed Meical, then spread into the surrounding area where they still roam today. But [Brishene discovered] something about those creatures. The magic that animates them seems to be undimished, unlike the magic of the Avalonians. Brishene doesn't know why, but she's trying her best to find out what's going on. Since you ratted me out to Wystan before, you're going to make up for it now! Brishene thinks there's a sphere of metal [in the creatures] that contains a bit of their magic and she wants to study it. Brishene asked me to get the spheres from the forged servants that roam around outside Meical's Hall. She wants two so she can conduct her experiments on them. I need you to go out and get the spheres for Brishene. Wystan is watching me closely so I can't leave the Caer to go do it myself. When you have the spheres, go to Brishene at Wearyall Village. She will be waiting for you there. You took your time getting back here, <Player>. I still wonder if I can trust you. Hopefully you weren't off reporting my every move to Wystan again. I see you carry a scroll with you. Is that my death order or something else? Hrmph. It appears that you did a decent job for Brishene. She says she's learning quite a bit about those creatures of Meical's. I have another meeting with Eilwen soon and I shall share this information with her. I still don't like you, but Eilwen seems to. She sent over weapons that were saved when Avalon was destroyed. You are to [choose one] that suits your needs. I hope I can trust you to continue to help Eilwen with this problem, <Player>. Now listen closely, for you can only choose one and once you make your choice you can't change your mind. You may choose from one handed [slashing], two handed [crushing], or a [thrusting] polearm a slashing [flexible] weapon, a [long bow], a [quarterstaff], or a [caster staff]? Here is your Gem Flecked Quarterstaff. Use it well, <Player>.
npc_lines.Brishene: Greetings, <Player>. Dory sent word to me that you would be coming to see me and be bringing me the spheres that I need. Please give the first sphere. Good, now the second one? Thank you, <Player>. I will begin my experiments but I wish I had [my pendant]. It is a pendant that allows me to focus my magic so that I may use it better. Dory wanted to borrow it to show it to Eilwen but some petty thief stole it from him before he could return it to me. I have [tracked its location] but I must begin working right away or I would go retrieve it myself. Every minute I delay hurts Eilwen and the Avalonian armies. Apparently the thief either traded it or lost it to the hands of a Drakoran because I've tracked it to one of their camps. There is a Drakoran there named Barak. My sources tell me that you will find Barak in the camp that lies east from the great tree of Wearyall Hill. I must have that pendant if I am to do my research correctly. I can start without it, but it will be better with it. Return to me when you have my pendant. That did not take as long as I expected, <Player>. Were you able to obtain my pendant? I am in your debt. This will allow me to continue working with the second mechanism that you brought me. I have been able to discover that Meical imbued the spheres of each creature with magic from a source other than what the Avalonians draw upon. It is a powerful source that Eilwen may be able to use if we can discover a way to tap into it. I shall continue my research and hopefully have good news for Eilwen soon. Until then, take this report to Dory so that he may know what is going on.

M683.offer: Well met, ________. You look stronger than the last time I saw you! That is good! With Modi's courage flowing through you, you will continue to grow strong. But I wonder, will you use that courage to help [someone else]?
M683.accept_line: Modi's courage does flow through you! Go now to Dalea Gronholm and she will give you more information about the task before you. All of the House of Modi will honor your name one day, _______!

Trainer.someone else: I have received word from one of the merchants around here that she is looking for a courageous berserker to help her with something. Her name is Dalea and she is [collecting] things. She didn't say exactly what would be collected only that it might be difficult but the reward would be worth the work. S, [what do you say? Cound you help Dalea out?

Dalea Gronholm.unable to gather: Apparently there have been some problems over on the mainland, for Elizabeth recently sent me a very urgent message begging for the new components. Since I cannot get them, I am asking you to get them for me. Elizabeth needs the essences of some of the creatures that roam the lands. But before you can gather those essences, I must make the vessel to hold them. You must [get me the parts] I need to make the vessel.
Dalea Gronholm.get me the parts: There are two parts to the vessel. The first is a gilded fang from a scimitar kit. When it is cleaned out and enchanted properly, it will hold the essences Elizabeth needs. To enchant the fang I need some shimmery feathers from a boobrie hatchling. Once you have both things come back to me. May the House of Modi watch over you as you undertake this journey, <Player>." (scimitar kit can be found at loc=28k, 57k)

npc_lines.Dalea Gronholm: Thank you for answering my summons, <Player>. I have been ill lately and am too weak to venture far. I have been working with my cousin Elizabeth in Mular. She is an enchantress and has been working on new enchantments for weapons ans armor. When she found out I was coming here, she asked me to gather potential enchantment components and send them to her. I agreed, but then I took ill. Since then I have been [unable to gather] anything. Apparently there have been some problems over on the mainland, for Elizabeth recently sent me a very urgent message begging for the new components. Since I cannot get them, I am asking you to get them for me. Elizabeth needs the essences of some of the creatures that roam the lands. But before you can gather those essences, I must make the vessel to hold them. You must [get me the parts] I need to make the vessel. There are two parts to the vessel. The first is a gilded fang from a scimitar kit. When it is cleaned out and enchanted properly, it will hold the essences Elizabeth needs. To enchant the fang I need some shimmery feathers from a boobrie hatchling. Once you have both things come back to me. May the House of Modi watch over you as you undertake this journey, <Player>." (scimitar kit can be found at loc=28k, 57k) I am relieved to see you return, <Player>. Do you have the gilded fang for me? Please give it to me. Now give me the feathers please. The fang will do no good without the feathers. Wonderful. I am strong enough to take these to Meregrota Solvor and have her enchant them. It may take a while. I shall send word to your trainer when I need you again, <Player>. Until then, take this with my thanks.

A686.offer: I feared for your safety, <Player>! When Adelon sent word that you were going to take on Meical, I became worried. I have heard rumors about him that scared even me! Were you able to obtain [anything] from him?
A686.accept_line: Why, this box is locked. Do you have the key for it?

Lady Lurlei.something for you: This is one of the few items I was able to save as we left the city of Avalon when the Drakoran attacked. I have been holding on to it for a while in hopes of finding the right person to give it to, and now I have. Thank you, <Player>. Your service to Avalon is highly appreciated!

A699.offer: Good day, though any day you're alive these days is a good day, eh? How do you get on with those of the [Ogre Citadel]?
A699.accept_line: This item, now, it's in the Ogre Citadel, deep within, a chamber open to the stars. I don't know how to get in it, but I know the ogre there, his name is Scurceol Hydre, and he calls himself a star channeler! He is said to be channeling power from the heavens! Heresy, some say, but there is one who claims to have seen this powerful channeler! Speak to Arden in Caer Diogel about the star channeler. Tell him you're crazy enough to seek out the powerful talisman he's created.
A699.finish: Ah! Well, to be honest, I have no idea what this is! But I will find out. I'm sure it is something that can be used to counter the magic of the Midgard shamans! Thank you my friend, thank you! Oh here, let me take that map as well. You don't need it!

Master Xavier.Ogre Citadel: Yes, the ogres. Once, they were allies. Now, they are a sensitive bunch, blaming us for their essential exile into the mountains and their last stronghold. They fled before Morgana, pleading with us for aid, not realizing that we were already defeated, fleeing before the evil [Drakoran] hoardes.
Master Xavier.Drakoran: Aye. We weren't the sole occupants on this island you know. Once, not long ago, as we measure time, the ogres were our allies. We held this land together minding our own business, for the most part. We helped each other out occasionally. Occasionally we had some arguements that turned into some fighting, but nothing much. Then, Morgana came, and pushed us back, and the ogres back, [as well].
Master Xavier.as well: They wanted us to help them. They somehow expected us to do a better job of defending the island. Truthfully, I think they rallied themselves to late, and relied on us too heavily. They liked to keep to themselves, and when Morgana's Drakoran hoarde appeared and she summoned that dragon up, while we were struggling to hold our city, they [retreated] to their fortresses and citadels.
Master Xavier.retreated: They watched as our city became overrun. They watched the citizens of Avalon flee. But they assumed we'd handle it. The assumed they were not threatened. Then, the Drakorans [surprised] the ogres.
Master Xavier.surprised: Honestly, I don't see how they could have been surprised. It was clear to all of us what was happening. Morgana wanted the island, wanted it's magic. Ogres have access to the powerful places in the land. They have [magic] all their own.
Master Xavier.magic: Oh yes, Powerful magic. Ogre magic. I know a bit about their [strange] magic.
Master Xavier.strange: Oh yes. Here, we face the Drakorans and Morgana's evil. But what of when they are gone? Then, we are faced with the threat of that savage people from the Norse lands. If Albion does not defeat Midgard, then Midgard will defeat us. Now, if Albion got a hold of some of the magic of the ogres in their most powerful [stronghold], think what could be done!
Master Xavier.stronghold: Well now, before I go telling you about all that, I need to know, would you be willing to find some of their magic? You will need help, a lot of help. So before you agree, be sure you can convince many friends to come along. It's an orb I'm looking for, created by one called the Star [Channeler]; and it's locked deep inside the Ogre Citadel.

Arden.power: Rory says the ogres don't have magic, and that this one Ogre, he was talking about natural powers that had more to do with a science of application rather than spells and incantations! How absurd, I say! Let the ogres believe what they will, but I know magic, and what this self-claimed star channeler does is not [science] but magic.
Arden.science: Science. Call it what you will. Here is what Rory says happens. There is a room inthe citadel under the stars. There are four golden rings. Rory said the star channeler, named Scurceol Hyrde, calls them nodes. The nodes are powerful. The seem to protect the star channeler. His name is Scurceol Hyrde. I don't pretend to konw how it all works. I can't even tell you how to defeat Scurceol Hyrde, but I know the room is very [dangerous].
Arden.dangerous: Rory only said the room meant death for anyone not meant to enter. The nodes, he says, semms to be collecting power from the stars! He said storms often brew in the room. He says the ogre that calls himself the star channeler wields lightening! Now, it won't be easy getting in to this chamber, but if you want, I know who has a [map] to the chamber!
Arden.map: The ogre Malefact. He holds a map. I know this because Rory has tried to obtain this map. Normally, I would get Rory to sneak in, but Rory is missing, lost somewhere in the ogre fortress! Ah, but kill Malefact, and you will have your map. The map will guide you to the star channeler's chamber.

npc_lines.Arden: Greetings friend. What brings you to old Arden? Ah. The star channeler. The ogre that calls himself that. Rory, my good, and often absent, friend, knows a bit about this ogre and his [power]. Rory says the ogres don't have magic, and that this one Ogre, he was talking about natural powers that had more to do with a science of application rather than spells and incantations! How absurd, I say! Let the ogres believe what they will, but I know magic, and what this self-claimed star channeler does is not [science] but magic. Science. Call it what you will. Here is what Rory says happens. There is a room inthe citadel under the stars. There are four golden rings. Rory said the star channeler, named Scurceol Hyrde, calls them nodes. The nodes are powerful. The seem to protect the star channeler. His name is Scurceol Hyrde. I don't pretend to konw how it all works. I can't even tell you how to defeat Scurceol Hyrde, but I know the room is very [dangerous]. Rory only said the room meant death for anyone not meant to enter. The nodes, he says, semms to be collecting power from the stars! He said storms often brew in the room. He says the ogre that calls himself the star channeler wields lightening! Now, it won't be easy getting in to this chamber, but if you want, I know who has a [map] to the chamber! The ogre Malefact. He holds a map. I know this because Rory has tried to obtain this map. Normally, I would get Rory to sneak in, but Rory is missing, lost somewhere in the ogre fortress! Ah, but kill Malefact, and you will have your map. The map will guide you to the star channeler's chamber.
npc_lines.Malefact: Foul traitor to the land! You have failed us, and we fell to the drakoran. Now, you would destroy yourselves?

H701.offer: <Player>, You're familiar with Crace by now, right? He's got a scheme, and he wants help. He's found a trader in silver who claims to have some [special] silver.
H701.accept_line: I'm sure Crace will reward you again. Talk to Crace, he'll tell you more.

Trainer.special: Yes. He is looking for [adventurers] willing to help him out. He says this trader is reliable, and is offering enchanted silver!
