Crace.enchanted silver: Aye, <Player>, it's mainly controlled by those evil siabra local to the area, however, I've a friend who has managed to get a large amount of the silver. See, we've come up with a trade. The next boat leaves for Hibernia shortly, and I don't have the time to go and get everything to trade myself. See, there are many things here that may be valuable back in the mainland. I've arranged a trade. All I need right now, though, is two sporites.
Crace.reward: Here, you surely do. I hope you find it useful, <Player>! Thanks again for your help! Hopefully, this enchanted silver my, ahh, friend, is sending will make a difference here!

npc_lines.Crace: Ah, you're here to help me, are you? <Player>, you know about the [enchanted silver] in the Silvermine Mountains, in Hibernia? Aye, <Player>, it's mainly controlled by those evil siabra local to the area, however, I've a friend who has managed to get a large amount of the silver. See, we've come up with a trade. The next boat leaves for Hibernia shortly, and I don't have the time to go and get everything to trade myself. See, there are many things here that may be valuable back in the mainland. I've arranged a trade. All I need right now, though, is two sporites. <Player>, <Player>, did you get the sporites? i understand that if you dry them out, they become quite useful. <Player>, that's what some of the Sylvan have told me! Oh, this is a good one! I need just one more from you. Do you have it? Great. Now, I just need one more thing. Now, have you seen the precocious cniogcrags? I would like one of them. I've a friend who wants it for display, why, I don't know. He wants to hang it on his wall. As an exotic type of beast. Oh, did you get the creature? Hand it over! Ah, great! Thank you! Now, you certainly should receive a [reward] for your efforts! Here, you surely do. I hope you find it useful, <Player>! Thanks again for your help! Hopefully, this enchanted silver my, ahh, friend, is sending will make a difference here!

A702.offer: <Player>, is something wrong? I feel like something has been wrong for some time. I talk to the Swett's, and they say the same thing. Funny. I haven't talked to them in such a long time, and they are only next door. Do you [understand]?
A702.accept_line: Oh! Thank you! I hope you can help us! Try talking to Everard. Lucia only mumbles about going to the market. I think she is more affected by this than the rest of us.

Juliana Grym.understand: About the feeling I have, that our peace is disturbed. Sometimes, I feel like I shouldn't be here at all. But there is more. Sometimes I sense strange beings that I can't quite make out. I sense them in the house. They make me [angry].
Juliana Grym.angry: Yes. Unsettled, angry. I try to keep my calm, but they are a constant pressure. And things are already so confusing! For instance, why hasn't Lucia gone to market? She should have gone to [market], yet she hasn't gone in so long.
Juliana Grym.market: Well. She can't remember when she went. Neither can any of us. But it couldn't have been long ago. Things are [strange], <Player>. Will you help us?'

Everard Grym.bothered: Anxious. Angry. Annoyed. What not. What do you want? Oh. Juliana sent you.Didn't she.Fine. You are here. Have you seen anything strange? Odd? Different? We all feel different. Have you seen strange [presences]?
Everard Grym.presences: Aye.Can you? Can't you? Well. Stick around. They come. They always do. I know not what they are. There was a holy man. Father Staverly. He stayed on the hill. He came to us often. Seek him out. Ask him what to do about the Grym family! Tell him the presences disturb us. I think he now stays at Fort Gwyntell, beyond the hill behind our homes.

Father Staverly.forces: Those of Morgana, wicked sorceress and mistress of dragons; and those of Arawan, the dark lord of the underworld. Since Arawn's forces broke the boundries between the mortal and immortal to aid us against Morgana, I can only think it must be Morgana's doing, perhaps one of her minions. The only way to undo the workings of necromancers these days seem to be by accepting the aid of other [necromancers].
Father Staverly.necromancers: Seek out a drakoran mystic. They wear charms of some sort, we call them charms of the dead. Bring these charms to the priest of Arawan at Fort Gwyntell in exchange for a sword, a dark sword of Arawan. Give this to Warin. He was once a great Paladin.

npc_lines.Everard Grym: What? I'm a bit [bothered] right now. Anxious. Angry. Annoyed. What not. What do you want? Oh. Juliana sent you.Didn't she.Fine. You are here. Have you seen anything strange? Odd? Different? We all feel different. Have you seen strange [presences]? Aye.Can you? Can't you? Well. Stick around. They come. They always do. I know not what they are. There was a holy man. Father Staverly. He stayed on the hill. He came to us often. Seek him out. Ask him what to do about the Grym family! Tell him the presences disturb us. I think he now stays at Fort Gwyntell, beyond the hill behind our homes.
npc_lines.Father Staverly: Presences disturb them? In their house? Do they not realize they are dead? Aye, but in these times, that would not be such an odd thing, would it? There are only two [forces] that work with the dead. Those of Morgana, wicked sorceress and mistress of dragons; and those of Arawan, the dark lord of the underworld. Since Arawn's forces broke the boundries between the mortal and immortal to aid us against Morgana, I can only think it must be Morgana's doing, perhaps one of her minions. The only way to undo the workings of necromancers these days seem to be by accepting the aid of other [necromancers]. Seek out a drakoran mystic. They wear charms of some sort, we call them charms of the dead. Bring these charms to the priest of Arawan at Fort Gwyntell in exchange for a sword, a dark sword of Arawan. Give this to Warin. He was once a great Paladin.
npc_lines.Priest of Arawn: <Player>, what brings you out here, to this remote land? Ah! This is a charm used by the drakoran mystics! We've been trying to acquire them, to try and find weaknesses in their magic. They are trying to use dark magics they don't understand, but we do. We ar hoping we can use their ignorance against them. Here, for that, I shall give you this, it is a sword forged in the realm of the dead, in the forges of Arawan. I know a bit about the workings of this world, and even more of the other. I know that there is someone who needs this sword. Be sure it gets to him.
npc_lines.Warin Grym: Fare well, friend, now is not the time to visit us. Many strange things have been going on here, things I can not understand. I fear we are being attacked by forces of great evil, even in our death? Else why are we not at rest? <Player>, I know what this is. It's the dark sword of Arawan. Forged in the fires of the realm of the dead. Forged in dark magics by evil workers of the necromantic arts. To wield this sword is to cut loose the thread that separated us from this world, and brings us to the dark lands of Arawan. I fear though, if we do not do this, then a more dire fate awaits us as enslaved minions of Morgana and her drakoran followers. As such we would never be free to rest. I must believe that Arawan's realm at least would offer some sanction. I will wield this dark sword, and lose myself to Arawan. I may need your help, <Player>. Die, foul creature of Morgana's! I summon thee to thine death! Kill him when he appears <Player>! I have summoned him for you! Speak to me when he is dead!

A714.offer: Welcome back. I have been watching your training and you seem to be blessed with many skills. Those skills will come in handy in the near future. I have been sending reports of your progress to my superiors at the Defenders hall in Camelot and they have decided that it is time to [test your limits and skills].

Trainer.test your limits and skills: Our superiors have sent word that a former member of the Defenders of Albion, Gavon Montgomery, is once again working with us. They did not tell more than he is working with the Defenders and that his task is very important. He has requested assistance with his work, and our superiors felt it was time for you to use some of the skills you have been gifted with. Apparently Gavon needs to recover something that has been lost, and our superiors all agree that you are ready to help him. Do [you agree with them]?
Trainer.you agree with them: I believe you are correct. Go to Gavon Montgomery now and he will tell you more of his [assignment] with the Defenders. You shall find him at Caifelle on the road north of Gothwaite Harbor. I shall pray for your safety while you are out in this dangerous world.

Gavon Montgomery.tracking down lost objects: As you may know, the Defenders of Albion are always searching for better ways to defend the realm from enemies. Our duty is hard, for these days we face not onlythe enemies that nip at our borders but also the ones that exist amongst us. Anything that can be done or used to make our fight a little easier is always well supported among the Defenders. That is [why I was sent] here.
Gavon Montgomery.why I was sent: One of the Inconnu that has been helping us to defend the realm against the Drakoran located and recovered a stone that seems to weaken the Drakoran. Our Theurgists back in Camelot wish to examine and study this stone so that it can possibly be duplicated and used to aid us in this fight. If we [only had it now]!
Gavon Montgomery.only had it now: This Inconnu was coming back from getting the stone when he was attacked and overpowered by a pack of urchin rabblerousers. They stole the stone and ran off into the wilds when the Inconnu mandaged to crawl back here. So far no one has been able to capture the little rabblerouser that has it. Go now and seek out the urchin rabblerouser that has it. They are tricky and throw it around, so keep trying until you find it. We are counting on you.

npc_lines.Gavon Montgomery: Greetings Friar. I see that your trainer received the message fromt he Defenders. What is your name? We have quite a task ahead of us. I was once a Scout for the Defenders of Albion before I hurt my leg. Since I can no longer do my duty, the Defenders have helped set me up s as merchant. It's not what I had planned to be doing , but it puts food on my table. Even though I am not an active member of the Defenders, I still do what I can to help. Lately that has meant [tracking down lost objects]. As you may know, the Defenders of Albion are always searching for better ways to defend the realm from enemies. Our duty is hard, for these days we face not onlythe enemies that nip at our borders but also the ones that exist amongst us. Anything that can be done or used to make our fight a little easier is always well supported among the Defenders. That is [why I was sent] here. One of the Inconnu that has been helping us to defend the realm against the Drakoran located and recovered a stone that seems to weaken the Drakoran. Our Theurgists back in Camelot wish to examine and study this stone so that it can possibly be duplicated and used to aid us in this fight. If we [only had it now]! This Inconnu was coming back from getting the stone when he was attacked and overpowered by a pack of urchin rabblerousers. They stole the stone and ran off into the wilds when the Inconnu mandaged to crawl back here. So far no one has been able to capture the little rabblerouser that has it. Go now and seek out the urchin rabblerouser that has it. They are tricky and throw it around, so keep trying until you find it. We are counting on you. Were you able to find the stone? The Defenders in Albion are waiting for it so they can begin trying to duplicate it. I must send it to them soon. This isn't the stone I seek! I was told it was plain, flat, gray stone. It may have special properties, but the Defenders will have to investigate it. Did you find another stone? This stone doesn't look like it will do much, but we hope that it will. I shall get this over to Camelot right away. The Defenders of Albion sent this over for the person who was able to recover the lost stone. Here take it, and know that you have helped to defend the realm!
npc_lines.The urchin rabblerouser: Ho ho! You thought I had the gray stone you seek, but I didn't! Try again! You want the stone so bad, take two of them! Ho ho!

M721.offer: I give up! These two are [driving me crazy]!
M721.accept_line: I hope for both my sanity and their health that you have found Alisa's and Olvaerr's missing items, <Player>. Do I see [a cloak] in your pack there?
M721.finish: According to Stonelock, this was made by the finest Troll craftspeople around. I hope you will use it as you explore this land. Perhaps one day we shall speak again and you can join in an expedition I am leading! May the house of Skadi watch over you, <Player>!
giver_turnins: Well <Player>, I am speechless. You have done it! They have apologized to each other I thin the world may be ending after all. Now if I can just keep the two groups from killing each other on the away up to Gripklosa, Stonelock will be pleased with me. I cannot thank you enough for helping me. After the last expedition I led, Stonelock [gave me something] for my good service. I have never used it, but I think it is time it got some use.

Skorri.driving me crazy: You don't know what's going on, do you? I believe you may be the only one in all of Aegir who hasn't heard the bickering that has been going on between these two. I would have had both of them dragged to Iarnvidur's Lair and left there if Stonelock Stonefist would have allowed it. Instead I have to listen to them [accuse one] another of horrible things!
Skorri.accuse one: Olvaerr here is one of Ota Yrling's Kobolds, who came over with Longbeard and his dwarves. He claims that Ailsa stole something of his. And Ailsa, one of <Player>'s followers claims that Olvaerr stole a totem she was taking to <Player> Gardasdottir, I've been trying to reason with them but they both so stubborn that neither will listen to me when I say that perhaps they simply [lost their belongings].
Skorri.lost their belongings: ENOUGH! Both of you be quiet this instant or I will have you dragged to Delling Crater and thrown in headfirst! Do you see what I have been dealing with? Stonelock, King Goran's brother, put me in charge of leading two groups up into Gripklosa Mountains and unfortunately these two are the leaders of those two groups. neither will budge until they [get back] their missing items and King Goran and Stonelock ill both string me up unless I get them there.
Skorri.get back: <Player>, right? Well <Player>, I was talking to Kaisa and she says she saw both objects before they were lost and knows how to recreate them. Kaisa can't go get the materials because she's been feeling sick lately and I can't leave these two alone for two seconds or they would tear each other apart. If there was someone to [go out and gather] the necessary items.
Skorri.a cloak: Look Olvaerr, this fine <Player> has found your cloak! Please <Player>, give Olvaerr his cloak so that he will no longer think that Ailsa stole it from him. Perhaps he will even apologize to Alisa.
Skorri.gave me something: According to Stonelock, this was made by the finest Troll craftspeople around. I hope you will use it as you explore this land. Perhaps one day we shall speak again and you can join in an expedition I am leading! May the house of Skadi watch over you, <Player>!

Kaisa.lost them: Yes, they lost them. A few days ago Ailsa went out with the totem tied to her belt and didn't come back with it. I'm sure she lost it when she was out studying the Morvaltar for <Player>. As for Olvaerr, Ailsa might be right in hat he lost it in a drinking game [with the dwarves].
Kaisa.with the dwarves: He took a horse to Aegirhamn on the same say that Ailsa went out and he returned the next morning, reeking for ale and groaning about his head. I didn't see the cloak anywhere. It was the same day they both started accusing the other of stealing. I'm just glad I saw both items before they lost them Poor Skorri only has a certain amount of time [to meet Stonelock] up in Gripklosa mountains and if he can't get those two groups moving, Stonelock will be furious.
Kaisa.to meet Stonelock: Stonelock is going to be leading an expedition into the wilds of Gripklosa to track down the truth of yet another rumor about the Troll Fathers. I told Skorri to just go himself and leave both groups here and let <Player> and Longbeard get in trouble for not being able to control their people, but Skorri said Stonelock wouldn't look at it that was. I'd hate for Skorri to [get in trouble] since he's been so kind to check on me while I've been sick.
Kaisa.get in trouble: Well, if we want to keep Skorri out of trouble, we better get you going! Olvaerr's cloak is rather easy to reproduce. From what he was telling anyone who would listen, he killed a mammoth bull himself and sewed it with he sinew from a morvalt bagskytt. But I saw the cloak and know the pelt actually came from a mammoth calf. And I heard Alisa say she saw Olvaerr killing a morvalt ungdom shortly before he started wearing the cloak. I think you can handle getting the pelt and the sinew. Now for [Ailsa's totem].
Kaisa.Ailsa's totem: This will be a bit more difficult. She took the eye of a biting insect and imbued it with the essence of a pyslings. I believe I can reproduce the process she used if you bring me those two things. I know it is a lot to get, but I know that Skorri will reward you well for saving him from those two. Do you [need directions] to the creatures or do you [know the way]?
Kaisa.know the way: Which do you need directions to? the [mammoth] calves, the [morvalt] ungdom, the [pyslings], the biting [insects], or [all of them]?
Kaisa.all of them: The mammoth calves do have a tendency to roam, but you can almost always find some just west of here, in the open area by the rocks. Take care, for the calves usually travel in pairs. Watch out for the young mammoths, they are more than you can handle at this point!

npc_lines.Kaisa: Come in, come in, <Player>. If I'm not mistaken, Skorri sent you to me. I could hear Ailsa and Olvaerr all the way over here. They have been fighting for days and poor Skorri has been close to tears, which is saying something, him being a troll. They have surely tested his patience. I am just glad that I saw both objects before those two addle-brains [lost them]. Yes, they lost them. A few days ago Ailsa went out with the totem tied to her belt and didn't come back with it. I'm sure she lost it when she was out studying the Morvaltar for <Player>. As for Olvaerr, Ailsa might be right in hat he lost it in a drinking game [with the dwarves]. He took a horse to Aegirhamn on the same say that Ailsa went out and he returned the next morning, reeking for ale and groaning about his head. I didn't see the cloak anywhere. It was the same day they both started accusing the other of stealing. I'm just glad I saw both items before they lost them Poor Skorri only has a certain amount of time [to meet Stonelock] up in Gripklosa mountains and if he can't get those two groups moving, Stonelock will be furious. Stonelock is going to be leading an expedition into the wilds of Gripklosa to track down the truth of yet another rumor about the Troll Fathers. I told Skorri to just go himself and leave both groups here and let <Player> and Longbeard get in trouble for not being able to control their people, but Skorri said Stonelock wouldn't look at it that was. I'd hate for Skorri to [get in trouble] since he's been so kind to check on me while I've been sick. Well, if we want to keep Skorri out of trouble, we better get you going! Olvaerr's cloak is rather easy to reproduce. From what he was telling anyone who would listen, he killed a mammoth bull himself and sewed it with he sinew from a morvalt bagskytt. But I saw the cloak and know the pelt actually came from a mammoth calf. And I heard Alisa say she saw Olvaerr killing a morvalt ungdom shortly before he started wearing the cloak. I think you can handle getting the pelt and the sinew. Now for [Ailsa's totem]. This will be a bit more difficult. She took the eye of a biting insect and imbued it with the essence of a pyslings. I believe I can reproduce the process she used if you bring me those two things. I know it is a lot to get, but I know that Skorri will reward you well for saving him from those two. Do you [need directions] to the creatures or do you [know the way]? Which do you need directions to? the [mammoth] calves, the [morvalt] ungdom, the [pyslings], the biting [insects], or [all of them]? The mammoth calves do have a tendency to roam, but you can almost always find some just west of here, in the open area by the rocks. Take care, for the calves usually travel in pairs. Watch out for the young mammoths, they are more than you can handle at this point! For the morvalt ungdom, follow the road southwest as if you are going to Aegirhamn and cross the large stone bridge. Not far over the bridge you will find morvalt ungdom on both sides of the road. The pyslings and found in many places, but I like one particular spot. From the guard tower near the large stone bridge, head due south. You'll cross over the road and enter a small valley between the hills. You should find some in there. Some are only there at night, but others are there all the time. As for the biting insects, head south from the guard tower near the large stone bridge. Cross over the road and into a small valley between the hills. Once in the valley, follow it west until you reach the beach. The biting insects live along the coastline. Oh, <Player>, you should be thankful you were not here recently! Ails and Olvaerr got into another yelling match and Skorri was ready to drag them back to Muspelheim and drop them into the lava! I managed to get over there and calm them down. Poor Skorri! He's looking so tired from all this. Let us get these things made quickly, shall we? I need the pelt from the mammoth calf first. Now give me the morvalt sinew an I shall quickly sew a cloak. There, that is done and it looks exactly the same as the one he had before. Good job <Player>! Now give me the essence from the pyslings. Please give me the eye from the biting insect. That is done too. I was a little unsure of this one, but from what I overheard Ailsa saying, this is the same process she used. We'll see if it's acceptable to her or not. Here, take the cloak and the totem and go speak with Skorri. Hopefully he hasn't hurt Ailsa and Olvaerr yet!
npc_lines.Olvaerr: Hrmph. It appears that you have found my cloak, <Player>. I didn't think that dwarf would give it...I mean I didn't think anyone would ever find it! Ailsa, I...I...am...sorry. There I said it! Hopefully you have Ailsa's totem so she realizes I didn't take it!
npc_lines.Ailsa: Well would you look at that! The Kobold didn't steal it after all Perhaps I did drop it the other day when I was you watching the Morvaltar. I am sorry too, Olvaerr. And I am sorry, Skorri that we put you through this. I shall send word to my group to prepare for the trip to Gripklosa now. <Player>, I think that Skorri has been stunned into silence. Perhaps you can break him out of it by speaking to him again.

A725.offer: Hello there friend. Welcome to the Isle of Glass. I am Eafa Thatcher, local to these parts. Well, maybe not a true local, in the honest sense of the word, but a local now nonetheless. A [misplaced] local, if you will.

Eafa Thatcher.misplaced: Yes. I came out here for adventure, wealth and most importantly, new scenery! But what I got were a bunch of [undead nuisances] instead.
Eafa Thatcher.undead nuisances: What? You haven't seen them? Come now, friend! They are all over the beautiful apple orchards here. You surely can't have [missed them], did you? Hrm...
Eafa Thatcher.missed them: Well, even if you did, I know you wouldn't want the undead roaming around your orchards, now would you? I didn't think so. Hey! Maybe you and I could work out some sort of [arrangement]. You help me and I'll help you.
Eafa Thatcher.arrangement: The other locals and I don't want those undead around, but we certainly can't take care of it by ourselves. You have the look of a stalwart defender of Albion. I'll bet that you could help [us] with the undead problem.
Eafa Thatcher.us: I'm sure, in exchange, I could get the other merchants to come up with some money, and maybe a magical item for you. What do you say? Will you [do it]?
Eafa Thatcher.do it: Great! I knew you'd help us out. Now listen, here's what [must be done].
Eafa Thatcher.must be done: We had been in negotiations with a man called Reabus Drakehide who was going to deliver the information we had to a necromancer in Fort Gwyntell. But Reabus disappeared with our money and our information. We need that [information].
Eafa Thatcher.information: Reabus was headed to Fort Gwyntell the last we heard, but that was nigh onto a week ago, and a messenger we sent there brought back word that he never made it. His horse was found roaming the hills halfway to [Caer Gothwaite].
Eafa Thatcher.Caer Gothwaite: We aren't sure why he decided to go straight there instead of to Wearyall, but he must have had a good reason. He mentioned something about a person called Meb, but we don't know who that is. Here, take this coin and purchase a ticket to Caer Gothwaite. When you get there, speak with the Stable Master, Kennard Jameson. He will know if there is anyone name Meb frequents [Gothwaite] or not.

Kennard Jameson.Eafa Thatcher: I figured as much. He's been trying to talk adventurers like you into getting rid of the undead around here for ages. Hehe. He still hasn't succeeded. You'd think he'd [stop trying] by now.
Kennard Jameson.stop trying: Well, I know it isn't a noble thing to do, to give up, but he's met with a lot of failures in this undertaking. It is rather monumental. Still, if there's anything I can do to help, I will. Now, we were [talking] about Reabus, right?
Kennard Jameson.talking: Reabus used to like to hang around one of the kitchen servants, a girl named Hanna. She was pleasing to the eyes, I suppose, but she was beneath his station. Not sure what he saw in her, but maybe you could talk with her first.

Hanna.miss: I know they found his horse halfway here, but I almost wish they had found him too, whether he was dead or alive. At least then I'd know. I know what you're thinking, how could a kitchen girl love a [soldier]?
Hanna.soldier: Reabus has always been so kind to me, ever since we were both children. As the years went on, we both kept in touch, from the time he went in for training as an Armsman, to when he was part of [Constantine's army].
Hanna.Constantine's army: I would get a letter from him every month, telling me of the war that was raging between Albion and Midgard and Hibernia. Sometimes it was too gruesome for me to read, but I always [replied] to his letters.
Hanna.replied: Finally, his last letter to me said he was going to be stationed in Caer Gothwaite for limited duty. So, I left Campacorentin Forest and came here. I knew we would finally [be together].
Hanna.be together: He said being only a part-time soldier made it possible for him to earn extra money on the side, helping local merchants with their caravans and helping others with problems. That's when he heard of [Eafa].
Hanna.Eafa: Eafa has been trying to get rid of the undead for a while now and Reabus knew he could do the job. He kissed me goodbye and left for Caifelle. That was the last I saw of him. He told me that if his old friend [Meb] showed up, to get him a room.
Hanna.Meb: Meb was his second in command during the time he served in the army. He had sent Meb a letter asking him to come and help him, but he said he couldn't wait for a reply. Me is a [sorcerer], capable of many things. Reabus knew he could help out.
Hanna.sorcerer: But I haven't seen Meb. In fact, there hasn't even been a reply from Reabus's letter to him over a month ago. I know Meb lives in Caer Diogel, for whatever that's worth. I'm so sad, I hope I get to see Reabus again!

Meb.prohibited: Captain Denholm thought it would be best if those who could defend the Caer remain here. I send word to Reabus, but it must not have reached him in time.
Meb.Anniogel: Hanna tells me Reabus's mount, <Player>, is still there. There may be some clue to his disappearance. Give this note to Toby Keller, the Stable Master there. He will help you.
Meb.not known them: They were, at one time, allied with the Avalonians, but their help was shunned by the Avalonians when the Drakoran attacked Avalon. Though somewhat discouraged, they would not attack. This must be a [trick].
Meb.trick: Until I can discern more information from these scraps, I'm afraid our search is at a standstill.

Toby Keeler.means: Well, whatever it means, I really hope you find Reabus. He was a good tipper.

npc_lines.Kennard Jameson: Ah, yes, Reabus Drakehide, I've heard of him. He used to come around here a lot, but he kind of disappeared about a week ago, if I remember correctly. You must be here from [Eafa Thatcher] aren't you? I figured as much. He's been trying to talk adventurers like you into getting rid of the undead around here for ages. Hehe. He still hasn't succeeded. You'd think he'd [stop trying] by now. Well, I know it isn't a noble thing to do, to give up, but he's met with a lot of failures in this undertaking. It is rather monumental. Still, if there's anything I can do to help, I will. Now, we were [talking] about Reabus, right? Reabus used to like to hang around one of the kitchen servants, a girl named Hanna. She was pleasing to the eyes, I suppose, but she was beneath his station. Not sure what he saw in her, but maybe you could talk with her first.
npc_lines.Hanna: Oh, my poor Reabus! I don't know what's happened to him! I saw him as he headed out to speak to Eafa Thatcher, but that was over a week ago. I [miss] him so much! I know they found his horse halfway here, but I almost wish they had found him too, whether he was dead or alive. At least then I'd know. I know what you're thinking, how could a kitchen girl love a [soldier]? Reabus has always been so kind to me, ever since we were both children. As the years went on, we both kept in touch, from the time he went in for training as an Armsman, to when he was part of [Constantine's army]. I would get a letter from him every month, telling me of the war that was raging between Albion and Midgard and Hibernia. Sometimes it was too gruesome for me to read, but I always [replied] to his letters. Finally, his last letter to me said he was going to be stationed in Caer Gothwaite for limited duty. So, I left Campacorentin Forest and came here. I knew we would finally [be together]. He said being only a part-time soldier made it possible for him to earn extra money on the side, helping local merchants with their caravans and helping others with problems. That's when he heard of [Eafa]. Eafa has been trying to get rid of the undead for a while now and Reabus knew he could do the job. He kissed me goodbye and left for Caifelle. That was the last I saw of him. He told me that if his old friend [Meb] showed up, to get him a room. Meb was his second in command during the time he served in the army. He had sent Meb a letter asking him to come and help him, but he said he couldn't wait for a reply. Me is a [sorcerer], capable of many things. Reabus knew he could help out. But I haven't seen Meb. In fact, there hasn't even been a reply from Reabus's letter to him over a month ago. I know Meb lives in Caer Diogel, for whatever that's worth. I'm so sad, I hope I get to see Reabus again!
npc_lines.Meb: Wha...? Reabus has vanished? Oh! This is all my fault. Curse these attacks. I was unable to get to Caer Gothwaite because we had come under attack by a band of orcs, and travel was [prohibited]. Captain Denholm thought it would be best if those who could defend the Caer remain here. I send word to Reabus, but it must not have reached him in time. Well, if he truly is missing, then I will aid you in your efforts to find him. I don't care what Captain Denholm says, I shall leave this place. Return to Hanna in Caer Gothwaite. I shall meet you there shortly. Hanna and I have already spoken and she has given me as much information as possible. I see only one way to solve this mystery. First, you must travel to [Anniogel]. Hanna tells me Reabus's mount, <Player>, is still there. There may be some clue to his disappearance. Give this note to Toby Keller, the Stable Master there. He will help you. I can not discern what has happened to Reabus with just these pieces. I believe the hair belongs to a thrawn ogre, but I have [not known them] to harm passers-by, especially those on horseback. They were, at one time, allied with the Avalonians, but their help was shunned by the Avalonians when the Drakoran attacked Avalon. Though somewhat discouraged, they would not attack. This must be a [trick]. Until I can discern more information from these scraps, I'm afraid our search is at a standstill. I will stay here with Hanna and see what information can be gained from these pieces. Thank you friend. I'm sorry this couldn't have ended on a more positive note, but such is the way of the world, eh? I hope this coin and this item will be of use to you. Thank you again. Once I have some more information, we can find Reabus and punish those that would think to harm one of Albions' children...
npc_lines.Toby Keeler: Yes, <Player> is still here. I took off his saddle, bridle, the whole thing. All I found was this piece of parchment and some weird looking hair. You can have them, as I have no use for them, but what do you think this [means]? Well, whatever it means, I really hope you find Reabus. He was a good tipper.

Miari.pouches missing: The other night I caught side of a lesser sylvanshade leaving here carrying something brown. I believe it had one of my seed pouches. The lesser sylvanshades never bothered us before the Fomorian came, but their evil presence has disturbed many creatures of the wood, including the sylvanshades. I fear the Fomorian may have even coerced the sylvanshades into stealing the seeds to prevent we Sylvan from restoring the groves. I would go out and search for the thief myself, but i must guard the chests and tend to some delicate seedlings. You must go now and search for the lesser sylvanshade that has the stole seed pouch. Return to me when you have retrieved it. [Step #2] Find a lesser sylvanshade and get the pouch of seeds from it. They can be found northwest of the entrance to the Grove of Domnann. The lesser sylvanshades are everywhere round the Grove so go, kill one and retrieve the pouch. [Step #3] Return to Miari in the Grove of Domnann.
Miari.Step #3: ***! I am pleased to see you have returned. Were you able to retrieve the pouch from the sylvanshade? Please, i must check the seeds.

npc_lines.Miari: Blessings of the Grove upon you, <Player>! You are the one Searlait sent, are you not? What be thy name? When the groves started to be destroyed by the unnatural Fomorian, we that tend the seeds rushed to the groves. We risked our own lives to gather as many seeds and seedlings as we could, for all feared that some rare trees would be lost forever to the hate of the Fomorian. Thoug some of us were lost to the evil Fomorian, many of us were able to return here to the Grove. I have gathered all the seeds we saved and sorted them into pouches. I've stored all the different pouches in these chests. Lately, I found the chests open and [pouches missing]! The other night I caught side of a lesser sylvanshade leaving here carrying something brown. I believe it had one of my seed pouches. The lesser sylvanshades never bothered us before the Fomorian came, but their evil presence has disturbed many creatures of the wood, including the sylvanshades. I fear the Fomorian may have even coerced the sylvanshades into stealing the seeds to prevent we Sylvan from restoring the groves. I would go out and search for the thief myself, but i must guard the chests and tend to some delicate seedlings. You must go now and search for the lesser sylvanshade that has the stole seed pouch. Return to me when you have retrieved it. [Step #2] Find a lesser sylvanshade and get the pouch of seeds from it. They can be found northwest of the entrance to the Grove of Domnann. The lesser sylvanshades are everywhere round the Grove so go, kill one and retrieve the pouch. [Step #3] Return to Miari in the Grove of Domnann. ***! I am pleased to see you have returned. Were you able to retrieve the pouch from the sylvanshade? Please, i must check the seeds. Ah, they are unharmed! These seeds were from some of the rarest trees we have grown. Alas, this handful of seeds is all that remains of the trees, for the Fomorian have destroyed all others. Please, take this in thanks for rescuing these very precious seeds. Now i must go and encourage these seeds into strong, healthy trees. May the sun always warm your roots, ***!
npc_lines.Miary: A fine name, ***! I am called Miari, and I am one of the grove keepers of Domnann. I tend the seeds that shall one day grow to be trees like these, or they would if my seeds did not [keep disapearing].

H740.offer: Welcome back. Mirari and I spoke recently. She complemented you on your skills in retrieving the lost pouch of seeds. She's taken those seeds and sprouted them. She showed me some of the seedlings and the ones [under her care] are doing well.
H740.accept_line: Mirari and I both had a feeling you would say yes. She asked that you come to her now, so that she may tell you more of what she needs. Go to her now, and show the Fomorian they destroy the precious spirit of the Sylvan!

Trainer.under her care: Some of the seedlings have gotten too big for her to keep inside, so she has planted them outside the walls of the Grove. Mirari told me that out there she will be able to keep an eye on the seedlings until they are stronger. Once they are strong enough, she and others will take them to their permanent homes in new groves. We shall help the Sylvans [protect thoses groves] from the evil of the Fomorian.
Trainer.protect thoses groves: Mirari needs help now protecting the seedlings so they can grow into the great trees you see around us now. She has asked for your help again, for she fears there is some evil afoot in her newly planted groves. Will you [go to her] and help her again?

Mirari.for their safety: Shortly after I planted them, I noticed some tracks around the seedlings. Then yesterday morning, as the sun's rays touched the leaves and filled the world with warmth, I went to the grove of seedlings. I was saddened by what I saw. Many of the seedlings had been dug up! Their delicate roots had been ripped from the ground and their tender leaves eaten. Out of the corner of my eye, I [saw the creatures] I belieave are responsible for this horrible act!
Mirari.saw the creatures: A pair of forest grazer calves slunk off into the trees. I am sure that they are the creatures that are tearing up my seedlings and feasting upon them. Before the Fomorian came, the calves never bothered the seedlings but ate the grass instead. I fear that the change in their habits has been caused by the evil of the Fomorian. Some of these seedlings are the last of their kind. You must [protect them]!
Mirari.protect them: Go now and seek out the forest grazer calves. I know you cannot stop all of them, but stopping two of them would help a great deal. I do not like to deal with creatures in this manner, but I must protect my trees at all costs! If they have any of my seedlings, bring them back to me and I shall try to save them. I wish you luck.

npc_lines.Mirari: Blessings of the Grove upon you. It is good to see you again. Since you retrieved the seed pouch for me I have not seen any creatures prowling around the chests again. I offer the thanks of the Grove for that. Those seeds have begun to sprout and I have planted some of the seedlings outside the walls of the Grove. But I fear [for their safety]. Shortly after I planted them, I noticed some tracks around the seedlings. Then yesterday morning, as the sun's rays touched the leaves and filled the world with warmth, I went to the grove of seedlings. I was saddened by what I saw. Many of the seedlings had been dug up! Their delicate roots had been ripped from the ground and their tender leaves eaten. Out of the corner of my eye, I [saw the creatures] I belieave are responsible for this horrible act! A pair of forest grazer calves slunk off into the trees. I am sure that they are the creatures that are tearing up my seedlings and feasting upon them. Before the Fomorian came, the calves never bothered the seedlings but ate the grass instead. I fear that the change in their habits has been caused by the evil of the Fomorian. Some of these seedlings are the last of their kind. You must [protect them]! Go now and seek out the forest grazer calves. I know you cannot stop all of them, but stopping two of them would help a great deal. I do not like to deal with creatures in this manner, but I must protect my trees at all costs! If they have any of my seedlings, bring them back to me and I shall try to save them. I wish you luck. Did the sun smile upon you? Were you able to rid the seedling grove of the horrible forest grazer calves? Did you retrieve any seedlings? Ah, this one is in poor condition, but that is not your fault. I shall do what I can to help bring it back. With warm sun and cool water it may grow yet. Did you find any more? This one is in much better condition! I shall replant this one soon. Only a few of the leaves are torn and the roots are not damaged. With a little care, this seedling will one day be a great tree that will withstand the evil of the Fomorian! I am in your debt! Twice now you have helped me save the trees. Please, take this in thanks and know that the trees shall soon whisper your name in praise. May the rain always be gentle upon your leaves!

A1764.offer: Hello there, what a fine day. I only wish I had more time to spend outdoors. I've taken up a new hobby, I'm [learning to track]. It's fascinating to be able to read the signs of a person or creature's passage.

Brach Leof.learning to track: Recently I followed some interesting tracks in the Pennine Mountains, but I was forced to turn back before I found my prey. The tracks led me to believe I was tracking a [wild chicken]!" However, I also found scales, so I'm not sure what it was.
Brach Leof.wild chicken: If you want to see if you can find some of the feathers of these scaled chickens I'd be most interested. Bring back proof of their existence so I know I was right in my [assumptions].

H1767.offer: Do you [have a moment]? I have great need of your skills.
H1767.accept_line: Oh! This is quite amazing Enchanter. I am most impressed with your progress.

Broc.have a moment: Do you know of the melancholic fairies? Quite a nasty beast they are. Would they not travel in groups I may be a wealthy man by now. My supply of quartz has been limited by their insistence to kill any who approach their hold. I seek the help of any who might be willing to [slay a few] of these insects.
Broc.slay a few: Very well then! Return to me any [melancholic] fairy wings you may find. I will consider this proof of your deeds. Safe travels Enchanter.

A1778.offer: <Player>, I am Kaere and I was sent here by Lady Eilwen and Davay to help Lady Treva Evasca defend this town. The task has not been easy for the Drakoran are a formidable enemy. Every day Lady Treva and her guardians live with the knowledge that the Drakoran may not be satisfied with over running the forts to the north and will attack the town. I have been [gifted with the knowledge] that may yet save this town from the Drakoran.
A1778.accept_line: You have survived, <Player>. You must have courage and bravery that will serve you well. Now, I must add the items to the potion in a specific order, so listen closely to what I ask for. First I need the vial of water from the lesser water elemental.
A1778.finish: Some of the finest craftspeople in the land worked hard to create this, <Player>, and now we present it to you. We cannot thank you enough for your service to Anniogel, <Player>. Lord Arawan and Lady Lile shall look upon you with favor for your help. Fare thee well, <Player>.
giver_turnins: Now I must have the tail of the giant dragonfly.
Please give me the dirt from the urchin rabblerouser.
And now give me the flowing spirit stone.
Kaere drops the stone into the potion and there is a bright flash of firey light Enchanter Slone flinches at the bright light and then nods one last time at Kaere as the potion turns clear.

<Player>, you have worked so hard to help us make that potion that we shall grant you the honor of protecting the toen. Take this potion and go out into the middle of the town. The potion will glow when you reach the correct spot. Then simply use the potion and it will protect the town. If you need help [using an item] I can aid you. Return to me once you have used the potion.

I felt the magic of the potion flowing through the town, <Player>. The potion worked perfectly and the town is protected for a while. When the potion begins to wear off I shall seek out another to help me, for you have done your duty to Anniogel and there are other people that shall need your help. But you do not walk away from here empty handed, <Player>. Enchanter Slone and I have [a gift] for you.

Kaere.gifted with the knowledge: Lord Arawn deemed me worthy to be skilled in potion making. Together with Enchanter Slone, we have developed a potion that will shield and protect the town for a while. There isn't a potion that will grant the town permanent protection - it is only through the destruction of the Drakoran that the town will be safe again. Until then I shall do everything in my power [to aid Lady Treva] in protecting her town.
Kaere.to aid Lady Treva: Lady Trevahas asked me to make this potion, as well as perform my daily tasks for her. I do not have the time to gather the necessary components for this potion and Enchanter Slone must remain here to serve those seeking enchantments. If I was to tell you what we needed, could you [get it for me]? [Will you gather the components for Keare's spell to protect Anniogel?]
Kaere.Will you gather the components for Keare: Enchanter Slone has called upon his knowledge of the magic of this land and combined it with my knowledge of the dead. Together the two make a powerful protection potion. All the components for the potion [can be found] on creatures that roam this land.
Kaere.can be found: For Enchanter Slone's part of the potion we will need a draft of water from a lesser water elemental. It shall be the base of the potion. I shall give you a container to capture the water in when we are finished speaking. You will also need to get the tail of a giant dragon fly and then some dirt from an urchin rabblerouser. Both items will aid in forming the invisible wall to repel the Drakoran from this town. There is one more thing you will need for the potion. and that is [my ingredient].
Kaere.my ingredient: I require the glowing spirit ston of the ghosts that roam the land. By placing the spirit stone of one of Morgana's servants into the potion it shall aid to break the power she has over this land. You may aquire these four components in any order you wish, but you must bring me all four to brew the potion. Do you [need directions] to the creatures you must hunt or do you [know already] where they are?
Kaere.know already: I am pleased that you are so familiar with the creatures of this land. Here is the vial to capture the water from the lesser water elemental. If you should forget the locations of any of the creatures, come back and speak with me. Remember, you may obtain the [components] in any order. If you lose this vial, return to me and I shall give you another one, but do your best not to lose it! Good luck, <Player>.
Kaere.using an item: To use and item, drag the icon of the potion ove to your quickbar. Then type the letter of the Use item key (check your keyboard mapping to see what it is set as), then type or click the number of the hotkey where you will put the potion. This will allow you to use the item. Good luck, <Player>!
Kaere.a gift: Some of the finest craftspeople in the land worked hard to create this, <Player>, and now we present it to you. We cannot thank you enough for your service to Anniogel, <Player>. Lord Arawan and Lady Lile shall look upon you with favor for your help. Fare thee well, <Player>.

M1784.offer: Oh, you new to our tribe, aren't you? Yes, yes you are. I was told to give you tasks. So I have good task for you to do. [Listen] closely.

Rith.Listen: Thir in charge of making rope and nets for tribe. Fishing easy for us, but best rope come from the Cave Lioness [sinew].
Rith.sinew: Cave Lioness fierce hunters. Very protective of territory. Kill many [musslaklan] warriors. But you stronger than us. Go now, get us some sinew so we can have stronger nets and rope.

M1785.offer: Oh, you new to our tribe aren't you? Yes, yes you are. I was told to five you tasks. So I have good task for you to do. [Listen] closely.

Torlieva.Listen: Woolly Mammoths give our hunters hard time. But mammoths good eating and clothing. YOu go out and get mammoth hides for us. Harsh winter is coming. Need [warm] clothes.
Torlieva.warm: Yes. We fish, get food that way, but clothes very [important]. Go now. Come back when you have hides!

H1788.offer: Blessings upon you this night, <Player>. Your progress has been not gone unobserved. Each day you walk the Path of Affinity brings you closer to being one with Nature. Yet there are many unnatural things that threaten both the world around and us. I have received word from one who strives beyond all others to remove the unnatural and restore the balance to this land. Her name is Ciarda and she is the trainer of Druids that walk the Path of Harmony. She desires that [all join together] and aid her in this fight.
H1788.accept_line: The earth and the sky sing with happiness that you join in this endeavor. Go now to Ciarda, for she awaits you. She will tell you more of the work she and the Druid Torrance are doing.

Trainer.all join together: Ciarda has recruited a Druid by the name of Torrance to help her in this battle. Although he is in Hibernia, they share information about the magic that we use, and the magic that flows through Hy Brasil. Together they hope they can find a way to counteract some of the evil influence that Fomorian have had on our land. Yet they cannot do this work alone. They have asked all who walk the Path of Affinity to join with them and solve this problem. Will you [answer Ciarda's call] for help?

Ciarda.tap into the same magic: He has had some success, although it is difficult to tell since he is not here to test it upon the plants and animals of this land. I have tested some of the spells he has developed, but since I possess the magic naturally, I am not a good judge. Torrance and I have come up with [a solution to this problem].
Ciarda.a solution to this problem: The magic should work upon plants and animals of this land, but they have become far to wild to take to Hibernia safely. I believe that if we are able to get a root from a tendril weed, Torrance will be able to nurture it until it grows into a tendril weed he can use. As for the animals, Torrance said he doesn't actually need a live creature to work with, just [some part of it].
Ciarda.some part of it: I know it is not the most pleasant thought, but it will do the job. If it means that he will know if he is truly drawing upon the magic of Hy Brasil, it is worth it. Once you get the root from the tendril weed, seek out a callow forest grazer. You'll need to get a hoof from it. That will be enough for Torrance to work with. Now, go and seek out a tendril weed. When you have everything, return to me here.

npc_lines.Ciarda: I'm glad you answered my call, <Player>. My work with Torrance of Hibernia is vital to the protection of this fair land. If he and I can discover some way to protect the land from the influence of the Fomorian, it would help to turn the tide in our direction. As a Sylvan, I know many of the secrets of this land that now fail us with the coming of the Fomorian and I have shared these secrets with Torrance in hopes that he will be able to [tap into the same magic] that the Sylvan use. He has had some success, although it is difficult to tell since he is not here to test it upon the plants and animals of this land. I have tested some of the spells he has developed, but since I possess the magic naturally, I am not a good judge. Torrance and I have come up with [a solution to this problem]. The magic should work upon plants and animals of this land, but they have become far to wild to take to Hibernia safely. I believe that if we are able to get a root from a tendril weed, Torrance will be able to nurture it until it grows into a tendril weed he can use. As for the animals, Torrance said he doesn't actually need a live creature to work with, just [some part of it]. I know it is not the most pleasant thought, but it will do the job. If it means that he will know if he is truly drawing upon the magic of Hy Brasil, it is worth it. Once you get the root from the tendril weed, seek out a callow forest grazer. You'll need to get a hoof from it. That will be enough for Torrance to work with. Now, go and seek out a tendril weed. When you have everything, return to me here. Were you able to obtain the root of the tendril weed? Please give it to me now. Thank you. Torrance will appreciate your hard work. Now, if you were able to obtain the grazer hoof, he will be very pleased. You have done well, <Player>. I know that the future of Hy Brasil is in better hands knowing there are people of the Paths of Harmony and Affinity out there protecting our precious lands. Take this with the thanks of both Torrance and myself. I hope that if we should need your services again, you will answer our call. Blessed be, <Player>!

M1789.offer: <Player>, it is good to see you again. I have recovered a bit from the last time we spoke. Remember the vessel you got for me? I was able to get it to Meregrota and she has enchanted it properly. It will be perfect for holding the essences that [Elizabeth so wants].
M1789.accept_line: So, you have lost the vessel, after I warned you not to! Do not fret, <Player>, I knew that Pyserlian might cause trouble. While he may not be the strongest pyslings, he is cunning and fearless, and the other pyslings fear him. I am afraid that [without a special charm] to weaken Pyserlian, you will not be able to get the vessel back and trap his essence.
M1789.finish: Elizabeth will be most pleased to finally receive this. There is a Berserker going over to Mularn soon and I shall send this with her. I sent word to Elizabeth that a Berserker was helping me and she sent this over in thanks. Please take it, knowing that you have helped to protect Midgard!

Dalea Gronholm.Elizabeth so wants: Elizabeth has grown a little impatient with me, although she knows I've been sick and I'm still recovering. The situation over on the mainland grows worse, and she is desperate to learn some new enchantments to aid in the fight againsta Hibernia and Albion. Her one enchantment needs the essences of different undead spirits. she's asked a few others to help her over around Mularn, but [I am to gather] the essences here.
Dalea Gronholm.I am to gather: Since I am not well enough to handle this, it falls upon you. You must take this vessel with you and obtain the essences of three psylings. Elizabeth believes there is [something] in their essence that will help our brave forces defeat the armies of Albion and Hibernia. Go now and defeat three Pyslings. As you defeat each one its essence will fill the vessel. Do not lose the vessel for then all our hard work will be for naught! If it should become lost, return to me and we will work out a solution.
Dalea Gronholm.without a special charm: When I went to Meregrota, she and I spoke of th [ -- Missing quest text -- Dalea tells you to go kill a Morvalt Ungdom and collect a finger bone, then take it to Meregrota Solvor who can place an enchantment on it that will help defeat Pyserlian.]]
Dalea Gronholm.-- Missing quest text -- Dalea tells yo: <Player>, I am glad to see you have returned. Time grows short. Do you have the vessel of essences?

npc_lines.Meregrota Solvor: Dalea Gronholm said that you may be coming to me for a way to weaken Pyserlian. Give me the morvalt finger bone and I shall enchant it. There, the bone is enchanted. Do not look surprised that it took so little time. The spell is quick and fairly simple, but it will cancel the spell that Pyserlian has cast around the vessel. You must wear the bone around your neck to cancel Pyserlian's spell. If you do not wear the bone, Pyserlian will not give you back the vessel and Dalea and Elizabeth will both be disappointed. Go now and seek out Pyserlian and obtain the vessel for Dalea! When you have defeated Pyserlian, the charm will disappear for its magic will be used up.
npc_lines.Pyserlian: No! How did you break my spell! I shall seek my revenge upon you one day! Just wait and see if I don't!

A1793.offer: About sever days ago, one of the city guards became suddenly ill during the night and I was called to her bedside. The guard was crying and in severe pain. She said that her back felt like it was on fire. I rolled her on her side to look at her back and the smell of [rotthing flesh] filled the air.
A1793.accept_line: Good. I will need all the help I can get. I would like you to go meet with Berenger Brenner. He is the guardian of one of the latest people to show signs of the disease. I would like you to try and discover anything you can about the strange illness. I will try to make another potion to cure it while you are gone. May the light of Camelot shine upon you, ______.
A1793.finish: This one potion should be more than enough. You can keep the other potion for yourself. It's a very powerful potion, so use it when in dire straights. I must begin to cure the other stricken people. You have earned a friend for life, ______. I shall remember your name if I am ever in need of help again.
giver_turnins: Praise the Church, you have returned! There have been more people coming down with the plague. Luckly, I have found a way to figure out who is [sick] and who isn't. This potion gives me the ability to see who is sick. I was just about to drink some more before you came in.
You are very lucky, _______. I could see the sickness growing in your body while you were standing there.
At least you are well for now. We need to do something about Gaevin. I forgot to ask. Did you find out anything [new] from him?
You have returned and not a moment too soon. Do you have the Stoppered Wondrous Potion?
Thank you, ______. You have saved all of Albion from this disease! Hopefully, you will never need to go into that [hellish] place ever again.

Sister Elaydith.rotthing flesh: Her back was covered with black small oozing sores. I applied a salve to her back and hoped that would be the end of it. I could not have been more wrong. Two days later, she died. Since her death, eight more people have grown ill and two have died. If this plague [continues], everyone in the city will be sick and dying in a matter of weeks. We have to stop it before it's too late. Will you help me ______?
Sister Elaydith.sick: Oh no! You have the early markings of the disease. We have to get you a potion to keep you healthy while we find a [cure].
Sister Elaydith.cure: There is only one thing that seems to do any good and I have run out of it. I need you to quickly go into Dartmoor and find a creature called a Dartmoor Pony. I need you to bring me the horse fungus that comes from that creature so I can use it to cast a special cure spell on you. Go quickly before you start showing signs of the illness.
Sister Elaydith.Marquis Sabonach: This is not the first time I have heard that name. Others have whispered it to me. I have [learned] where it comes from.
Sister Elaydith.learned: Sabonach is the name of a demon that lives in an underground fortress called Darkness Falls. Legends say that the Marquis lives in the darkest depths of that hellish place. The entrance can be found in our relic keeps, but the mythical gate only opens when our forces have conqured more lands than the other realms. Otherwise, the entrance remains closed. There are rumors of another gateway very close to Camelot City, which may be used in a suprise attack against us. That place is pure evil, ______, but I fear you will need to go there and find a [cure] for the disease.
Sister Elaydith.Albion: He informed the king that Sir Bors is planning some sort of an assassination against the Crown. He also said that the demon named Marquis [Sabonach] was spreading the disease that is afflicting Camelot City
Sister Elaydith.Sabonach: I did some research of my own and found the name of another creature in Darkness Falls that may hold the cure. There is a creature called Malroch. He is said to be the cook of Darkness Falls. He cooks up recipes made from the fruit of immortality. If you could bring me just one of his sealed wondrous potions, I am sure I could come up with a cure for the [disease]. You could keep any extra potions you find for yourself.
Sister Elaydith.disease: He might be our only chance, ______, If not, I am sure that Camelot City will soon fall to this horrible disease and after that, all of Albion. You must find the way into Darkness Falls before it is too late.
Sister Elaydith.hellish: This one potion should be more than enough. You can keep the other potion for yourself. It's a very powerful potion, so use it when in dire straights. I must begin to cure the other stricken people. You have earned a friend for life, ______. I shall remember your name if I am ever in need of help again.

Berenger Brennan.Sister Elaydith: Very well. I am watching over [Gaevin] ensuring sure he is well enough to tend to his duties.
Berenger Brennan.Gaevin: Aye. He has been feeling ill lately, yet he refuses to rest. I keep telling him that he needs to drink water and sleep. He is as stubborn as a mule and has never listened a day in his life. Every time I tell him to go rest, he just says I should mind my own business. He is in a lot of [pain] and I think he wants to see his brother, Keener, for something.
Berenger Brennan.pain: Well I know you didn't come all this way just to chat with me. You should go speak with Gaevin now, while he is in a good mood. He normally doesn't chat much with strangers, especially ones with questions prying about his health.
Berenger Brennan.demons: He tried to cut me in half with a sword until I pinned him against the wall. I felt so bad because I know the sores on his back hurt so much, but it was the only way to keep him from [killing me].
Berenger Brennan.killing me: I have heard stories of other sick people killing Clerics because they were so sick they thought the Cleric was a demon. You need to go back to Sister Elaydith that Gaevin's time is near. I don't think he will live much longer without a cure.

Gaevin Sebryn.sick: I have heard rumors spreading around the city about people falling ill, but the guards are keeping a tight lip if you ask them what is happening. I think the king is trying to keep this sickness a secret so people don't panic. Can I tell you my own [secret]?
Gaevin Sebryn.secret: I am really scared, ______. I am putting a brave face on so that the city guard, Berenger, doesn't lock me up. I don't think I will live to see the next full moon. Can you do me a [favor], ______?'
Gaevin Sebryn.favor: I need a message delivered to my hometown so they know what is going on. If I die, I don't want them to think I left home because of them. I just needed to get out and see the world, [understand]?
Gaevin Sebryn.understand: I am sure you do. You seem the adventurous sort yourself. Now take this sealed letter to my brother, Keener, in Ludlow. He will make sure my parents get it. Tell him not to worry about me. He will know something is wrong when he gets my letter because I haven't tried to wrote to my parents in years. [Hopefully], the cleric will find a cure before you return.
Gaevin Sebryn.Hopefully: If not, I may not be hear to learn of any news you bring back. Now get out of here! I am tired of looking at your ugly mug.
Gaevin Sebryn.feeling: I can't lie down to sleep anymore. It causes so much pain if I touch the sores. I am getting sicker and I am so scared. A [strange man] came to visit me while you were gone.
Gaevin Sebryn.strange man: He was dressed in long robes and said he was Marquis Sabonach. That man did not look like a noble at all. He whispered some strange words in my ear and said I would be [ok].
Gaevin Sebryn.ok: He lied. I even feel worse than yesterday. My body hurts too much for me to try lying down again. I don't know what I am going to do. I hope the Healer has a cure for me soon. Could you ask Berenger if he has heard anything yet? I know Berenger thiks I have lost my mind but I am fooling him. Tehe haha.

Keener Woedin.favor: Go back to Camelot and give this note to Gaevin. I realize that it must be quite the journey for you and you are not a messenger, but I must insist that you help me get that [message] to my brother.
Keener Woedin.message: Gaevin may die before he finds out my parents don't hate him for leaving Ludlow. That is why it is so important to me to have him get my message. I have a few gold coins if you need them. Do you [need them] or [not]?
Keener Woedin.not: Thank you, ______. I will put the coin to good use. It will help pay for my parents to travel to [Camelot City].
Keener Woedin.Camelot City: Aye, you must get going. Thank you so much, ______. You shall be blessed for your deeds this day.

npc_lines.Berenger Brennan: Greetings, noble one. You must have been sent by [Sister Elaydith]. Very well. I am watching over [Gaevin] ensuring sure he is well enough to tend to his duties. Aye. He has been feeling ill lately, yet he refuses to rest. I keep telling him that he needs to drink water and sleep. He is as stubborn as a mule and has never listened a day in his life. Every time I tell him to go rest, he just says I should mind my own business. He is in a lot of [pain] and I think he wants to see his brother, Keener, for something. Well I know you didn't come all this way just to chat with me. You should go speak with Gaevin now, while he is in a good mood. He normally doesn't chat much with strangers, especially ones with questions prying about his health. Welcome back, ______. It was truly good of you to bring that letter for poor Gaevin. I fear his sickness is starting to overcome him. He has been talking about a strange man coming to see him and babbling stuff about [demons]. He tried to cut me in half with a sword until I pinned him against the wall. I felt so bad because I know the sores on his back hurt so much, but it was the only way to keep him from [killing me]. I have heard stories of other sick people killing Clerics because they were so sick they thought the Cleric was a demon. You need to go back to Sister Elaydith that Gaevin's time is near. I don't think he will live much longer without a cure. Hmm, my back itches. You should get going, _______.
npc_lines.Gaevin Sebryn: What are ye looking at? Didn't your sire ever teach you not to stare? Anyway, it's not important. I told the clerics everything I know about how I became sick. I went to bed one night feeling fine and I awoke the next morning with my back feeling like I had slept on a bed of hot coals. I haven't left the city in the past few weeks and I haven't been around sick people, at least none that looked [sick]. I have heard rumors spreading around the city about people falling ill, but the guards are keeping a tight lip if you ask them what is happening. I think the king is trying to keep this sickness a secret so people don't panic. Can I tell you my own [secret]? I am really scared, ______. I am putting a brave face on so that the city guard, Berenger, doesn't lock me up. I don't think I will live to see the next full moon. Can you do me a [favor], ______?' I need a message delivered to my hometown so they know what is going on. If I die, I don't want them to think I left home because of them. I just needed to get out and see the world, [understand]? I am sure you do. You seem the adventurous sort yourself. Now take this sealed letter to my brother, Keener, in Ludlow. He will make sure my parents get it. Tell him not to worry about me. He will know something is wrong when he gets my letter because I haven't tried to wrote to my parents in years. [Hopefully], the cleric will find a cure before you return. If not, I may not be hear to learn of any news you bring back. Now get out of here! I am tired of looking at your ugly mug. Thank you for bringing me this note. I am glad my parents know I am sick, but I am not sure I remember your name, <Class>. I haven't been [feeling] well lately at all. I can't lie down to sleep anymore. It causes so much pain if I touch the sores. I am getting sicker and I am so scared. A [strange man] came to visit me while you were gone. He was dressed in long robes and said he was Marquis Sabonach. That man did not look like a noble at all. He whispered some strange words in my ear and said I would be [ok]. He lied. I even feel worse than yesterday. My body hurts too much for me to try lying down again. I don't know what I am going to do. I hope the Healer has a cure for me soon. Could you ask Berenger if he has heard anything yet? I know Berenger thiks I have lost my mind but I am fooling him. Tehe haha.
npc_lines.Keener Woedin: This is a letter from Gaevin! I haven't heard from him in years. I hope nothing is wrong. Oh my! I can't believe this. Gaevin has come down with some sort of plague or something. He can't die! I must tell my parents immediately. Please do me this one [favor], ______. Go back to Camelot and give this note to Gaevin. I realize that it must be quite the journey for you and you are not a messenger, but I must insist that you help me get that [message] to my brother. Gaevin may die before he finds out my parents don't hate him for leaving Ludlow. That is why it is so important to me to have him get my message. I have a few gold coins if you need them. Do you [need them] or [not]? Thank you, ______. I will put the coin to good use. It will help pay for my parents to travel to [Camelot City]. Aye, you must get going. Thank you so much, ______. You shall be blessed for your deeds this day.

A1794.offer: Greetings to you this fine day friend. I am Achae Smith. Over there is my daughter Aelbfeld Smith. My husband is the hard working man, but I sometimes regret coming [out here].
A1794.accept_line: Oh! You will! Excellent! Thank you so much! I am very worried for my <Player>'s safety, and I would hope you find him alive, but if you don't, please bring his [remains] back to me.
A1794.finish: This was <Player>'s most prized possession. He gave it to me before he left on his fatal trip, telling me it was time to pass it on to another. I know I can not put it to use, perhaps you can. Here is al littler coin as well. I know it isn't much, but perhaps it will aid you in your battles. Thank you again friend. Even though these are sad times, I am strenghtened by your courage and kind heartedness. Thank you.
giver_turnins: Oh, you're back. Did you talk with Gracien? What did he have to say?
You need the metal bit I found? Well, alright. Gracien does know best I suppose. Here you are. I hope it helps to find my uncle! Please hurry froend! I want him home, safe and sound.
Welcome back ______. Were you able to find out any information?
Well, I suppose I should have expected that, even though I held out hope that he was alright. Could I please ask [another favor] of you?
Oh find, did you find <Player>'s remains?

Well, I want to thank you friend, for helping my family out in this difficult time. Atleast now I can give him a proper burial. I have little to offer you in the way of rewards, but I may have something that will benifit you better than me.

Achae Smith.out here: Oh, I know he meant well, thinking we could have a better life and all, that it would be less crowded than Camelot, which mind you, it is, but still...
Achae Smith.Cabalist Meical: I don't know the whole story, but I can share with you what I know. Not so long ago, a great cabalist by the name of Meical came here to Devwy. No one knows his reasons for coming, but some say it was to [shun] society.
Achae Smith.shun: In order to survive here, he built automated constructs of varying types and sizes. The more he was away from civilization, the more mad he went. Eventually, he lost his mind completely. That is when his creations [turned] on him.
Achae Smith.turned: Oh yes. They killed him and then left their prison to roam around the hills and valleys of Devwy. They will harm anyone in their path. That is why I am [concerned] for my uncle's safety.
Achae Smith.concerned: My uncle left a few days ago to make a trip to Wearyall Hill to trade for some supplies we desperately needed. The caravan has not returned yet, and our guards found some pieces of [shredded clothing] in the woods a days travel from here.
Achae Smith.shredded clothing: I went out exploring fir a little bit yesterday where the guards had found the shredded bits and discovered [this] as well.
Achae Smith.this: It's a chunk of metal from what I believe is a [forged servant].
Achae Smith.forged servant: A forged servant is a very aggressive construct of Meical's, forged from the very same metal used to make anvils. If a forged servant did take my uncle, there's no telling what they might have [done] to him!
Achae Smith.done: Please froend, will you help me out and [search] for my uncle?
Achae Smith.remains: We can give him a proper burial through the Church of Albion if we had his remains. Oh, but I do so hope for the best. Gracien Adamson is our local scholar around here. You should speak with him about Meical's creatures.
Achae Smith.another favor: Will you please find <Player>'s remains for me? I would like to have a proper burial for him. It would mean so much to me if you [would fo this] for me.
Achae Smith.would fo this: Oh thank you friend. I am indebted to you. Please return to me when you find the remains.

Gracien Adamson.Achae Smith: Yes... I heard about her uncle's strange disappearance. And then her finding of that metal. It's hardly what I'd call evidence, as you can find pieces of forged servants just about everywhere. Still, if she wants me to talk with you, I see [no harm].
Gracien Adamson.no harm: The forged servants are constructs made out of a dense steel, the same you'd find in an anvil. You'll sometimes hear them referred to as [anvil monsters], but I don't know how common that name is.
Gracien Adamson.anvil monsters: I'm sure you know that they were made by Meical in order to serve him. Make no mistake, friend. These creatures are pure evil, a menace to us and any who come upon them. I'll tell you [what], though.
Gracien Adamson.what: I know and alchemist who could determine if a forged servant really did make off with Achae's uncle. All you need is to get that piece of metal her and then come back to me. Don't worry, I'm sure she'll give it to you.

Elyn Badam.list: First, I need a piece of bark from Brother Josef's tree. It's the large one on the hill over yonder, you can't miss it. Secondly, I need a Golden Orb from a Drakoran Mage. Lastly, I need a [pair of wings] from an apple fly.
Elyn Badam.pair of wings: I suggest you get the items sooner rather than later. The longer we wait, the harder it will be for me to garnish whatever information I can from this metal bit.

npc_lines.Gracien Adamson: Yes? What can I do for you? Or are you here to waste my time? Oh yes... I am quite familiar with that creature, well, with most of the cabalist's former servants, I must say. But what interest do you have in the forged servant? You haven't, by chance, been talking to [Achae Smith], have you? Yes... I heard about her uncle's strange disappearance. And then her finding of that metal. It's hardly what I'd call evidence, as you can find pieces of forged servants just about everywhere. Still, if she wants me to talk with you, I see [no harm]. The forged servants are constructs made out of a dense steel, the same you'd find in an anvil. You'll sometimes hear them referred to as [anvil monsters], but I don't know how common that name is. I'm sure you know that they were made by Meical in order to serve him. Make no mistake, friend. These creatures are pure evil, a menace to us and any who come upon them. I'll tell you [what], though. I know and alchemist who could determine if a forged servant really did make off with Achae's uncle. All you need is to get that piece of metal her and then come back to me. Don't worry, I'm sure she'll give it to you. Yes, those do look like pieces from a forged servant, but without scribibg, it's nearly impossible to tell. Alright then, here is what you're going to do]. Take the metal bits with you to Wearyall Hill. There you will find a woman named Elyn Badam. She is a friend of mine, the alchemist I spoke of earlier. Give her this note. She should help you out after that. Good luck friend.
npc_lines.Elyn Badam: And what might I be able to do for you today? Ah, my dear friend Gracien... I do wish he'd come here for a... visit. But, that's really not what you're here to discuss, is it? It says in this note that you have some metal bits for me to look at? Well, hand them to me. Yes, I can discover if it was indeed the creature that took the woman's uncle. But I need for you to fetch me some ingredients in exchange for the information. Here is the [list] of what I will need. First, I need a piece of bark from Brother Josef's tree. It's the large one on the hill over yonder, you can't miss it. Secondly, I need a Golden Orb from a Drakoran Mage. Lastly, I need a [pair of wings] from an apple fly. I suggest you get the items sooner rather than later. The longer we wait, the harder it will be for me to garnish whatever information I can from this metal bit. Welcome back friend. I take it you were successful in retrieving the items I sent you after. If you were, please hand the Wearyall Tree Bark to me first. Now, for the Drakoran Golden Orb please. This is an absolute must for my ritual. Yes. Quite nice. And in excellent condition too. Now, for the apply fly wings. I hope they weren't too diffucult for you to obtain. Most excellent. You have done well my friend, and I am please with what you have brought me. Now, if you will please wait, I will begin. It's done my friend. I'm afraid that <Player> is no longer among the land of the living. A forged creature did take his life, along with several others. You should return to Achae Smith with this information.

M1803.offer: Ah, [Bonedancer]. You've aided Karle before, haven't you? Well, guess what! He's got a new idea. He wants to create a new clan crest!

Karle Alfevson.Crest: Aye. I think that using the talisman and the primitive icons of this land would be appropriate. So, what do you [think]?
Karle Alfevson.think: Morvalt ungdom often carry primitive tokens of luck. Find two morvalt ungdom and bring me their tokens!
